story_mappings.introduction: Trace the Temple of Flames’ fallen order, recover its exact proofs and follow the stories of its surviving voices. Six independent requests record accepted outcomes. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting.
orientation: Enter the temple lands from the southern boundary. Illyn at the guarded entrance can explain the fallen order, the fire emblem and the messiah. The haunted forest, moat currents, hidden shafts and temple inhabitants remain dangerous.

Illyn asks for his lost soul. Aku, deep within the temple, carries the soul of Illyn that is the exact proof. Illyn gives his armor and sword and leaves after accepting it. Wearing similar equipment or hearing his story does not record the hand-in.

The graveyard attendant hints at the sepulchre. At its entrance, SAY sepulchre, then OPEN door and go SOUTH when the route is closed. ASK lleddraick water or well explains the king’s request for the sick man’s knife. The hidden basin below the old well leads toward that man: SEARCH, OPEN basin and go DOWN. The well itself is scenery.

Bring the contortionate man’s well-crafted dagger to King Lleddraick. He reveals illesarus and leaves; this request has no item reward. The same knife can instead be spent on the little child’s request in the Hall of the Ancients. One consumed copy cannot complete both requests.

The bridge inscriptions and Illyn’s fire hint describe the outer temple puzzle. The current eastern doors respond to SAY bdkn, then OPEN doors and EAST. Their reverse inscription spells the word differently; the intended clues need builder review. An already open route requires no personal earlier password action.

Follow the faerie forest for the sage’s four-item bundle: two yellow daggers from the yellow devil, the green devil’s green token and the blue devil’s blue wooden sword. The faerie children do not carry these proofs. Bring two actual daggers together with the two different other items for 500 platinum.

STARE mirror at the curved mirror to enter the shimmering void. STARE backside at the return surface to leave. The old sage waits in the void; his globe and stories are separate from the accepted four-item bundle.

In the upper throne room, SAY illesarus behind the throne, then OPEN wall and go EAST when the route is closed. The angel accepts the exact wedding band and gives two vials of the angel before leaving. This spoken route and the angel’s hand-in require no personal king receipt.

The weapons master remembers his lost love by her golden locket. The first pale maiden in the forest wears it. The locket starts closed but unlocked and can contain a photograph. The master accepts the locket itself, gives a steel key, points you toward the cemetery shack and leaves. Remove anything you wish to keep before offering the container.

The wedding ring is in the steel chest in the cemetery shack. The master’s steel key belongs to that chest, but the chest currently starts open with its locked flag set, so check its actual state before trying to unlock it. The key breaks after a successful unlock. The key, locket and ring do not survive ordinary rent/save handling. A matching supplied ring fits the angel’s request without a prior master receipt.

Ommsh, the massive thorned monster, asks for the stonecrusher. A hallucination carries this hammer in the rooms of melting walls. They have no ordinary walking entrance; native teleport can reach the area, but the intended puzzle route needs builder review. “Drink drop” is a clue, not a recorded drinking objective. Bring the actual hammer for Ommsh’s secret about the hole; he remains and gives no item reward.

Useful shared controls include PUSH table for the shack’s basement panel, PULL latch for the hidden drain and TOUCH statue for the western wall passage. Some hidden routes still need SEARCH and OPEN afterward; the drain’s reverse side does not automatically clear. Opening shared routes does not itself record a story outcome.

The angel’s two vials provide vitality, rather than teleportation. Unholy water has alignment-sensitive healing or harm and finite supply. The epic rune, ambient fire advice, combat traps, statues and other scenery are separate from these six requests.

All six requests are potential dailies under current rules. Exact current stock, legitimate item supply and the return of departing givers govern availability. The journal keeps each accepted outcome independent; no earlier personal kill, access action or different quest receipt is required.

story_mappings.introduction: Shairak's villagers remember dragon tribute, broken families and a shaman's curse. Explore Smokeveil's forest, caves, burrow and lake for the exact proofs each contact accepts. Their exchanges and reward choices remain separate.
orientation: Start in Shairak: Ivar, Dorno, Keebo, Raltron, Tarlator and Ilvorntas live or work around the village paths. Oystein and Forvos wait in the tavern. Ordinary closed cottage, inn and shop doors can be opened.
Ask Ivar about sanrabb, dolgar, svartalo and the lottery to understand the village conflict. His heart reward needs both hearts together; his separate talon reward also makes him leave.

Enter the dragon cave from the forest's big-cave entrance. Dargast carries the pile of scales, Sanrabb his heart, Svartalo the bloody talon, and Dolgar his heart and the large scale. Azcatlipoca waits in the hatchery.
Beneath the sparse brush, follow the hole into the rabbit warren for Xertrath. Keebo wants the bunny master's head, not another rabbit or a general corpse.
The Tentabeast waits in the southern lake. Prepare for water travel and check your return route. The lake and forest paths also lead back to the surrounding lands.
Read the parchment in Tarlator's house and ask about his human curse, offer, heart, scrolls and Raltron. The parchment is readable scenery; you do not need to carry a quest scroll for his exchange.

Choose how to spend trophies. Ivar, Tarlator and Ilvorntas each consume a bloody talon. Tarlator and Ilvorntas each consume a Tentabeast heart. Completing every request needs three talons and two hearts from separate available supplies.

Tarlator's helm can then be delivered to Raltron. Each exchange has its own reward; supplied materials and a supplied helm qualify. A reward from an earlier step does not replace an item you have already spent.

For Oystein's betrayal request, the head named Grishnak has a known carrier in Tezcat: Diabolus in the ruined-temple catacombs. Return the exact trophy to Shairak. The local delivery does not establish a personal foreign kill.

Ravi Bjornson in Alatorin describes Ivar as his father and seeks vengeance for his injuries. His separate request consumes a Tentabeast heart and a Bloodbeast heart from Raxthan; reserve another heart if following that story.
Recover the actual dead animal in the forest for Azcatlipoca; the charred tree's animal description is scenery. Forvos accepts Otsurd's whiskey bottle, pays a coin reward and remains available.

Most request contacts leave after rewarding you. Check their presence and trophy availability before attempting another exchange. Their family histories and promised cures are guidance; these deliveries do not establish a reunion, transformation or every conversation.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore Desolate's village, forest, lagoon, jousting grounds and hidden Master trial. Nine story outcomes and two supply services explain all eleven exchanges. Active, ready accounting is required. Supplied exact proof fits without personal source history; control success, first recovery and trial or world-phase completion need separate accepted events.
orientation: Meet actual recipients before asking addressed words. The eclipse mercenary answers ale. Jandar has generic, class-sensitive level guidance; his teacher role is separate from quest dialogue. The other recipes are described by native prose and the journal, without inventing keyword achievements.

Recover the exact empty tankard from a bar patron in the North Star Tavern, let the eclipse mercenary fill it on the house, and bring that ale kind to the tired halfling for fifty platinum. The decorative ale tankard is different. Current acceptance checks the kind rather than actual liquid fullness; material readiness is not a drink-state objective.

The lost monkey is an item container in the bear den with the minotaur's chain inside it. Open it and remove the chain before handing the monkey to its hunter. Accepted hand-in consumes remaining container contents. Return the chain for an iron rod and ten platinum; the separate monkey request gives a mandolin and fifteen platinum.

The stranded wagon chain is chain → iron rod; rod + broken wheel + five platinum → repaired wheel; repaired wheel → brass token. Scotson's mixed payment is currently guarded under active accounting. A supplied repaired wheel still fits the driver without personal smith history. The driver leaves after acceptance; no physical wagon repair, movement or escort is recorded.

Beregan needs the severed hand from one particular outcast follower and the storm badge worn by the orc captain. Three matching outcasts do not all carry the hand. The captain is inside an entered tent. The scout's distinct armageddon badge instead goes to the Myrabolus delegate. Evidence delivery does not certify personal defeats or a military response.

Stinky bones inside the trapped old garbage container in the minotaur's dwelling fit the wandering shaggy dog and produce a platinum collar. The same container has the persistent bronze key for the locked jousting trophy cabinet. The key and trophy are not dog prerequisites or native story deliveries.

The original letter is inside a dresser drawer in a rented room of Myrabolus' Rising Sun Inn. The drawer is closed and unlocked despite open-drawer prose. Balance on the pier accepts and returns the same letter kind, referring you to the Seraphim on Desolate's secret beach ledge. Supplied original letter fits without that optional foreign referral history; local delivery gives a totem and ten platinum.

The northern exterior road can change: a reset may load a timed random-exit object, which reroutes its north exit into Desolate Under Fire and changes zone closed flags. Normal and invaded areas have different owners. Check the actual route; neither a normal-zone receipt nor discovery is proof of an invasion phase, restoration or safe return.

For the hidden Master approach, touch the torch in Jandar's tent to clear the downward block, then find and open the secret closed route. Push the soil below for the reverse upward block. Secret switches clear their own blocked side, not both directions; the rock and branch controls use the same distinction.

The Master chamber leads through closed rooms and entered caskets. One casket enters the starting trial room; its paired casket returns to the chamber route. Trial buttons lead east to Speed, east to Endurance, south to Strength, west to Courage, west to Will, then north back to the start. The Speed guardians are in the separate upstairs room. Buttons do not explicitly require recorded guardian kills.

The dragon's Master armor and other equipment are ordinary loot, with another declared foreign armor source. Its direct Master procedure counts worn matching slots against seven members, capped at six; the separate adapter table differs. Owning or equipping armor does not prove the whole trial, a full set or an accepted effect lifecycle.

The blue and black knights have R-loaded unicorn and nightmare mounts. Jousting and betting prose has no active local result contract; the gambler has no assigned casino procedure. Locked trophy access is separate, with a pickable cabinet and persistent bronze key. No joust, wager or trophy achievement is invented.

Forest declines have ninety-percent fall fields and watchtower stairs twenty-percent fields. These are falling risks, not quest destinations or ordinary guaranteed movement. Village no-magic rooms and actual movement/equipment conditions remain relevant. Shop purchases are separate services; three trinket stock references are absent from the current static prototype inventory and need builder review.

Nine native exchanges have potential daily shape. Classifying free tankard filling and the potion purchase as services leaves eight story candidates; the guarded mixed wheel repair has no eligible daily shape. Reset mode two, retiring recipients, wandering contacts, shared stock, actual access and ready accounting still govern repeats. No army, animal escort or Master/world-phase campaign terminal is invented.

orientation: The northern trail connects to the Great Forest of Aravne. Ask the dwarf sentry about the mine or where, then meet Bartis and ask worried, miners and free. The mine lies beyond its ownership sign and leads to hidden refuges, a stone giant cavern and Bartis's office. A clue or a discovered zone does not prove successful travel.

A wandering stone giant carries a closed wooden box with four brown-jar declarations. Recover the jars for the two different old miners, the young miner in the well, and Bartis. Each recipient consumes one jar and retires. These quest props narrate travel home; native acceptance does not invoke a potion effect or track a village arrival.

Three distinct badge parts from the miner exchanges combine at Bartis for one complete badge. Supplied matching parts fit without earlier rescue receipts. Offer that bundle before Bartis's final jar if using the same episode; the final jar gives his note and 150000 copper, then removes him and his remaining carried sources.

Bring Bartis's exact note to the sentry for the earring; he also retires. This independent request does not verify a complete personal rescue campaign. Each accepted delivery is its own receipt, and optional producer history cannot replace spent items or restore a recipient.

The wounded dwarf takes the exact green potion inside the northern wagon, gives cash and experience, and stays. The shop's flaming green potion is different. Narrated drinking does not record a checked poison cure or a healed character.

Wandering Remi accepts the raid leader's own scalp for a staff. The raid leader instead takes six distinct proofs: four faction leaders plus Bartis and Hulkuis. Four faction requests consume the same scalps as that bundle. Spend copies deliberately; neither a receipt nor one scalp satisfies all requests.

The drow's duergar-scalp request names potion 27056 and absent item 25000. Current journal readiness cannot guarantee payout, and the request needs a builder-selected reward repair and pre-consumption loadability checks before a safe attempt. No guessed coin or experience replacement is applied.

Grab the hidden rope on the trail for its blocked western cave route. In that cave, the two same-named black stones use grab and lead to different plateaus; select the intended object carefully. Enter the stone well to reach the young miner. Say windship by the marble slab for the crypt route. These are native switch/teleport commands, not learned-topic achievements.

Examine the stone giant office desk and pull its lever for the blocked western bedroom door, then open the door. The LARGE key carried by the hill giant guard opens the separate cavern door. story_mappings.introduction: Discover the city, meet its circus, court, shrine, bartender and monastery contacts, then follow six independent accepted stories. Exact supplies and optional earlier help explain each route. Ramous and Lozin offer supporting services. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The ordinary gravel-highway approach enters north at the southern edge of Verspin. Its brass doorway is closed but unkeyed; open it for the market. The southern city exit returns to the same highway approach.

Explore the circus in the west. Its northwestern tent has a hidden eastern path to the backstage network and Tottan. The five travelling gnomish shamans carry five same-kind totems; the accepted delivery, rather than five personal kills, earns his pants and XP.

Take an apple from either market stall for Ramous in the throne room. He exchanges it for a steak bone. Give that bone to the golden lion for its collar and departure. A supplied bone skips the apple route; those two receipts remain separate.

At the shrine, the holyman asks for five marble symbols from Tharnadian clerics. His suggested persuasion has no accepted keyword or symbol-transfer stage. His retiring delivery is the story outcome, and the other wandering cleric's insignia is a different item.

Vulm's stolen amethyst actually loads on a notorious jewel thief in the Cheltenham castle area, with a one-in-three chance and cap one. His crabmen clue needs correction. Return the exact gem for three distinct ore pieces; no separate gem-shop restoration is recorded.

Transo's Swinging Star is on the spectator level, reached by the city's western or eastern stairs. It needs no gladiator-pit key. Bring one green, one red and one black amulet for a belt and XP; his plan is to sell the stolen goods to Ramous, without an implemented reunion.

Red and green amulets each share a cap of three across their actual town/boatman sources. Black amulets have a separate cap and sources. Lozin's knife competes for reds and blacks; his four-red shield recipe exceeds the reviewed ordinary red cap and needs a deliberate feasibility correction.

Lozin has five actual paid equipment recipes. The sign prototype advertises ten, with no ordinary sign reset and no contracts for the other five offers. Keep the five real recipes as services; their cash settlement remains unavailable with active accounting. Brial also stocks all five outputs.

The master monk asks for one sigil of corruption from Bloodstone. Three sinister apprentices start together in Maelborg's tower, but only one ordinary sigil is declared after the third. The delivery belongs to Verspin and does not prove every apprentice or tower leader was defeated.

The secured pit uses two distinct keys from the strong and elite security guards. Reverse gate sides are merely closed. Guard taunts do not add a custom movement barrier. Hidden cave and shaft routes have their own access and falling hazards; they are not Transo prerequisites.

The waterways use ordinary deep-water movement. A carried or worn leaf boat is one aid; flight and other native movement abilities can also work. Boatmen's ambient offers do not implement a quest ferry, and no boating milestone is inferred from their dialogue.

Shinjin's nine listed stat potions are virtual paid stat effects, with native stat caps, rather than collectible quest objects. The normal teachers, inn and crew room are separate services. They need qualified settlement/effect evidence before any deeper lesson, purchase or hiring objective.

The city's honor, fighting, secret agents and blessings provide exploration lore without native contest-victory, spy-purge or blessing receipts. Asking topics explains current stories; it does not grant learned-keyword achievements. Native XP declarations remain subject to level and group award policy.

story_mappings.introduction: Find the swamp’s surviving voices, learn the history of the ruined elf-kin city and decide what to do with its crystal shard. One accepted shard request records a story outcome; the key and two crafts are paid services. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting.
orientation: Enter from the bottom of Pharr Valley through the wall of vegetation. The swamp is a large maze of pools, creatures, ruins and hidden paths. Currents and underwater passages remain dangerous; journal guidance does not supply waterbreathing or remove travel restrictions.

Knarlash, the dirty half-elf in the southern hut, speaks about his Skexis neighbor, Ahgra, the Mystics and the ruined elf-kin city. The chamberlain in the northern hut asks for a crystal shard. Their dialogue explains the setting without creating separate achievements for every keyword.

The lurking duergar deep in the swamp wields the exact crystal shard that the chamberlain wants. Bring that shard for 75 platinum. The chamberlain remains after the accepted hand-in. Finding a shard, defeating its carrier or hearing about it does not itself record the request.

The chamberlain separately sells the mummified tongue of a dwarf for 50 platinum. This tongue is the key to the mummified dwarf beside him, rather than the crystal shard. The key purchase is currently unavailable while accounting is active; owning a matching key does not establish a purchase receipt.

The mummified dwarf is a container holding the series of small skulls laced into a tome. Its current state is closed and locked, but not pickproof. UNLOCK and OPEN it when needed; a successful unlock breaks its tongue key. The container puzzle and the shard hand-in are independent.

PULL the thick gray vine or vines at the edge of Keera’s quiet clearing. SEARCH and OPEN the hidden route afterward when required. Keera describes her rescue, adoptive family and the Gartham raids. These are memories and leads; the current contracts do not record escorting her or freeing captives.

In the ruined workshop, the hunched podaling can make two different ornaments. The tall bird with arms beside him runs a separate shop. Ask the podaling about headdress, necklace, Keera or Ahgra to hear the exact native clues.

A birdfeather headdress requires six actual dark feathers and one strip of neberihide. The native recipe also requires 1 platinum, although the spoken clue asks for nine. This mixed item-and-coin service is currently unavailable while accounting is active; having the ingredients does not mean the payment or craft has succeeded.

A woven neberihide necklace requires three actual strips of neberihide and a native fee of 500 copper, although the spoken clue asks for six platinum. The necklace provides waterbreathing when worn. This is another guarded paid service, separate from the headdress and from the shard story.

Brooding dark birds carry dark feathers; neberis of several sizes carry strips of neberihide. One bird also carries a hide strip, and the intent podaling’s woven sack can contain both materials. These are exact stock items, not generic CARVE products. Take ingredients out of any sack before offering them. Current caps and legitimate stock govern availability.

SHAKE the thorny vine near the carved stone to clear the hidden way toward the farmer’s former wife’s shop; PUSH the vine on the shop side operates its own blocked exit when applicable. PULL the other tangled vines and crumbling stone controls along the swamp and ruins. Shared passages can already be open; some still need SEARCH and OPEN. Walking through one does not prove you operated its control.

The ruins’ fresco describes the crystal, Mystics and Skexis coming together when moon and sun align. Ahgra and the castle are wider Pharr Valley leads. The current local contracts do not restore the crystal, reunite the peoples or overthrow an emperor; those outcomes need deliberate builder integration.

A humble hermit elsewhere requests both a birdfeather headdress and a woven neberihide necklace for a recipe for a granular potion. That accepted request belongs to his own zone. Owning the ornaments here does not record either local craft or his hand-in, and supplied matching ornaments do not require your own earlier craft receipts.

The local shops, spell teachers, epic node, decorative blossoms, stranded travelers and creature stories are separate from the one shard request. Prices, existing accounting guards, shared access, hazards and scarce supply retain their native rules. The shard request is the only local potential daily; its availability depends on the actual giver and legitimate current shard supply.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore Torg's captive city through council secrets, legendary relics and the dwarven invasion. Each accepted delivery is a separate accomplishment; supplied materials can skip preparation.
orientation: Begin with Kordor and the Keeper for the hide and favor routes. The woman's token exchange supplies a rose for Zuzon; the jeweler accompanies Zarina.
The Colosseum's locked entrance answers to the spoken word carnage. The champion's medallion unlocks the upper council route before Zillra accepts it as an offering.
Zillra asks you to destroy the two promise rings. Zojt instead rewards delivery of both distinct rings; that is the recorded affair exchange.
The Lore Keeper accepts all eight distinct legendary relics together. His three Tranug commissions are separate and need neither the eight-relic delivery nor a recorded kill.
Timoro's death calls down the dwarven invasion force. Dranar and the accepting buckle craftsman arrive with that force; their availability depends on its actual arrival.
The legend scroll and Lanella's randomly created heart lead to quests outside Torg. A transformed scroll or a supplied heart does not establish a Torg achievement.

Optional curing, favor, rose and locket history explains preparation without blocking supplied terminal materials. Ask the contacts about the listed topics; learning a topic alone earns no achievement.

orientation: Start with Burbul: ask burbul hello, info, quest, or map. Look at the map to locate the guilds.
A letter of introduction can be exchanged for a teacher's starter equipment. These supply services are separate from their quests.
Try one local story: feed the hungry family; bring medicine to the grandmother; or recover Silva's stolen voice.
Explore with look, exits, and search. Some materials are hidden, carried by creatures, or inside containers. Current possession does not prove how you obtained an item.
The archway in the glowing temple leads to a hometown chosen by your race and class. Prepare before leaving Ailvio.

story_mappings.introduction: Return a lost ring, choose among Alorka’s four token crafts, trade a painting for fish, feed the goldfish and examine the leprechaun’s pot exchange. Exact materials and accepted outcomes stay distinct.
orientation: Two reciprocal Surface routes meet the dusty clearing29400: NORTH or EAST from the neighboring Surface hills enters Harrow. Main streets link crafts, shops, homes, gardens, the workshop, cave and lake. Terrain, visibility, existing doors and combat still apply; source locations do not guarantee safe access.

Ask the girl lost, ring or sad; ask Alorka treasure, craft or list; ask Bom fish, artsy, items or trade, or hi or hello. These twelve aliases select four response families. Seventeen qc_action messages are ambient scenes, not keyword achievements. MA/QA make responses visible to the room; they do not make requests automatic.

Return the hidden garden ring29405 for token29406. The girl departs. Each of Alorka’s four recipes consumes a fresh token plus two exact inputs. A supplied token works without your own ring receipt; an earlier receipt never restores a spent token or completes the other crafts.

Horn: stylish horn from the lonely bard plus hidden glass carried by Brwra. Robe: hidden tunnel silk plus the instructor’s worn simple robe. Wand: children’s scrap cloth plus a sleeping artist’s hidden doll. Sack: Lomya’s leather alchemist sack plus Torker’s faerie dust. Shop horns, cloth bolts, gallery paintings and other toys are different items.

The actual light reward is a wand, despite native sphere/staff wording. Lomya carries finite stock of the finished lucky sack in addition to producing its leather input. Buying or receiving the finished sack does not record Alorka’s craft. Hidden/worn proof and live stock need actual admission; no added source-kill, carving, learning or magical garden-belt requirement is inferred.

Bom on the lakeside29461 accepts the near-finished artists’ painting29440 and gives pike318, lobster319 and crab330. The colorful floor painting29433 does not fit. Fishing or eating the reward is separate; imported fish also support foreign recipes, which are not Harrow outcomes.

The fishbowl at29443 has an existing fixed ENTER route to29472. Fish food starts at29473 and29475; matching goldfish in29472–75 share one experience exchange. Return via the existing JUMP fishbowl object at29472. Water, arrival and portal rules remain native. The whale in29474 carries the pot of gold; possession does not prove defeating it.

The leprechaun’s lucky-star hub29477 connects to29478–81;29480 has a one-way return to main room29476. No ordinary incoming route or fixed incoming portal was identified. Plan access with a builder before inventing a key, luck, pipe, clover, random-travel prerequisite or new passage. His accepted recipe consumes the pot item, rewards clover and coins, and makes him depart.

The waterfall29469 has native fall/current metadata and a fixed ENTER waterfall route to altar29470; WEST returns to29469. story_mappings.introduction: Explore the grove's linked crafting stories: Striker's robes, Xaves' piwafwi and Valin's Mage Bane. Preparation services explain their ingredients; feeding the two birds is a separate pair of requests.
orientation: Use look and exits, and meet visible people to reveal their requests. The checklist shows current supplies and recorded exchanges; conversation alone earns no achievement.
From the Homestead pond, stare statue reaches the grove's large open branch. The Solonar statue on that branch returns to the Homestead. Arrival discovers only the zone actually reached.
Touch pedestal by the swallow returns to the western glades; stare circle by the hawk returns to the inner circle. The paired soot discs respond to tap disc and link the glades with the caverns.

In the merchant branches, stare at Sehanine's statue to reach the other side. Follow the elemental circle for the centaur's six different recipe ingredients. Hidden circle passages may need discovery and opening.

The Point's north passage responds to say arrow, then opening. The inner circle's locked south passage responds to say solonor; the hawk's circle offers another route. The centaur's hidden north passage is currently unlocked.
Enter opening from the northwestern path to approach the lich, or from the other northern path to approach the deep dragon. Examine the local exits and keep the return route in view.
High tree branches can cause falls. Flight or levitation can protect you; active climbing may catch a slip. Learning a password or taking a route is guidance here, not a recorded story stage.

Some recipes consume the same ingredients. Reserve separate orbs, buckskin, panther hides, raw golden thread and filament when pursuing several stories. Supplied ingredients qualify without personal acquisition history.
Valin and the miner roam from an area outside ordinary entry routes and can enter a holding room. Check whether they are present. The hawk's ordinary mouse-recovery route needs repair.

Diamond repair, arch-magi robes and the piwafwi include coin fees and are currently unavailable until mixed payments are supported. Other listed coin amounts are rewards. Preparation alone does not complete an equipment story.

story_mappings.introduction: Find the rusted key, free the chained dwarf and bring his shackles to the queen. This journal records the two accepted hand-ins. The separate good, evil and undead life paths are not recorded here. New progress requires active, ready accounting.
orientation: Travel north from the Surface hills into the foothills. The communal nest serves as a Harpy home and inn. Its sign advertises a destiny requirement for leaving, but that exit restriction is currently inactive.

Find the chained dwarf in his cave. To recover the hidden rusted key, ENTER the fixed hanging cage; DOWN returns from its interior. The other hanging cages are scenery: use the key as a hand-in to the dwarf rather than trying to unlock those props.

Give the exact rusted key to the dwarf to receive his prisoner shackles. He leaves after this exchange. A matching key supplied by another player also works. If the dwarf or key is absent, the route depends on their usual return and availability.

Bring the prisoner shackles to the queen in her nest. This earns her recognition; it does not choose the good life path. She accepts the native shackles hand-in while your race-war allegiance is neutral. Supplied matching shackles work without your own earlier dwarf hand-in.

The queen and khan have separate storm-crow-feather interactions that change a neutral character into a Harpy and choose the good or evil side. Those custom choices do not create a journal completion. Their GIVE handling can catch gifts addressed to another recipient in the same room, and characters who have already chosen a side cannot use their ordinary hand-ins.

Storm crows carry the hidden feather. It is ordinary carried stock, not a CARVE reward. Holding a feather, receiving one from another player and personally recovering it do not establish the same history. The khan feather route earns no achievement or daily credit in this journal.

In the crypt, ASK gargoyle undead reaches the response about two Harpy NPC corpses on the floor. The advertised word unlife does not reach that response. The advertised undead transformation is inactive: supplying two corpses does not currently complete it or earn a journal achievement.

PULL the fixed rope ladder to reach the wyvern nest; DOWN returns. CLIMB is a different command. The hidden wyvern egg belongs to a request from Wicks in Home of the Divine. Travel restrictions and falling hazards still apply.

Look for hidden golem plans inside the skeleton near the giant battle golem. OPEN the skeleton and remove the papers before offering them elsewhere. The skeleton is unlocked despite being resistant to picking. The nearby golem and the artifact described beneath rubble have no local quest outcome.

Foreign requests remain in their own journals: Wicks accepts the wyvern egg for 25,000 copper; the elderly engineer in Ultarium accepts the golem plans for a siege golem head; the dwarven trapper there accepts a gigasaur tail for two copper ores. A gigasaur carries the tail; CARVE is not its source. Holding these materials does not complete the foreign requests.

The merchant sells ordinary supplies. Merv redirects currency exchange inquiries to bank tellers. These services and the settlement’s nesting, mining and combat lore do not create additional quest achievements.

The dwarf rescue and queen’s recognition are potential daily requests. Availability still depends on the returning dwarf, current materials and the queen’s allegiance restrictions. Earlier completion never replaces shackles you have spent, lost or given away.

story_mappings.introduction: Help the witch gather useful beetle parts, choose among four potion crafts, and combine the red potion with an ancient signet and dragon scale for the ring ritual. Follow the expedition books as clues while keeping actual ingredients, accepted outcomes and the heartstone refusal distinct.
orientation: Go DOWN from the Khomani-Khan surface depression to the cliff landing, then follow the zigzag path down into the basin. The landing’s UP exit returns to the surface. Old city/Nizari prose is a clue mismatch: the actual boundary is to the surface. The witch and the elixir-bearing minotaur start at the basin entrance.

Ask witch greetings or welcome for the helpful opening, then help, search, components, ring or signet. Hello, hi and howdy receive a different response. The six response families have fourteen aliases; each keyword reveals a response, not another quest achievement.

The witch makes four distinct potions from a dark-magic elixir plus one exact beetle part. The elixir starts hidden on one minotaur lizard beside her. Give the elixir to choose crafting while carrying only the intended part kind loose: gland makes red, mandible brown, shell white and horn spotted white. Giving a part chooses its cash sale even if you also carry the elixir.

The four part sales pay the same native 25,000 coin amount and form one journal outcome. Any one exact shell, mandible, gland or horn fits. Each sold copy is consumed and cannot also be used for a potion. A minotaur or beetle name alone does not guarantee that reset instance carries its component.

The ring ritual needs the exact glowing red potion, ancient signet and smoldering scale together. Sakaslan carries the hidden scale in the swamp; Aberden’s fixed corpse holds the signet. The red potion is the gland craft reward. Matching supplied ingredients need no personal earlier craft, mage kill, dragon kill or expedition reading history.

Six fixed corpse containers hold the distinct expedition books: Michith near the oasis description, Cyril by the western wall, Tomak in the swamp, Gordas on the wastes, Aberden in the swamp and Milton at the cave dead end. They start open, not locked. SEARCH the named container to reveal hidden contents, recover the book and READ its descriptions. Reading reveals native prose but currently records no durable learned-clue milestone.

Milton’s partially ruined book includes separate passage1, passage2 and passage3 descriptions. These explain the doomed search for the Crystal City. The cave’s final room explicitly has no door or portal onward. Its spider blocks EAST, the only ordinary way back; neither the journal nor lore creates a new exit or removes the blocker.

The pool’s actual fixed water source is in a wastes room, separate from the room titled Oasis that holds Michith’s corpse. The pool attracts many vermin, but its fire beetle has no gland reset. Ordinary water, combat, staff use, potion drinking, armor and diary reading are supporting activities, not additional accepted quest outcomes.

Sakaslan’s heartstone, imported black skull and smoldering scale are three distinct prototypes. The witch refuses the heartstone through a same-kind replacement recipe, with no achievement or daily. Do not offer it for the ring or assume the original object identity, custody or enhancements survive that exchange.

Current loose inputs, earlier accepted receipts, source recovery, gifts, reading, access, combat and actual rewards remain separate. An old potion receipt cannot restore a consumed elixir or potion. The cap-one elixir/signature sources and live reset/accounting admission still govern availability; static daily candidates do not prove renewable supply.

Discovery has its own achievement; meeting the witch reveals the seven cards. All new discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit requires active, ready accounting, with frozen reward recovery separate. No native recipe, reset, blocker, item flags, portal or PvP mobility change is enabled here.

story_mappings.introduction: Longhollow is under siege while a protected temple, woodland campsite and witch's shrine offer separate routes. The mayor's five-proof delivery leads to a physical bracer for Solar. The witch's potion and poison experiments have independent intermediate hand-ins and distinct physical-output finales. Clothing services and scene lore remain separate.
orientation: Follow the forest path into the tall grass. The campsite beside the brook holds the trapper and traders; the stone shrine holds the witch. Trampled grass leads southeast to the ruined parish, its enemy leaders and Selune's temple.

Speak to the mayor in the clearing north of the parish. His proof set contains five distinct heads: the Bloodied Knight, necromancer, Fomorian chieftain, enchantress and dark priest. One head kind cannot replace another. The proof items are chance-loaded carried stock, not a reviewed personal-death achievement.

The knight and captive wife are upstairs in the mansion; the necromancer is at the burning stable and the dark priest chants in Market Square. The hidden briar route west of the grass leads through rock paths and a boulder entrance to the chieftain and enchantress in the caverns. Listed panels and doors reset open; no magical belt or glove gate is implemented here.

The mayor awards both the Longhollow bracer and an exquisite moonstone. Solar in Selune's inner sanctum accepts only the physical bracer for a star woven symbol, then disappears. Earlier mayor history is optional; a supplied bracer qualifies, while a moonstone or a spent-bracer receipt does not.

The witch narrates potion recipes in order, but each exact hand-in matches independently. Keep the distinct red, green and bubbling vials for the mist combination with the blood drop. The bubbling-vial recipe also rewards 25,000 copper through the supported native reward path; it charges no fee. Supplied exact outputs can feed the later recipe without producer history.

For the poison branch, two venom sacs plus mandrake produce a filled root; lotus, nightshade and red mushroom produce a filled head. Both prepared outputs plus the exact loose Kiss of Talona bloom complete the final blend. The nearby rooted vine is scenery, and the finished leaf's advertised poison behavior needs content review.

The trapper makes caps, boots, scarves, cloaks and a rare five-material headdress. Native boots cost 20 gold despite dialogue saying 15. Paid clothing is currently unavailable under active accounting. Four snake skins, two fox furs and two venom sacs exceed their respective ordinary cap-one supply; availability needs repair rather than a promise to wait for another reset.

Stock may be missing or carried by other players, and native NPCs may wander. Harv's shop remains implemented behind the alley panel despite his packing dialogue. Temple survivors, the captive wife, decorative corpses and Rolane's empty quest placeholder have no reviewed rescue, recovery or siege-ending completion.

Carry every offering directly, outside equipment or containers. Exact current supplies show readiness; an accounting-backed delivery records that hand-in once. Questions, optional producer receipts and printed promises do not confirm a personal kill, all-stage campaign, learned spell, title flag, rescue or applied item effect.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore Newhaven's living streets and their corrupted counterpart. The blacksmith's loss connects the rift to a real recovery request; berries and lost tobacco have separate deliveries. Equipment and the mismatched pipe trade remain services. The rift, librarian and prisoner have unfinished lore. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: Enter from the Tharnadia Highway and meet the living blacksmith, baker, armorer and plump Dibbly. Only the blacksmith and armorer have addressed quest topics. Ambient messages elsewhere explain leads without learned-keyword achievements.

The tear in reality on Newhaven Way leads to the ruined city. Its southern street also returns toward Newhaven Way. The two cities have separate NPC prototypes; killing a counterpart does not transform the living citizen or end the curse.

Search the decaying armory for the zombie assistant carrying the blacksmith's mummified wife. Return the remains to the living blacksmith for 50,000 XP. That accepted delivery answers his loss without resurrecting her or closing the rift.

Newhaven blackberries have ground declarations in the ruined bakery and a northern ruined Rapture Way dead end. Bring one bunch to the living baker for 18,000 XP. Both locations share a live cap of two; the spectre does not accept the delivery.

Recover the ground tobacco pouch in the ruined general store for the living Dibbly's 3,500-copper reward. An erinyes can appear there on a separate 25-percent reset; her death is not required by the exchange.

Dibbly asks for fishing line but his other current binding consumes a snorkel pipe for 5,000 copper. The actual reel has a different item identity. Read this trade as a support service until its intended recipe is resolved; it does not craft a fishing rod.

The armorer offers two dark-circle badges with different fees and rewards, a lizard-tail bracer and a displacer-hide cloak. Exact current material checks help preparation; paid offerings remain unavailable with active accounting until supported settlement. One circle cannot satisfy both badge recipes.

The tail stock belongs only to one small-lizard appearance in the northern ruined Rapture Way dead end. The displacer skin is carried by a beast that starts in a mainland forest distribution room and can wander through several woodland exits. These sources are not general animal harvesting rules.

Enter the waterfall beside the living gate to visit Vulgaris's damp cave. Read its sign for the frayed Khomani-Khan collar, Mixt's heart and 100,000 copper recipe. Supplied materials qualify; the fee still requires supported accounting settlement.

Touch the library painting in each city's scribing room to enter that city's library. Ordinary paths out remain in the same city. Both Evelosi appearances and the erinyes provide lore, but no implemented investigation, confession or rift-closure outcome exists.

The living and ruined Artos each carry a black CELL key. Both locked cells use it. The chained Dibbly asks for death, but opening his door, killing him or paying the living merchant does not record a rescue. Key access is a useful route, without a current quest endpoint.

The living sewer grate leads to western mainland forest; its ruined counterpart leads to eastern hills. Fountain and statue signs explain local law and faith without accepted-action objectives. Rent at the ruined inn uses shared inn rules; it is not the living innkeeper's quest.

Current items and an optional earlier Fisherman's Wharf receipt explain preparation. Gifts remain valid inputs; possession does not prove recovery, a kill or harvest. Completion follows an accepted terminal exchange, and active source generation still needs qualification.

story_mappings.introduction: Follow the missing platinum horns from a prisoner’s clue to the lieutenant’s reward. The adventurer’s purchase route is currently unavailable with active accounting; supplied matching horns still fit the supported return exchange.
orientation: Enter from the Narrow Lava Tube in Mountain Tracts (21148), heading SOUTH to the cave entrance (35501). NORTH returns to the tube. The crawlway leads to the Lake of Fire, then dark tunnels, a wooden bridge, the training grounds and the keep. Doors, darkness, confined rooms, fire terrain and hostile inhabitants affect the route.

Ask the gnome prisoner tresure or secret; ask the lieutenant person or horns; ask the adventurer horns or horn. These six existing keywords select four responses, not six achievements. Keep the actual spelling tresure when asking for that clue.

The prisoner points toward horns hidden on the lake, but no matching horns are placed on the floor or carried by a reset mobile. The adventurer’s coin exchange is their only identified native producer. His description of waving a horn does not guarantee that he carries one you can loot.

The adventurer starts in a room with no ordinary incoming route. He can wander WEST onto the lake or EAST into a room with no exits. Look for the actual wandering NPC; this journal does not promise he will always appear or add a route into his spawn rooms.

Buying the horns is currently unavailable with active accounting and is excluded from achievements and dailies. The configured exchange charges 100 platinum in equivalent coin value, although his dialogue says 1,500 platinum. Do not rely on that old quoted price or send payment expecting this blocked route to work.

The lieutenant in office 35628 accepts the exact pair of platinum horns for a golden wrist chain and 50,000 configured experience, subject to the game’s reward rules. Matching horns supplied by another player fit without your own purchase record or a personal thief-kill record. The exchange consumes the horns; an old purchase record cannot replace them.

The prison gate EAST from 35620 starts closed and locked. The gatekeeper carries the heavy iron key in the native reset data; actual live stock can differ. Picking remains another option if your skills and tools permit it. Unlocking, opening the door and reaching the office are separate from returning the horns.

The training gate between 35580 and 35582 resets open. The rare black onyx key associated with the instructor is not a mandatory first step for that route. The instructor’s barracks and the keep entrance have hidden doors; reveal and open them under the game’s existing rules.

If the cracked wall is present on the lake at 35537, PUSH wall clears the blocked WEST route toward the dwarven mine. You still need to OPEN the closed passage. The wall stays stationary. Clearing it is not a horn acquisition, a recorded quest completion or proof that you entered the mine.

The lake is elemental-fire terrain even where prose calls it not altogether dangerous. Ordinary protect-fire spells can be stripped by that heat. Do not infer safety, flight or immunity from a room title. The journal does not record a personal survival or fire-protection objective.

The alchemist’s potions, library sentries, training instructor, prisoners and miners have no additional local accepted quest endpoint or identified shop/lesson binding. The prisoners’ suffering does not implement rescue, escort or release steps. A potion or worn reward is not evidence of completing the horns exchange.

story_mappings.introduction: Follow the lord’s four independent offerings and prepare exact potions with the frail man below the village inn. Distinguish the hidden materials, consumed recipe, separate keys and unresolved blue-horn supply before following the larger dragon prophecy.
orientation: The lord accepts four independent offerings: blue-tinged horn, granular potion, small black gem and small dragon tooth. The frail man’s four potion recipes are supporting services; asked keywords and ambient actions do not each award an achievement.

The little-used road connects Cheltenham to the wider Surface. Follow Chiltern Way to the village square; west from its northern part is the Apples and Wheat Inn. Go south to the common room, west to the taproom, north to the kitchen, down through the stores and dark stair, then west to the frail man’s laboratory.

Granular preparation needs sand and the recipe scroll together and consumes both for three potions. The water dragon at the end of the inn’s underwater passage wears the hidden sand. The foreign humble hermit trades a woven neberihide necklace and birdfeather headdress together for the recipe; supplied exact materials can skip those earlier routes.

The hunched podaling’s paid headdress and necklace preparation and Carmotee’s epic smelt purchase are currently unavailable while accounting is active. An exact supplied recipe remains valid for the frail man. Earlier receipts explain preparation without replacing present materials or proving personal recovery.

The tiny waterfall on the plateau is a separate route: look behind it and take the open downward passage into the mines; no SEARCH is required for this entrance. The crystal dragon carries the frost recipe’s white horn and the onyx dragon carries an unrelated blackened horn. The sapphire dragon does not currently carry the lord’s blue-tinged horn; its exact supply route remains unresolved.

In the castle, the lord is in the audience chamber south of the main hall junction. The western hallway leads to the locked spiral stair. Only one of its six guards carries the onyx key. It breaks on ordinary successful unlocking; upstairs past the library, the lich carries the black gem.

The lord’s black-gem reward opens the hidden eastern catacomb gate beyond the neglected tunnels. Reach those tunnels through the prison’s hidden northern stair. At the prison entrance one golem carries the decayed portal key and the other wields the protective recipe’s curved rod. The decayed key breaks on ordinary successful unlocking; the golden catacomb key survives.

The spectral warrior carries the small tooth in the catacombs. A supplied tooth skips the gem-and-key route. The lord’s tooth key fits the locked foreign black-marble gate beyond his southern hallway and breaks on ordinary successful unlocking. Crossing that boundary and defeating a dragon need their own facts.

Search the hiding place east along the shrubs north of the wheat fields for the exact white flower. The pink flowers described on the shrubs do not substitute, and no gardener belt is required. T’Sharenoa’s delicate iron wand also does not substitute for the curved golem rod.

The plaque and lord’s prophecy explain the dragon threat. Drawbridge chains, collapsing-bridge warnings, spoken prison wards, healing-water lore and the gnome’s notebook are not additional accepted quest outcomes in the current map. No prison rescue, campaign victory or potion use is inferred from an offering.

Carry exact offering materials loose. Worn, nested, spent and handed-away copies remain missing; supplied copies need no personal source kill. Only accepted exact exchanges record outcomes. All new discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit requires active, ready accounting; frozen reward recovery remains separate.

story_mappings.introduction: Meet the people of Werrun and explore the hidden mirror passage to its dark counterpart. Four independent requests connect the village to the Library of Doom and Lady Death. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting.
orientation: Malfun lives upstairs in his home; the former mage shopkeeper starts in the magic shop; the stable owner starts at the village stables. The old githzerai traveller has a load route into the cottage bar, but can instead be trapped away from public routes or depart after his request. Contacts can move. ASK the listed topics for native replies; each keyword is not an achievement.

Malfun tells of leaving Verspin, trading toward Fort Marigot and losing Lady Sklera after a troll attack in the Twisted Woods. Ask about wife, trouble and task for his keepsake request, or book and revan for his separate reading request. Neither tale requires a recorded visit to those other places.

A bush at the southern village approach hides the westward route to an abandoned shack. PUSH bush to clear that blocked passage, then explore the shack. STARE mirror at the broken mirror leads to a second shack beside the dark Werrun; its perfect mirror leads back. Looking at a mirror is different from the native STARE action. Shared-open routes do not prove you opened them.

The dark village has a bone bridge, blood river, wasteland trail, sinister inhabitants and the Temple of Night. Its Library of Doom holds both the old book by Revan and the large book by Vewon Etsh. These are different exact items for different recipients. Recovering either is current preparation, not proof of reading, personal travel or accepted delivery.

Bring the old book by Revan to Malfun for coins and a small white key. The key fits the desk in Malfun's library; the desk contains a black scroll of flight and a blue scroll of venom. His recollection of four colored scrolls is broader than the two currently placed there. The key is a reward and access tool, not another accepted quest step.

Lady Death in the dark village wears the sacred braid of Lady Sklera and has two demon bodyguards. Bring that exact braid to Malfun for the silver ring of honor. His mourning reply does not prove your own Lady Death kill or establish a recorded transformation of his wife. Exact supplied braid stock fits the request.

Ask the mage about werrun, help and money for his debt. The native offering is 350 platinum, or 350000 copper-value coins, for a magical blue sack. This coin-only turn-in is currently unavailable while accounting is active. Keep it visible as an explained, blocked story; there is no recorded reopening of his shop or settlement with Malfun.

Ask the old githzerai traveller about vewon, then bring the large book by Vewon Etsh for tight blue sandals and the native experience reward. He departs on acceptance. Actual experience remains subject to native caps and recipient rules; the journal records acceptance separately from later reward recovery. The small metal key he initially carries fits two storage crates; the ordinary storage crate holds vigor potions, while the dark corpse-storage crate has no placed potion stock.

The skull-shaped key carried by the barbaric official fits the locked nightmare stable in dark Werrun. The stable owner's free-horse offer, ordinary supplies, keys, potions, nightmares and other equipment are supporting world interactions; the four accepted requests do not require personal riding, shopping or key use.

The strong bartender in the cottage bar offers generated world quests: ask about quest, map, abandon or resign, and use quest to review an assigned task. story_mappings.introduction: Follow Valois’s family-seal requests, the dwarf’s crafting models, the wine-to-dinner delivery, Madam Oakencrest’s two flower gifts and the ambassador’s overdue note. Each card distinguishes current proof from an accepted outcome.
orientation: The active Surface plain leads NORTH to Valois’s dusty road38575; SOUTH returns to the Surface. Roads lead toward the castle, royal shops, three inhabited estates and the old tavern. Native gates, guards and terrain still apply; source locations do not promise safe access.

Ask King Ulgris hi, king or quest. Ask the hearty dwarf hi, quest, dwarf, old, hearty or mountain; the stealthy figure hi, shadowy, figure, dark, assassin or king; the bakery cook hi, quest, cook, bakery or wine; the elven ambassador hi, quest, note, elven, ambassador or porter. These are five response families with twenty-six aliases, not twenty-six achievements.

The king’s family-seal bundle uses Oakencrest, Du’kel and Berani, each a distinct item. The assassin’s bundle uses the prince and princess, also distinct. Seal and ring names do not prove personal kills. A matching gift can satisfy a hand-in without proving you recovered it from the named person.

The dwarf wants four crafting models together: mace, polearm, sleeves and leggings. Royal guards following the chamberlain wield maces; patrolling pikemen wield polearms; the royal smiths carry models too. The dwarf gives one leggings reward and departs. Native stock/caps and actual recipient renewal determine whether another attempt is available.

The vineyard keeper’s key opens the pickproof cellar door DOWN from38525 to38526. It breaks on a successful unlock. SEARCH for the hidden quest wine in the cellar, then take the exact bottle to the bakery cook38551. His dinner plate goes to Queen Napolia in the third-floor dining room38475 for the royal token. Wine possession, a cook receipt, current plate and queen receipt remain separate.

The beautiful roses start in Du’kel’s courtyard38495 beyond the exterior keyed gate; its crimson key comes from a loyal swordsman at38484. The white rose starts worn by a former soldier in Oakencrest’s courtyard38534. Madam Oakencrest on balcony38546 accepts these as two separate gift exchanges. No magical garden belt or extra relationship scene is inferred.

The castle has public and private gardens and secret UP/DOWN ladder pairs to royal balconies. Their native reset state is secret, closed and unlocked; the ordinary garden doors are closed, not a new magical quest barrier. Finding or seeing an open ladder or another player’s unlocked gate does not record your own access action.

The elven ambassador waits in38451 while the red porter carries the exact note in38454. Read its description if useful, but the native exchange does not check personal reading or language knowledge. Other ambassadors’ trade, the king’s wider politics and the monk’s library are supporting stories without authored accepted endpoints.

F resets load the chamberlain’s royal guards and replace the current item holder for subsequent equipment. No local teleport or switch prototype is present. The Wailing Griffon room flag registers the shared inn handler even though there is no literal local assignment. The swordsman’s _spec1_ keyword selects class specialization; it is not a quest gate procedure.

Fifteen Veralis Mansion rooms have explicit unfinished descriptions and no connection to the main local road component. Two banquet rooms form another isolated component. These are builder review items, not new passages or completion requirements. The mere existence of unplaced mobile prototypes does not authorize spawning them.

All eight native exchanges have exact input, reward and acceptance identities. Current loose proof, gifts, source recovery, addressed dialogue, reading, keyed access, combat and accepted receipts are different facts. The optional cook history never blocks a matching supplied dinner plate or restores a consumed one.

Static daily candidates require actual material, stock and recipient renewal under native mode1. All new discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit requires active, ready accounting; frozen recovery stays separate. No native zone/quest repair, pickup, key, route, shop or mobility change ships.

story_mappings.introduction: Follow Pharr Valley's misplaced chest clues and the mountain farmer's two independent requests. Current materials prepare a request; accepted offerings record completion. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting.
orientation: ASK curator about key, chest, farmers or grandpod for the valley's misplaced chest and the old farmer. The curator offers lore and directions. You can meet the farmer and prepare either request without first speaking to the curator or recovering the chest's clue.

The display case in the Hall of Everything starts closed and unlocked. Its small key fits the small chest in the valley storage shed. The chest starts closed and locked but permits native picking attempts; an already opened chest or a supplied matching key can also fit. Its paper wad points to the old farmer. Reading that clue gives context without another completion receipt.

ASK farmer about chest, contents, scroll or where for the promised scroll's story, then about apple, orange, gartham or types for his requests. Dialogue keywords explain the story without awarding separate achievements. The curator may wander from the hall; the farmer waits on a mountain peak until he leaves after an accepted provision bundle.

For the provision bundle, carry one exact apple, one exact orange and one exact crow's nest loose together. Offer one of these materials to the available farmer to submit the whole bundle. Corn, peapods, the paper wad, an ordinary book or a carapace do not replace its three requested items.

Exact apples and oranges have limited stock in the valley fields. Exact crow's nests have stock on mountain and field floors and in scarecrows; remove a nest from its parent container to carry it loose. Open the nest and remove any contents you want to keep before offering it. Eating fruit spends it as food and does not complete the request.

The provision request grants experience and makes the farmer leave. His acceptance speech describes a parchment scroll and mentions a book and carapace, but this request declares the apple, orange and crow's nest as its inputs and experience as its only reward. The journal follows those actual declarations; a scroll's delivery and a completed Skexis history remain unresolved.

The second request accepts one exact gartham carapace for experience and leaves the farmer present. Its declared stock is carried by the gartham leader in the caves. The farmer's dialogue points to a soldier, so investigate the leader's actual stock rather than expecting every soldier to supply this shell. A supplied exact carapace can fit without a personal kill.

The carapace and provision requests are independent. Turning in the carapace first can preserve the current farmer for the bundle; turning in the bundle first makes him leave, so another request needs a fresh available farmer. Completion of one does not record or require completion of the other.

PUSH rock at the large flat rock on the road to clear its blocked eastern passage into the tunnels when the rock is available and the passage is blocked. Actual passage state is shared: another player's opening may already let you through. Valley fences and house doors start closed and unlocked. Mountain and cave movement retains native hazards, including falls at the narrow cave ledge and giant spider nest.

Follow actual paths between the mountains, fields, valley town and caves. The Rocky Trail connects to the valley and the eastern mountain route connects to Pharr Valley Swamp; discovering and completing another zone remains separate. Pirate crews and treasure in ships use their own runtime locations and availability, even though their prototypes share these area files.

Carry current exact materials loose to see preparation. Gifts can fit without personal retrieval, chest access, learned dialogue or combat history. Worn, held, nested, eaten or handed-away materials do not supply current loose custody. Limited stock, native reset timing and other players affect availability; potential daily eligibility does not guarantee a fresh attempt. New credit requires active, ready accounting.

story_mappings.introduction: Investigate a missing adventurer beneath the fortress inn, recover three royal proofs and release captives. Nine independent outcomes sit beside seven support exchanges. Optional sources and history explain a journey without requiring personal recovery. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The fortress has a surface approach and an Underdark tunnel entrance. Discovery opens this journal; stories and named contacts still depend on physical encounters. Administrative access is not an ordinary player entrance.

A stolen silver chalice earns an inn-bed clue. The inn also has addressed conversation about a barbarian moving a bed. These are alternate information leads, without an enforced briefing or learned-keyword achievement.

Shoving the inn sleeping-room bed clears its blocked secret downward route. A boulder below operates the upward return. Search and ordinary door state remain separate actions; neither successful access nor travel is recorded as quest history yet.

An adventurer corpse before the underground waterfall contains the bloodstained note and salt-water vials. This preplaced container is different from an actor death witnessed by the player. Taking or reading its contents alone does not finish a request.

The bloodstained-note delivery and three-proof royal finale are independent outcomes. The final proof set is an exact head, balanced longsword and gold hair pin. Supplied materials fit without a briefing, personal kill, full crafting chain or recorded escort.

The goblin leader carries a small silver key used by a locked chest and two captives. One rescue returns a replacement key with experience; the other consumes it for a gold hair pin. Check current custody before each delivery; a receipt is not another key.
A separate beaten prisoner wants the set of cell keys. This rescue also returns replacement keys with experience. Both key-return rescues count for zone progress and are not offered as daily quests.

The trainer's proof uses the decorated goblin totem and dark amulet, producing the balanced longsword. A crafted bullywug totem, ordinary goblin sword or earthen statue cannot substitute. Delivering the proof does not establish a personal kill.

A support chain runs from two distinct hides and a fee to a statue, then gourd plus statue and another fee to a totem, ring, buckler, rod and dark amulet. The two mixed-fee services remain guarded under active accounting; supplied later materials can still support independent deliveries.

A separate feather-headband service requires exact peryton feathers, gorilla hide and a fee. The relevant animals are captive locally despite distant homeland dialogue. This mixed service is guarded and creates no quest achievement.

The captain's strange note and the corpse's bloodstained note are different kinds. The strange-note delivery gives a hidden-shop key; the captain separately accepts a hemp necklace and peace pipe for fifty platinum. Direction dialogue does not create the carried note.

The underwater treasure chest is a push-operated switch rather than loot storage. It reveals a diagonal passage with an Underdark connection. Boulders at that tunnel currently target an already-open east route, so their shove action has no effect.

A mysterious key carried by the goblin shaman opens the concealed pool/platform connection. Standing at either blue-chalk inscription teleports between the platform and a spy chamber beside the royal room; the configured portals have unlimited charges. Destination and accepted travel still need live qualification.

Ordinary shops, room rental, teaching and a special sword's pegasus call follow their own rules. Other prisoners, animal cages and captive-centaur lore have no additional accepted rescue contracts here. Departure prose does not prove arrival home, invasion or settlement clearance.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore the mist, elemental shrines, titan palace and cloud camps. Twenty independent deliveries cover the siren, seven bounty proofs, nine treasures, the competing titan token and Pure-Dark. Twelve preparation/access services explain the longer routes. Active, ready accounting is required; missing reward, guarded fees and source/access qualification remain explicit.
orientation: The mountain peak reaches the outside portal room. Enter the local arrival portal to reach the mist; the reciprocal arrival portal returns outside. Enter Shiva's pool for the icy cloud, touch the palace loom for the prison corridor, and enter the fiery cave portal for the foreign Great Below. These are real item teleport routes; knowing a clue or carrying a key does not prove successful travel.

One nexus cloud buys the wispy palace key. One giant badge buys the cloudy prison key, which opens both locked cells beyond the loom passage. These two access services do not award achievements. The named prison key is not the palace key or Raith's blood-red eyepiece, and neither key receipt proves freeing a giant.

The siren accepts four distinct elemental tokens together, gives dress and harp, then vanishes. The shrine chancellors wear the tokens. One accepted bundle owns the outcome; it does not require four personal kills or confirm peace for the sisters.

The hunter accepts seven different hearts independently, including Sealot's foreign heart. Delivery proof is not a recorded personal kill. The Relazier heart request names a reward absent from current world data and needs repair before a safe attempt; material readiness cannot certify payout. Rare holding sources may wander and do not guarantee encounter or repeatable availability.

Wicks has nine independent cash-reward curiosity requests. Distinguish the local single golden horseshoe from Moria's full set, the Harpy Heights wyvern egg from the exotic surface egg, and a smoke egg from both. Ivory, feather and disc are container contents; the horseshoe, bone statue and smoke egg are ground declarations. Recovery and falls need separate care.

The shared Riser mace feeds fire or frost crafting. Fire needs the prison demon's trapped claw; frost needs an icicle reached through Shiva's pool. Each mace plus its own mist shard and 50000 copper becomes a different longsword. Both swords plus the generic dragon scale and 200000 copper make Dusk and Dawn. Starting from Riser requires two maces, two shards and 300000 copper; one-copy source caps and mode-one empty-zone resets prevent a promise of fresh same-visit supply.

Six item-and-coin crafting recipes remain guarded with accounting active. The generic dragon scale's automatic death source is also disabled under active accounting. Support receipts cannot pay fees or replace consumed inputs, and no all-stage crafting achievement is inferred. Item-only crafting services remain distinct from the twenty quest outcomes.

Emition also turns the foreign electrum chunk into the first angelic flute. Return it to Whetstone in the Airship Graveyard for his separate outcome and a different same-named flute. Reln's jade warsuit needs the foreign jade wyrmscale and 10000000 copper; local celestial/smoke scales and generic dragon scale are distinct.

Leolan and Raith both accept the same titan token in independent exchanges. One physical token is consumed by one recipient; earlier history or allegiance does not produce a replacement. Raith's eyepiece is equipment and is not a requirement for the fiery portal. The native recipes do not enforce a good/evil campaign branch.

Relazier accepts foreign Pure-Dark for Purelight and retires, which can remove the bounty heart he carries. These independent outcomes need a deliberate episode/branch policy before becoming a personal campaign. Departure text does not record a returned warlock, royal power drain, released prisoners, invasion or war victory.

Ordinary Emition shop/forge and Snent encrust teaching have shared bindings and separate accounting/actor requirements. No additional custom local quest terminal is bound. Dialogue remains useful guidance; each keyword, source encounter, trap, door, teleport, kill or container inspection needs accepted evidence before it can become its own tracked objective.

story_mappings.introduction: Discover Tribal Forest and follow the hunter-to-bluebird grain route, the separate small-meat nest, the wife’s four-item escape, the lost comb, the shaman’s two independent commissions, Xazapath’s five scattered parts and the Spider Queen’s missing egg. Actual source, key, switch, trap and travel clues guide preparation; each accepted exchange remains its own named outcome.
orientation: Active, ready accounting is required for discovery, visible NPC encounters, journals and new achievement/daily credit. First discovery is its own achievement. Reading hints, carrying materials and asking ordinary keywords award no credit.

Enter through the cave at 42281, joined to three surface hill rooms. The apprentice’s STARE mirror returns to this cave. The cellar’s ENTER pentagram leads to a local Astral junction, with a returning black rift and six outward Astral exits; these are travel routes, not accepted quest completions.

The hunter’s larger-meat exchange produces oat grain for the huge bluebird’s staff. The bird separately accepts small meat for a nest, but refuses larger meat. The refusal returns the same prototype kind through native exchange settlement; it is excluded from named outcomes and dailies. Do not equate a same-kind output with the same physical item UID.

Some recipients and sources begin in loading rooms or follow another actor. Bluebird, larger worm and Xazapath staging routes rely on actual wandering, not a guaranteed immediate placement. Starting rooms, reset comments and nominal probabilities do not certify a currently reachable actor or item.

The kitchen lock uses the chieftain’s bluish key, which can break on normal unlock and is also consumed in the wife’s four-item offering. Recover shoes, skirt and blanket from the secret closet or other exact declared sources. Shared doors or supplied material fit without a personal chief kill, shackles action or escort.

The beautiful comb is on the huge brown spider; spotted deerskin is on a specific deer. The shaman’s second recipe needs five different material kinds and no earlier deerskin receipt. The lookout’s crystal is held, the runed bone is inside an unlocked bone pile, and F gives the horn, root and egg to their actual following owners.

PUSH the named vegetation or leaves to address their configured blocked exits. STOMP the weak web floor after entering the web in the forest glade to reach the tunnels. PUSH the tunnel boulder to approach Xazapath’s apartment. The shared switch clears the blocked state; secret discovery and other door state remain separate.

The red cellar key is inside the shelf in the shaman’s hut and can break on normal unlock. The yellow bone key comes from the dracolizard and always breaks on normal unlock to the back treasure room. Neither key is required by the shaman’s five-material offering; an available key is not proof of the associated passage.

Xazapath requires five different secret ground parts in separate underground rooms; two left hands cannot replace a right hand. The Spider Queen’s exact missing egg is on the second ancient tree above ground, not a spider, the bluebird nest or the descriptive egg pile in her room.

The fixed amethyst orb has RUB destination selection, STARE or GLANCE viewing and TOUCH travel or burning with HP loss. Its target is a runtime room index, not a native quest receipt. The apprentice mirror uses STARE for direct travel instead; match the actual targeted object and committed arrival before recording any future access objective.

Tree branches, tight trunks, no-ground falls, poisonous-ivy combat and the well have real movement or hazard constraints. Grove lore describes magic excluding humans, but the reviewed local bindings and room flags do not establish a dedicated racial gate. The narrator’s claim is not an enforced prerequisite or recorded achievement.

All nine meaningful exchanges retain native daily shape, including wife and drow retirement under reset mode one. Current recipients, reachable supply, perception, traps, difficulty, shared scarcity and renewal need qualification before assignment. Active accounting refuses legacy item resets without admitted generation.

The runed bone uses unsupported trap damage code 9 and the ring of destruction code 10. The shared handler can spend their charge without a matching payload branch; attempted pickup is still separate from recovery. Builder intent must choose supported effects before a native repair. Leaf and other narrative direction discrepancies remain separate review findings.

Supplied matching loose items fit the native recipes. Optional producer receipts cannot replace spent grain, keys, clothing, body parts or crystal ingredients. The wife’s and Xazapath’s native departures do not establish an escorted journey, deity forgiveness, title or global forest-campaign terminal.
