story_mappings.introduction: Explore Yerdonia's cavern maze, learn the Yerdons' story and choose among ten independent native requests. Exact offerings and accepted receipts determine progress. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting.
orientation: ASK drustl about raxthan, quest, head or enslaver for the tribe's history, and drusto, jasmona, son or daughter for his family request. ASK dravkult about raxthan, graskal or noctule for the wider conflict. These are independent turn-ins; conversation and each keyword are not separate achievements.

Drustl accepts either Raxthan's head for serpentine leggings or his lost slime-covered arrow head for an earring. He leaves after either accepted request. Completing one does not unlock the other; a fresh available Drustl is needed for the second. The arrow head is carried by the slime-speckled slug accompanying the giant slug, not by Drustl or every slug.

Dravkult asks for Graskal's head and Noctule's black heart together. Some of his replies say two heads, but the accepted offering needs the heart. Raxthan carries his own head, and Noctule follows him and carries the heart. These are separate objects and requests, without a mandatory Drustl-before-Dravkult order.

T'rin also accepts Noctule's heart, paired with a Malstrog Bloodbeast heart. One copy of Noctule's heart can prepare either her request or Dravkult's, but it cannot be consumed for both. The Bloodbeast heart also has a separate use with Ravi Bjornson in Alatorin. Choose where to spend each copy; foreign acceptance does not finish a local request.

ASK rethorn about morklar or scales for his revenge and crafting request. Morklar carries large serpent scales and a different black heart. Only the exact scales fit Rethorn's offering. Epolon asks for Elytron's head and a giant zvorgast fang; ordinary zvorgasts and the other named hearts do not substitute.

ASK drasklor about darthus for his request. Darthus wields the spine that Drasklor accepts for a serpentine seal of Bozk. The seal is a reward, not an access key. Drasklor's hints about bones, searching, touching and gazing provide guidance; they do not declare an additional accepted puzzle or a requirement to wear the badge.

In the rock-filled room, TOUCH baphomet operates the wall symbol and clears the blocked northern passage toward the marble chamber. The return rock is an ordinary initially closed, unlocked door; OPEN follows native rules. The other symbol targets that return side and has nothing to clear while it is unblocked. A passage already opened by someone else remains usable without your own switch history.

The slab between the dismal cave and Raxthan's dark hall starts closed and unlocked on both sides. Its hidden-looking description does not itself make SEARCH mandatory. Follow the actual door and movement state. Dark caverns, bone-lined routes, the swamp, slug lair and bloody shaft retain their native travel, fall, breathing, combat and PvP restrictions.

Several downward routes have native fall chances. Flying, levitation, climbing, door state and actual arrival affect the journey. Falling into a room, seeing a route or reaching a named creature does not by itself prove a personal kill, source recovery, switch activation or accepted quest.

Trosat needs one strange mushroom from the orcish slave merchant's gnomeskin backpack. These differ from common cave shrooms and the dealer's other fungi. Grobklarn needs three exact cave shrooms for his ritual, offered together. Loose supplied mushrooms also fit; one or two cave shrooms do not prepare the three-shroom request.

Volgk accepts Agama's tongue for a mystical serpent-runed quiver. Agama currently carries that object. His dialogue mentions sparing her, but no recorded cutting, rescue or spared-life outcome is declared by this request. The card tracks the exact accepted item without inventing a method or making personal violence a prerequisite.

Carry each chosen offering loose to see current preparation. Held, worn, nested, consumed or handed-away items are not current preparation. Exact supplied items can fit without a personal kill, first-recovery or prior dialogue record. The item-and-item bundles settle as one native request; readiness and reward possession do not prove acceptance.

All ten native requests retire their recipient after acceptance. Source and recipient caps, reset timing and other players affect availability; potential daily eligibility does not guarantee fresh stock. Epolon's transformation, T'rin's hellfire, Grobklarn's ritual and freedom speeches are native completion narration, not additional recorded world-state achievements.

The local dealer also sells an azure potion, so owning that potion does not prove Grobklarn's ritual. Ordinary shopping, training, rune-covered stones, memories and descriptive symbols do not complete another local accepted request. Surface and Underdark passages, foreign quests and guarded arrival abilities retain their own ownership and discovery rules.

story_mappings.introduction: Discover the ports, meet their contacts and follow nineteen independent commissions: local supplies, overseas proof and exact mixed collections. Six supplier and equipment services stay separate. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: Canderthal, Fenaline and Thur'Gurax have separate loaded land approaches from the Surface Realm. Visiting one discovers this shared area, but other contacts remain hidden until encountered. No ship ownership or sailing receipt is required for the native deliveries.

Start with dock supply recovery and the seafood kitchens. Chundel and Grimashk pay different prices for normal crates; Grimashk also accepts old reinforced crates as one recovery alternative. Voshen and Martinek each need six of their own exact seafood kind.

Pol sells an ordinary fishing pole separately from his refunded briefing. His final lure request consumes five shells and five fire glands, pays cash and XP, and does not require his note or award Fishfetcher. Optional current supplies and earlier history do not add achievements.

Crendethyl wants the engraved stein equipped by the huge bartender in Canderthal. Elthindeal wants the Canderthal ale cask from Gringash's cellar. Carry their actual proofs between the ports; tavern dialogue and visits provide guidance without enforced prior stages.

The turtle, pyrolisk, viper, panther, samurai, hydralisk and bandit sources disperse into distinct mainland regions. Their caps, worn proof and current roaming locations need active qualification. One pyrolisk branch is unloaded and one viper destination is ocean. Supplied materials remain valid.

Gringash and Kruth'Urgur want the same tinker map for different independent purposes and payments. Gelden wants a Sarmiz obsidian and steel totem; Shaenae wants the aged ring from a foreign bone pile; Frull wants a Werrun cigar box. The delivery receipt belongs to this port area even when its source is elsewhere.

Krintis, Ayden and Vrash compete for venom, glands or panther teeth. Trismerk needs five jade katanas; Austugus needs five hydralisk glands. Cairme's implemented recipe needs four shivs and the exact tundra rations despite a conflicting six-shiv line. These research and military commissions do not implement poison, antidote, siege or arsenal state.

Bestile needs six distinct potion kinds, one each. The troll in Thur'Gurax stocks his brown potion locally as well as all three Bronak materials. Exact supplies can come from shops, alternate sources or other players; their possession does not prove first personal acquisition or visiting every named shop.

Bronak's three totems each require one exact material and fifty platinum. His outputs differ from Gelden's proof. The refunded briefing, two seafood purchases and three totem recipes remain support services with guarded coin settlement.

Closed port gates are unkeyed. The barracks east door is reset locked with key zero; ordinary lock-picking and other valid access need qualification. A hidden cellar staircase connects to a foreign gambling room. Loaded sea edges use ocean movement; three other legacy port exits are unloaded and need deliberate repair.

Worshipping the garden statue and touching the storm altar use ordinary teleport objects with walking return routes. The moonwell enters Shaledrieth. These actions, teachers suggested by prose, inns, ship construction and crew hiring have no new quest milestones without accepted event evidence. Paid ship services also need coordinated accounting settlement.

Quest rewards preserve actual cash, items, declared XP and recipient retirement. Native XP is subject to actor and companion caps. Gifts can prepare a valid turn-in without recording personal hunting, fishing, sailing, faction standing, learned keywords or a whole campaign.

story_mappings.introduction: Follow the duergar and paladin patrol stories through the temple, its hidden passages and the earthen abyss. Two independent item deliveries record accepted outcomes. Rescue, closing the bloodrune and solving the shared chamber remain separate exploration stories. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting.
orientation: Enter from the Underdark caverns and meet the temple patrols. ASK a nearby contact about a listed topic to follow their leads. A recognized response can reveal that contact; each keyword is not a separate achievement. Gromdishar and the paladin captain begin in different parts of the temple.

Gromdishar asks about the lost Gloomhaven patrol, the abyss outpost and his brother. His recorded request accepts the exact badge of Gloomhaven for a vial of blood. The hydra-lair lead is in his dialogue, but a current world source for the badge is unresolved. This journal does not promise that a corpse or scout supplies it.

The paladin captain describes a search for survivors and a mission to stop the bloodrune. His accepted request takes the silver band of Torm the true for a crested shield of Melkivar. The band starts inside the slain paladin's body in the abandoned temple. The body is an open container; the band must be retrieved and carried loose for the hand-in.

Both deliveries are independent. Exact supplied proof can fit without your own earlier recovery, combat, puzzle, rescue or rune travel. Wearing the silver band, keeping either item inside a bag, holding it, spending it or handing it away does not satisfy the journal's current loose-material check. A reward item alone does not prove acceptance.

Find Lithibar for the temple history and the nights, wishes and summer-day hint. His study has a keyed approach; the nearby tapestry gives another clue. He describes imprisonment and escape, but the present journal has no accepted rescue or escort endpoint. Shared-open passages and supplied keys remain separate routes.

The chamber before the illusions has five material buttons. A shared hidden selection determines the custom PUSH puzzle, and a wrong recognized choice can release a hostile creature. The selection and reset behavior need builder qualification before the journal can promise a reproducible solution. Solving or entering a shared-open passage is not yet personal puzzle credit.

Explore the maze, hidden library, abandoned temple and side caverns using their actual exits and controls. The sun symbol, metallic button and red book use PUSH; the wooden wheel and rune-shaped dial use PULL. Keys and controls affect different doors. Search and open actions may still be necessary after a wall moves. These controls do not create accepted delivery receipts.

The bloodrune in the private summoning chambers leads to the earthen abyss. Its counterpart in the abyss leads back to those chambers. Two other ancient runes respond to TOUCH, and green mirrors provide different return routes. Travel is distinct from deciphering or closing a rune; a room arrival does not establish every earlier step.

Seek the duergar outpost, paladin encampment and elven landing in the abyss. Their contacts describe the invasion and surviving patrols. These replies do not record a defended outpost, a reunited patrol or a slain high priest. Some contacts start in holding rooms and can move; availability depends on the current world.

Eligoth guards the abyss fortress. A return portal may form after his defeat; its availability depends on the current world. Defeating him, finding an actual portal and using it are distinct outcomes. None is required for the captain's or Gromdishar's delivery.

Plan for the actual native hazards and underwater rooms. Floating-rock descriptions do not by themselves require flight, and a heavy-door description does not create a giant-strength gate. Shared door state, key custody and item effects still govern access. The journal does not grant movement protection or change the temple's dangers.

Accepted delivery retires that giver. Gromdishar's escort text and the captain's Word of recall text do not move you or close the bloodrune. These are currently story quests. Daily repetition still needs deliberate integration of their material supplies and returning givers; the badge source is unresolved. New credit requires active, ready accounting.

story_mappings.introduction: The Lost Temple of Tikitzopl tells of a resistance against the Krahns and undead. Follow the hidden magician, Zynar's guards' key, four guardian shards and the glass component toward royal treasure and the Orb of Insanity; O'Gallagher and the beautiful drow have separate requests. Item deliveries establish their exact outcomes, while lore, travel, combat and temple liberation need separate evidence. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The temple entrance lies below the Lost City's forest entrance. The foreign temple key opens the approach door; its sacrifice contract remains owned by the Lost City. The magically sealed northern door in the entrance description is scenery: the actual temple route is the hidden trapdoor down.

Look for the hidden chamber beneath the Necromancy temple to meet the crafty magician. Ask about mages, list or help and examine the room journal for the resistance plan. The separate empty Ancient Crypt below the necromancy altar is not his ordinary placement.

The large golem in the hidden passage carries the flaming key for the secret fire-side wall. Krahn'krayv equips the armor of the elements in the Temple of Meditation. Give that exact armor to Zynar at the Altar of Dexterity for the wooden guards' key.

The guards' training grounds contain the master of arms and the glass component. A gem-and-gold key is declared inside a cot in the guards' sleeping chambers and opens the king's chambers. The rack instead contains two yellow vials; its own keyed closure uses that same gem key.

The earth, water, fire and air guardians carry four different shards. Bring one of each plus the glass component to the magician for the golden treasure key. The glass component is a recipe ingredient; a fire shard is different from the separately collected burning flame.

Push the majestic royal altar, then use the golden key for its locked passage down to the treasure rooms. Pushing clears the block but does not itself unlock or reveal all access. This key has a one-percent native break chance; the other local access keys have no native break chance.

Altar inscriptions are clues to the sequence of magical speech doors beyond the treasure rooms. Their accepted last-word keywords differ by door; examined lore and successful unlocking are not recorded as journal achievements. The final southern door is already open in its loaded state.

The Orb is declared inside the marble high altar beyond those doors. Each of fifteen chosen Orb enhancements consumes a separate Orb together with its exact ingredients. One Orb cannot complete every upgrade, and an earlier key or crafting receipt cannot replace a spent current ingredient.

The high altar room also has a separate entrance from Winterhaven's gnomish-key teleport room. Entering its array of lights leads to the Lost City Snake Pit, where a ground leaf key opens the exit. This is a one-way return route with its own encounter, source and travel qualification; hints do not award foreign discovery.

Nine distinct emblems merge into the empowering emblem; nine distinct earrings merge into the Krahns earring. Five sharp stone pieces, ten standard swords, four guard scimitars, five claymores or five base glistening bracelets make separate magical base outputs. Carry every required piece together for the chosen recipe.

Four weather components merge into the basic weathered shard. Four different royal dagger metals and three royal sword metals make their own bases. Those bases can then compete for an Orb; donated exact bases skip earlier producer receipts.

Advanced services also use Lost City equipment: eight distinct racial flesh rings, three different same-named sapphire necklaces and High Council weapons. Necklace sources and attributes distinguish the three kinds. Stocked rings and weapons do not establish personal creature kills or body-part creation.

Return the clover necklace from the drow warrior to O'Gallagher for the mirrored bracelet; give that bracelet to the beautiful drow for mirrored leggings. These two requests remain independent, and donated exact offerings work without the earlier local request.

The high altar prayer is a separate class-change service: it can remove a multiclass character's secondary class and specialization for 100 epic points. Its debit already waits for committed settlement. It grants no quest credit and is not required to retrieve the Orb or craft equipment.

MaDMaN armor can use its worn hide power, the shield has a fire retaliation, the mangler has blur/riposte powers and the mace uses a worn mentality command with a five-minute cooldown. An early mace repeat hurts the wielder. These powers do not complete a takeover, reveal a learned quest keyword or prove accepted combat progress.

Directly carry every exact offering outside equipment and containers. Readiness and journal reads award nothing. Four named requests/story assemblies are potential daily candidates; the 25 equipment services and class-change prayer award no quest achievements or dailies. Fresh active reset stock and actual travel/combat/service episodes still need qualification.

story_mappings.introduction: Follow the outpost patrols, chaos relics and royal tombs of Githzerai Stronghold. Thirteen independent accepted deliveries sit alongside the larger fortress and Rrakkma stories. Gather the exact items for each bundle together. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting.
orientation: Begin at the surface outpost and follow the patrol, guild and Limbo leads. ASK nearby contacts about their listed topics to hear their stories. A recognized response reveals the contact; individual keywords are not separate achievements. The spirit of Zerthimon has an item request but no listed ASK topics, and the stranded githyanki has no substantive written reply.

The wrinkled parchment begins with an outpost warden. A sergeant accepts it for an insignia, while Zangzk also needs it in a separate three-item key bundle. Choose which request to supply. The parchment, the insignia and learning the map topic are different things.

Zangzk offers independent routes: three githyanki trophies for a katana and master key, or a violet potion, parchment and azure poison bottle for the master key. His cash option asks for 500 platinum, but that payment cannot currently be accepted while accounting is active. Keep the item routes separate from the pending cash route.

A pile of adamantite coins is a physical item found in a guild locker. Zangzk accepts it for information without awarding an item. This is separate from his 500-platinum fee, and the information delivery is not required before his other hand-ins. An Alatorin contact also accepts these coins; giving them away consumes stock needed here.

Prazyz, the slaadi hunter, asks for one large hide and two matching smaller scraps. The red and green bundles have separate rewards. Identically named hides can be different sizes and kinds: one large hide cannot stand in for two smaller pieces, and one scrap cannot count twice. His starting location is in Limbo; contacts can move.

Collect the three separate relics of chaos for the spirit of Zerthimon and the long fortress key. The mixed slaad, huge shadow and githzerai watch leader are the declared sources. This delivery is independent of the king's heartstone request. Supplied relics fit without your own earlier kills or realm travel.

King Tayr-Dryn accepts Zerthimon's heartstone for an eternal shadow and then retires. The shadow opens a different approach. The king's arcane form already has a separate world appearance; the delivery narrative does not prove that you created or defeated that form. The royal feud still needs distinct story endpoints.

Vozalyzk accepts a Zerthimonian necklace for a mindstone bracelet or a Zerthimonian ring for a mindstone ear clasp. These are separate requests. The necklace and ring come from different Zerth placements; the ring is not one of the royal signet rings requested by the prophet.

The stranded githyanki accepts the wicked implement of torture for a blood-stained rosary and then retires. The torturer and prisoner begin together. Acceptance records the delivery; the departure text does not escort you or establish a separate rescue destination.

The prophet connects the royal feud, Kezyr-Dryn, secret tombs and rogue Rrakkma. Bring five separate signet rings with a kingly crest together for the bright marble key. The rings are inside five royal sarcophagi, including the father's tomb. The king's statue responds to BOW; its return portal has a different command. Your own tomb visit is not required if the exact rings are supplied.

Read inscriptions for the native speech-door clues. Speaking a recognized password can reveal and unlock a shared door, but opening it or moving another barrier may still be necessary. Keys, PULL controls and the shadow control that responds to BLEED affect different passages. A shared-open route does not establish your own earlier solve.

The deeper soul chambers, ghost controls, forcefield, mirrors and void are exploration stories. Guardians can leave fixed controls on the floor when they die; those controls can affect remote passages. Actual controls and travel commands differ from their narrative wording. Flight, falling, traps, door state and native travel restrictions still govern the route.

Carry all items for the chosen request loose and together. Held, worn, nested, consumed or handed-away materials are not current preparation. A reward alone does not prove an accepted delivery. Exact supplied materials fit without earlier dialogue, source, combat or access history. World stock, retiring contacts and renewal can limit potential dailies; new credit requires active, ready accounting.

story_mappings.introduction: Aid the wounded miner, follow rival signet requests, supply a desert traveler, recover hidden contraband, and trace the Queen’s garb through Goranon and Eriic to Winterhaven. Exact item exchanges remain distinct from personal source, access, combat, travel and epic learning.
orientation: Enter from the Surface’s Amber Sands through the city’s western approach. Inns, bazaars, merchant docks, poor encampments, the Sultan’s palace, House Lo’Ushuur and the undermountain provide separate paths. Native visits, loot and prose do not automatically create quest achievements.

Ask the eight quest givers their mapped topics. These aliases reveal existing responses; asking every alias is not eight or forty-six additional achievements. The mine’s potion, two distinct signets, compass, contraband, wyrm eyeball, royal garb and hunter medallion are exact item proofs.

For the collapsed mine, PUSH the fixed boulder along the cliffs. It clears the blocked north exit below; neither the boulder nor an entrance needs to be made takeable. Follow the shaft with native falling risk, then ENTER the first river and follow its downstream rooms to the River’s End. NORTH reaches the miner’s trench and UP the wyrm lair. The second river portal at the trench returns to the River’s End. Access and movement remain guidance until admitted events are qualified.

The wandering merchant carries and sells the miner’s large potion. The miner grants the studded belt; the white-robed figure separately accepts the wyrm’s eyeball for an ordinary glowing runestone. Miner rescue and wyrm proof are independent exchanges, and a supplied exact item bypasses personal access or combat.

The cloaked figure wants the jolly old merchant’s dusty signet from the Sultan’s pleasure room; the evil wizard wants Vernadad’s different signet from House Lo’Ushuur. Palace and House gates have separate keys and pickproof locks. The first burly guard carries the House key; the lord wears his ring.

The gangleader at the refuse encampment carries the traveler’s compass. The city map from the tinker is a different item and has two separate Shipyard recipients. The traveler’s narrated magic-tower expedition has no native campaign endpoint.

SEARCH and OPEN the secret DOWN plank in the massive warehouse for Mijium’s wine cellar. The shady merchant wants the exact contraband on the floor there. Ship-shop contraband uses separate cargo state; the same word does not make it this quest item.

Goranon accepts the insect Queen’s royal garb for the elvish hunter medallion. Eriic accepts that medallion for the desert-island locket. Winterhaven’s ambassador then accepts the locket; its rare fabric can enter Grendilyn’s paired-fabric recipe there. Each exchange keeps its actual owner, and supplied later proof requires no personal earlier history.

The tower’s two fixed runestones use TOUCH to travel between tower approach and the desert stone. They are not the white-robed figure’s type11 reward and do not require possessing that reward. Fixed ships, tents, ladder, caravan, warehouse and river portals preserve native mobility, access and charges.

Eriic also teaches Improved Endurance, and Ruffus Totemic Mastery, through computed epic bindings. Epic purchases remain guarded while accounting is active. Narggle’s random world quests, the dock’s ship services, taproom crew hiring, ten shops and inn services are separate support systems.

Current loose materials, historical accepted outcomes, actual source recovery, gifts, access, combat, travel and learning are separate states. An old receipt never restores spent proof or a key. No journal binding makes narrated House collapse, slave liberation, nest destruction or expedition success into an implemented campaign.

The Sultan also carries a memory of Venan’Trut for Winterhaven’s ambassador, independently of Eriic’s locket. His imported rune-covered epic stone has a real TOUCH group-reward handler, periodic configuration and actor custody; accepted claim, eligibility, peaceful room, group membership and reward recovery remain separate from native item hand-ins. Neither merely holding it nor visiting the palace completes another journal card.

Discovery has its own achievement, and meeting each terminal giver reveals its journal card. Active, ready accounting is mandatory for all new discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit; frozen recovery is separate. Reset mode1 and existing recipients make eight static daily candidates, without proving live stock or daily renewal.

story_mappings.introduction: Find the missing key, plan your way into the hero’s cell, and follow the steak exchange to its tragic ending. Returning the key and feeding the hero are separate recorded exchanges; other prisoners’ stories have no implemented rescue outcome.
orientation: Enter from Split Shield’s Eastern Gate (10327) and head EAST through the muddy approach to the main square (53202). From the square, NORTH reaches the guard and elven barracks, SOUTH the barbarian and dwarven barracks, and EAST the human and gnomish barracks. Doors, darkness and hostile inhabitants can affect your route.

Ask the master slaves, camp or encampement. Ask the hero food, hi, hello, howdy, greetings, help, quest, camp, orc or encampenet. These spellings match his existing topics. Several keywords lead to the same response; asking each one does not earn a separate achievement.

The slave guard in the northern barracks carries the small metallic key. The mud on the approach mentions something shiny, but there is no matching key on the ground. A key received from another player still fits the exchange; carrying it does not show how you obtained it.

The same key opens the hidden trapdoor between the main square and the hero’s cell (53212). Find the door before trying to unlock it, then OPEN it before going DOWN. Lockpicking remains another option if your skills and tools allow it. Each successful use of the key has a 20 percent chance to break it.

Plan access to the cell before giving the key to the master. He takes it in exchange for the large steak and a configured reward of 1,500 coins. Returning the key does not open the trapdoor or restore your key. An already opened door may let you enter without carrying one.

The master also carries a copy of the steak. A matching steak obtained from another source can be offered to the hero without your own key-return record. Having a steak does not prove you completed the master’s exchange, and the available supply is limited.

The hero accepts the exact large steak for a lightweight spiked mace and a configured reward of 15,000 experience, subject to the game’s reward rules. The scene ends with poisoning and his death. The journal records that tragic exchange; it does not describe a successful rescue or count it as a combat kill.

Although named as food, this particular steak cannot normally be eaten by a player. It is the specific item for the hero’s final exchange. Ordinary food, including the half-eaten iron ration carried by the enslaved human in cell 53210, does not substitute for it.

The hero also has an ordinary-food request that would leave him asking for more, with no reward. That request is currently unavailable with active accounting and is excluded from achievements and dailies. Use the exact steak exchange described above for the supported story.

The well in the square supplies water. The gnomish man in cell 53211 wears a bag associated with white and black scrolls. Water, scrolls and the other prisoners’ backstories have no additional local quest outcome, teaching objective or liberation objective.

The southern barracks description points toward gnomes, but the cell directly EAST of it (53206) holds dwarves. The gnomes are off the eastern barracks instead. Descriptions of mines, escape and family hardship do not add travel or rescue steps to these two exchanges.

story_mappings.introduction: Follow the storm druid's burnt-tree evidence, Chauseis's remote exchange, Ahanz's hunt and the adventurer's one reward choice. The barbarian's mask and Asus's soup are services. Exact current materials prepare an offering; acceptance records its outcome. New progress requires active, ready accounting.
orientation: This area spans several separate roads, forests, settlements, tomb approaches and travel pockets. Discovery does not mean every path or giver is accessible. Follow each contact's actual route and native shared doors; these independent requests are not one mandatory journey across every room.

ASK druid about hello, hi, dark, moor or moors for burnt-tree leads. He accepts the exact ember from a burnt tree and declares a 20 platinum reward before leaving. An ember can also come from remote fireplace or hearth stock. Supplied exact evidence fits; this is not proof that you identified the burner, saved a forest or learned every keyword.

ASK barbarian about feathers or craft. His mask needs four separate exact eagle feathers together and 10 platinum. The four local eagle placements each declare feather stock with a shared cap of four. Carry all four loose; one feather, another bird's feather, worn feathers or the mask reward do not complete the service. Its mixed item-and-coin payment still needs accounting qualification before active use.

Chauseis exchanges the exact heart of Bel, orb of unmaking and mystic runed stone tablet together for the declared Wisdom scroll. Heart and orb have remote limited sources; no active declared tablet supply was found. The scroll's native type does not establish a Wisdom gain from reading. Her ambient prayers are not ASK objectives. Her separate epic Wisdom training has a normal boot binding but refuses purchases while accounting is active.

ASK ahanz about kraken. He accepts the exact heads of Princess Aventi and Prince Itneva together, rewards an unfinished wand and leaves. Matching supplied heads fit without your own kills. Ahanz's own head is not an offering. The unfinished wand is a component, distinct from the finished combat wand.

ASK fallen about tomb or mystic for the foreign mystical-key lead. The actual exact key comes from a separate Surface mystic exchange of four different lockets and a book. Matching supplied keys or an already-open route can provide access where native rules allow. Hearing the lead, recovering a local locket, holding the key and opening the tomb are different facts; no personal mystic receipt is required by the adventurer's item recipes.

ASK adventurer about priest, mage or warrior and choose ONE five-item bundle. Mage: skin of the shadow eel + tight green cloak + foggy visor + shadowy chest plate + purple robe of stars. Warrior: skin + cloak + earring of congealed blood + chest plate + misty blue dragon scale armor. Priest: skin + cloak + helm of light + mask of hatred + foggy visor. Materials shown below describe alternatives, not a requirement to gather all nine kinds.

The adventurer gives the matching unfinished handle, chest piece or crown shell plus a glowing ring, then leaves. These three alternatives count as one story outcome; asking three class keywords is not three completions. His rescue and Aceralde-defeat remarks do not establish personal rescue, kill or class requirements in the actual recipes. Equipped tower gear must be carried loose for an offering.

The wise gnomish cosmomancer near Torrhan owns four separate finishing services in Mini Zones: unfinished handle, crown shell, chest piece or wand + one exact pulsating sphere + three exact large mithril ores makes the corresponding staff, crown, platemail or wand. The strange being's sphere exchange needs six distinct plane essences. Those remote services retain their own journal ownership. Local component acceptance does not prove finished gear, sphere gathering, ore mining or matching branch lineage.

ASK asus about soup or fishing. One exact large hairy crab and one exact large shrimp together make TWO copies of the declared shrimp-and-hairy-crab bisque. Fishing can produce these species, and supplied exact fish also fit. Eating soup, holding same-name bisque or personally catching fish is not the accepted cooking receipt. The Fiord tent is reached through its actual Surface tent portal.

Six native PUSH switches alter shared blocked routes around the narrow path, overturned wagon, rubble and crypt. Exact keys and fixed sunwell, crack, tent and moonwell portals also affect access. Another player's prior opening can help. No switch press, key possession or travel description is an additional story completion.

ASK feliusius about quest, map, abandon or resign for his separate generated mission service. Its ASK/kill assignments and fees use the native mission log, not these static turn-ins. This area is excluded as a generated mission target. Mission refund settlement and an explicit journal bridge still need qualification. Crew hiring at the tent also needs a payment continuation fix before any new credit is attached.

Current exact loose custody is preparation; worn, held, nested, spent or handed-away materials do not satisfy those rows. Gifts fit without personal first-recovery history, and reward possession is not acceptance. Four stories contribute achievements and potential dailies under this area's reset mode; a giver who leaves after acceptance still needs a qualified later return and fresh materials. The mask and soup remain services. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting; limited stock and shared access govern actual availability.

story_mappings.introduction: Winterhaven connects everyday city requests with forest crafts, prisoners, snow-ogre passages, ambassador memories and distant artifact expeditions. Choose a story and follow its exact materials and named contact.
orientation: Read look, exits and the signs along the guild district. Ask named contacts about their listed topics; talking gives clues, while completed deliveries appear in your history.
For wildlife, recover the freshly killed animal item. Grenthal buys it; Monfit tans it for crafting. Selling and tanning consume the same item, so choose its use before delivery.
Most fresh animal remains spoil. Carry them promptly to the intended maker; an ordinary corpse or a decayed carcass cannot replace the requested fresh item.
For alchemy, bring each Incarnate material and an empty potion bottle to Bipplewizzlille. The five resulting potions can fund either his elixir or Chibbleniffle's separate potion request.
For equipment, obtain blueprints from Chibbleniffle, plain equipment from the weapon or armory merchant, and the named ingot from the blacksmith merchant. Each improvement consumes another blueprint.
Sootfoot then needs the exact improved equipment, an orb of binding, a weapon hilt or armor flint, and his recipe's distant artifacts. These are independent commissions.
For silk, Grendilyn exchanges the two rare fabrics for two raw threads. Melfist colors a raw thread with the named dye; Seyb needs the matching leather garment, colored thread and payment.
The ambassador memory requests reward a shopkeepers token, a strange enchantment scroll and coins. Scrolls become a random attribute; Branay needs two matching attribute scrolls per earring.
For the prison and palace, ask Rosenthal, Thyz and Sir Espet about their requests. The immunity letter, prison key and palace key have different purposes.
To reach the snow-ogre realm, stare at Ohjal's painting. The chief trades a baby centaur for a key; that key breaks after unlocking one shaman door. Four freshly locked doors require four copies.
Ask Xola and Drahknalloth's projection about time and the dragons before their expedition. Carry the three beating hearts for the three locked seals, then deliver them before they decay.
Supplied materials count for native delivery. A completed delivery records the exchange; it does not establish a personal kill, learned topic, unlocked passage or complete campaign.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore the Mountain of Peril Peaks through Mugnork, the beast-filled undermountain and the dark citadel. Ten independent accepted deliveries explain three linked errands and four separate exchanges. Active, ready accounting is required. Exact supplied proof fits without personal producer history; kills, first recovery, learned words, access, travel, healing and companion fate need separately qualified events.
orientation: Meet each recipient before asking their addressed words. Each keyword reveals a clue rather than awarding an achievement. The hunter spirit's quest/hi answers introduce three different beast-part outcomes, not a required dialogue checklist.

Deliver the dwarven miner's exact silver bag to the underground foreman for a silver stud, then independently offer that stud to Roxon at the Gray Owl Ale House for a tribal bracelet. The stud's usable item keyword is earring. Optional shipment history does not restore a spent stud.

The hunter spirit wants three distinct reptile trophies together: python scale, serpent scale and the anaconda pair. The pair is one object. He separately accepts a plant tentacle plus a kraken tentacle, or one pair of fire-draco eyes. These are independent hunting exchanges; duplicate parts cannot replace another required kind.

The tribal barbarian accepts snow-bear fur for five thousand experience independently of his sasquach task. Meat is a dialogue keyword, not a requested food item. Bring the sasquach's right arm for parchment, then offer that parchment to Gooran in the Gray Owl Ale House for the actual prayer book. Native dialogue and the parchment promise a ring; that content discrepancy remains pending.

Bring the ancient twisted skeleton's head from the Forest of Death to the one-eyed troll for a troll eye. Offer the eye to the injured human beside the stream for the silver rune medallion. Exact supplied eye proof fits without personally completing the head exchange. Narrated recovery does not record healing or rescue.

The traveler asks about his companions after giving the medallion, but there is no further native quest contract. Five displaced companions have active placements in a connected load room and can wander independently. Finding them, their current fate and returning a report need a builder-authored continuation and qualified events.

The medallion is a persistent key for the white-washed gates. Use it to unlock the gates, then open them; receiving the key does not record passage. Defeating the ghost gardener or ghost librarian releases that ghost's emerald into the room, where it can be touched. The gardener's emerald clears the blocked north courtyard route, and the librarian's different same-named emerald clears the blocked north tower route. Another NPC's carried object does not dispatch the switch. These controls clear blocks without awarding journal credit.

Look at the magical twilight in the oval tower chamber to travel to the observatory, then touch the silver sphere there to return. Enter the black gate in the western tower access or the snow covered tent by the hot spring for their declared destinations. There are separate unused cave/oval portal prototypes; do not assume they are present or usable.

The tower's elemental paths contain false turns back to the aether hazard, while the high snowy cliffs have falling routes and the underground river has current and water hazards. Follow observed exits and controls. A delivery does not certify walking the maze, defeating its guardians or arriving safely.

Bridge, defense-tower and council-cell gates use different keys. The bear chief's persistent stone key opens the locked pickproof wooden chest; the council-cell key is displayed as silver but has stone-key aliases. A small iron key is named on already-open non-door exits and has no active source; this is a builder-review finding, not proof the tower is inaccessible.

Declared stocks and wandering can limit current proof. One hunter outcome consumes three different scale kinds, and plant/kraken tentacles are distinct from the reward tentacle. Recover carried proof loose; worn eyes, a worn troll eye or material left in a corpse or container does not count as current carried readiness.

All ten recipients stay after acceptance, and all ten native contracts retain potential daily shape. Source supply, access, recipient survival and active accounting still govern actual attempts. Each receipt records its own delivery rather than every earlier stage, companion investigation, narrated world change or a completed mountain campaign.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore Castle Ravenloft, its temporal demon realms and hidden passages. Four independent reward quests sit alongside the bell puzzle, prisoner leads and the wider Barovian story. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting.
orientation: Begin with the castle approach and nearby contacts. The outer gates use the long black castle key obtainable in Barovia Continued. Lady Vey Rallen, Perganan, the Sabbath Wizard and the inner Megosh describe separate requests. ASK their listed topics to hear the native replies; individual keywords are not separate achievements. Contacts can move or depart.

Lady Vey Rallen needs both an abyssal essence and a Zionyn essence together. The two Obox-Ob appearances are independent sources in the past and future demon realms. Their travel routes, guardians and return passages are useful exploration guidance, rather than an enforced personal order. Exact supplied essences fit without your own earlier visits or kills.

Lucian carries a container with a small key for his locked desk. The document of Lenience and the document of Indulgence are different papers inside that desk. Perganan wants Lenience; the Sabbath Wizard wants Indulgence. Bring the exact paper loose in inventory. Neither paper nor its reward substitutes for the other request.

Perganan hides in a crawlspace reached through the jail area and its loose-brick control. Ask about urik to hear his request. His accepted Lenience delivery gives a note for Sir Urik in Barovia Continued. The note is a separate onward hand-in; Perganan does not actually depart or escort you after the local delivery.

The Sabbath Wizard accepts Indulgence for a black belt with a fiery skull buckle, then departs. The copper mallet comes from the Treasury and belongs to a separate puzzle. The soul release does not award the mallet or unlock the bell sequence.

Megosh outside the Court of the Count wants the Idol of Ravenloft and the Dayheart together for a barbed raven-talon key. The Idol starts at the chapel altar; the Dayheart starts in the tower beyond the garden and its guarded approach. Watch the native traps, doors and falling hazards. Delivering these relics does not record that you personally took them or defeated their guardians.

The castle has another Megosh at the outer approach, with a separate request owned by Barovia Continued. The inner Megosh's completion text reveals Strahd and makes Megosh disappear. It does not spawn or transform the separately placed Strahd, or prove the Count was defeated.

For the bell puzzle, find the copper mallet in the true Treasury and wield it before striking the large bell. A successful native strike destroys the mallet and unlocks a remote sword case. The case stays closed until opened. A tapestry control reveals its alcove. This shared puzzle has no accepted quest receipt yet; someone else opening the case does not prove your own solve.

The shocker lizard accepts and returns a copper mallet with a squeak. This same-item prop is not a reward quest or a source of the first mallet, and it is not required before striking the bell. Its native accepted history remains separate from the four journal stories.

Look at inscriptions and controls for passage clues. The SouthTower plaque asks for the demon prince's name. Different tapestries, statues, a loose brick, a torch, an altar and a throne affect different shared exits. Opening a shared passage does not require your own earlier solve. Use the native commands and preserve access, trap and movement restrictions.

Gertruda, the dracolich skull and the old catacomb key lead to other zones: Mad Mary in Barovia, and Rahadin or Gevin in the Ravenloft Catacombs. These are separate recipients and receipts. The catacomb entrances and paired wall handprints have their own routes. The existing Doru–Chernovog–Strahd kill achievement is also separate from local item deliveries.

Carry every item for the chosen request loose and together. Held, worn, nested, consumed or handed-away materials are not current preparation. Exact supplied proof fits without previous dialogue, source, combat, puzzle or gate history. A reward alone is not an accepted delivery. Scarce stock and departing contacts limit availability; new credit requires active, ready accounting.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore the Barovian valley, its witches, Vistani camps, dragon lairs and Kashtrakis. Five independent hand-ins connect this wilderness to Castle Ravenloft and the wider Barovian story. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting.
orientation: Follow the road north from the village through the valley toward Lysaga Hill and Castle Ravenloft. Sir Urik waits at the crossroads gallows; Madam Eva starts in her inner sanctum at the mountain encampment; Mirkodesiuska lives in a cluttered mountain cave; the outer Megosh starts at the castle gates in the adjoining castle area. Contacts can move or depart. ASK listed topics for their native replies; each keyword is not a separate achievement.

Madam Eva has two separate requests. For the Ravenkind symbol and the castle outer-gate key, bring Baba Zelenna's tiny locket and the Drowned Lady's cloudy glass eye together. Zelenna starts atop Lysaga Hill; the Drowned Lady dwells in the deep Ivlis Marsh. Beware the native terrain and guardians. Exact supplied relics fit without personal earlier kills or source history.

Eva's Vistani exchange instead accepts a badge of the Vistani and the mark of the saboteur together. An overseer in the mountain encampment carries the badge; a special saboteur in the hidden Vistani den carries the mark. The reward is a blood-red bandana and a returned mark. The reply welcomes you to the Vistani, but the exchange does not record a faction change or prove stealthy recovery. Keep this path separate from the witch relics.

The two Madam Eva chambers are different places. Her active initial placement is in the inner sanctum at the mountain camp, not in the secret private chamber. The tiny key she carries fits the private chamber's locked door and storage chest. The hidden den also has an active portal back to the mountain camp. Access and custody remain subject to the native game rules.

Mirkodesiuska asks for proof against the red dragon. The accepted proof is the exact fire dragon egg from the red dragon's damp cave; the reward is a shimmering crystal dragon scale. An egg supplied by someone else fits the hand-in without your own kill. The crystal dragon departs after acceptance; this does not spawn a scout or record a later meeting.

Urik wants news of Perganan, who hides in Castle Ravenloft. Perganan's separate Lenience delivery supplies the hastily-written note. Bring that exact loose note to Urik for Moonfriend, a silver ring; Urik departs after acceptance. Reading the note, possessing the ring or hearing an escape promise does not prove either delivery.

The outer Megosh wants Chernovog's black heart for the castle outer-gate key. Baba Zelenna's books and clothing conceal an onward tower route: PUSH books to reveal the passage, then explore the pentagram leading into Kashtrakis. Its guardians, gates, scrolls and exit route have their own hazards. Chernovog carries the heart and a shard of hellfire for the locked upper route. Supplied heart proof fits without earlier personal travel, combat or puzzle history.

Two burning scrolls have the same visible name but different effects. The scroll associated with the Kashtrakis gates opens the blocked gate when used there; the other affects the distant marilith route. Examine the native clues and use TOUCH with the actual relevant object. The lore about a devil's touch does not currently enforce a devil race requirement. Shared-open passages remain usable without personally operating a control.

Eva's witch-relic reward and Megosh's heart reward are alternative sources of the same black outer-gate key, with independent receipts. The holy Ravenkind symbol is a different item with a reactive combat effect. It is neither the key nor a guaranteed victory over Strahd. The inner castle Megosh has a separate two-relic request; these independently placed contacts do not form a spawned escort or transformation chain.

The crystal ball in Eva's inner sanctum has an onward exchange with Rahadin in the Ravenloft Catacombs. The Catacombs also have another entrance to Kashtrakis. Those contacts, onward deliveries and discovery are separate. The existing ordered Doru–Chernovog–Strahd kill achievement is distinct from the heart and relic deliveries.

Carry the complete chosen offering loose and together. Held, worn, nested, consumed or handed-away items are not current preparation; owning a reward does not prove acceptance. Exact supplied stock fits without prior questions, source custody, kills or gate history. Only the witch-relic exchange is a potential local daily; scarce stock, mode-zero resets and departing contacts do not promise daily availability. New credit requires active, ready accounting.

story_mappings.introduction: The Ravenloft Catacombs weave independent prisoner rescues, relic recovery, fortune commissions and three Strahd-skull reward choices through a large network of crypts. Follow the contacts you encounter and keep their competing proofs and availability in mind. Player journal progress requires active, ready accounting.
orientation: Enter through Castle Ravenloft's cellar or Kingsmen route, or push the paired handprints between Ravenloft and the catacomb wine-cellar passage. These are world access mechanisms; discovering or reading about them does not record successful travel.

The black key carried by Stefania fits the cell doors and supplies Emil's release. The old Castle Ravenloft key fits the main gates and hidden wall route; it has a 100 break chance. The image of Rahadin replaces it and awards a separately brittle spectral key for the spectral corridor.

Pull the iron curtains for Thredra's laboratory route and push the broken wine racks for the cellar passage. Bring Thredra three different holy relics together for a buckler and stake; her relic delivery retires her.

Dostron's ashes can restore Exethanter's narrated memory or rejuvenate Thredra for a different reward. Neither route is required by the other. Identical slab/remains prototypes use a shared container lookup, so the intended crypt placement of several relics needs live qualification.

The bleeding slab opens the Amber Temple passage. Kasimir accepts the altar's blood of Zhudun for a key to Patrina's crypt and three moonbeam drops. The existing banshee and Kasimir corpse do not prove a resurrection event.

Rahadin offers eight independent proof requests. Each supplies one physical spectral fortune coin; these items are distinct from wallet currency. Proofs drawn from Ezmerelda, Rictavio or Jander compete with keeping those contacts available for their good-aligned skull rewards.

Each favor commission requires five fortune coins and one exact role scroll together. The animated cloak carries four different scrolls and also has a shop role. Active accounting currently blocks buying; supplied existing scrolls still qualify. Native giving enforces no class or faction prerequisite.

Fortune services consume one coin for potions or equipment chests plus cash and experience. These remain visible support deliveries without extra achievements. Ezmerelda's paid card reading and Izek's paid dues use wallet offerings and remain unavailable under active accounting.

Ezmerelda's twelve card faces form a conversational loop: raven, moon and mists lead through blood, rose and chalice to bat, mirror and gate, then castle, coffin and candelabra return to the opening faces. Replies are stateless; keywords do not complete quest steps or establish a paid reading session.

Blinsky accepts any one of five exact clockwork artifacts as a single recovery request. His stocked toy woman supports a separate Izek request. Izek also accepts two different wines and Ireena's comb for distinct rewards; his toy reward key has no confirmed door or container target.

Wolf, human, bat and gaseous Strahd forms are independently reset creatures. The wolf statuette, two memory switches, dimension door and coffin mechanisms provide alternate passage routes. The gaseous form carries the exact skull; receipt does not prove a personal kill or a sequence of transformations.

Choose a skull recipient: Ezmerelda, Rictavio or Jander. Their equipment rewards differ, and each contact disappears after delivery. Promised room keys, restored sunshine, party departure and permanent liberation are not corresponding native outputs or recorded world changes.

Explore the crypt names, coffin-and-lid escape switches, Tomescu's Blood Rift portals, Sergei's portcullis and marble sword, and Dhavit's speech door. Say dhavit from the northern side or utherlan from the southern side to unlock that door, then open it. Some Blood Rift portals release enemies instead of transporting you.

Sasha's journal describes the Dayheart and Sunsword as history and intended vampire preparation. It is optional lore, without a verified Dayheart destruction or Sunsword quest outcome. One skeleton search mechanism targets an absent exit, and Sasha's alternate epitaph switch has no ordinary placement; those routes need builder repair.

Carry all offering items directly. Readiness and optional earlier receipts award nothing. Eighteen repeatable story/request groups are potential daily candidates; mode-zero disappearing contacts are story-only. Daily eligibility does not promise available stock or contacts. Active source-generation support must be qualified for a playable journey.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore a mining village and its silverworking, gem cutting, jewelry setting and magical-necklace leads. All twelve native exchanges are support services, with no quest or daily achievements. Several advertised recipes disagree with their current contracts. Active, ready accounting is required; paid exchanges remain guarded.
orientation: Surface hills reach the village approach from the south and west; two southeastern mine exits connect to the Underdark. A further eastern branch points to an unavailable old-world destination. Check an actual open route before travel.

The intended crafting story runs from silver ore to five pure bars, a plain necklace, five cut gems, a set necklace and a rare platinum disc, then rainbow enchantment. Current recipes disagree with that sequence. This journal explains the actual exchanges and their blockers instead of promising the intended outcome.

Ten raw-gem kinds share a visible name and aliases. Silver ore and pure silver bars are separate kinds. Current material checks distinguish exact kinds and quantities; five interchangeable-looking gems need not satisfy a five-copy contract.

Ordinary and magical gem-set necklaces share a visible name. The magical kind holds rainbow charges and is currently created directly by the five-raw-gem service. A current receipt does not replace an unequipped necklace after it has been used or consumed.

Real gold ore and pyrite also share a visible name. Real gold and pyrite are separately declared in eastern ore shafts. Only real gold matches the current magic-shop contract, whose required disc is unavailable.

The disc rumor describes a ranger, forest and kobold suspicion. It does not establish an active foreign recovery route, item grant or personal-source achievement. A similarly described foreign disc has a different identity and cannot substitute in the current recipe.

Current carried-material checks are optional preparation aids. Supplied matching items fit without prior crafting, personal mining, a paid rumor or learned keywords. No check proves first recovery, and no service receipt earns a quest achievement.

All twelve paid native exchanges remain unavailable under active accounting. Carrying every visible material does not override the payment guard, missing disc or missing jewelry rewards. Recipe repairs and safe payment integration need qualification before a fresh journey.

Gem and ore declarations, merchant inventories and alternative foreign or random-effect sources are leads. Caps, actual stock, custody and accepted acquisition still matter. Ordinary skill mining is guarded while item accounting is active and is different from picking up predeclared ore.

Guild teaching, class gates, shops, room rental, town justice and guard keys are separate support systems. Four named guildguard prototypes have gate procedures but are not placed by local resets; the cleric teacher occupies his gate position. Access rules need a deliberate builder review.

The stable lists a cave-spider hireling in its adjacent storage room. Pet purchase, rental and claim operations are guarded under active accounting. The old claim path reports a return without restoring the pet and needs repair before it can support a quest step.

The dump is also guarded while accounting is active. Drunken chatter and janitor pickup are ambient behavior. Orc, giant, beast and mine danger descriptions contain no local accepted rescue, clearance or village-defense outcome.

story_mappings.introduction: Help Malok recover Parka, gather four offerings for the spirit's weapon, bring the corporal the deserter's scalp, and consider Justunian's three independent trophy exchanges. The blacksmith's two-skin vest is a service. Exact materials prepare a turn-in; acceptance records its outcome. New progress requires active, ready accounting.
orientation: The Battlefield contains the military outpost, castle and cavern approaches, old temple, ruins and the separate demon-lord passages. Entering the zone discovers it; it does not guarantee that every giver or route is accessible. These requests can be pursued independently, using actual doors and fixed portals.

ASK halfling about parka, rat or quest. Malok accepts the exact dead rat named Parka for a leather quilt. A minotaur soldier declares limited rat-item stock. Supplied exact custody also fits. Returning Parka is an accepted item request; the native item is food, and the exchange does not revive, escort or rescue a living animal. Eating the item is a different action and spends the offering.

ASK blacksmith about snakeskin, skin or eq. Two distinct copies of the exact snakeskin together make one snakeskin vest. The two king cobras declare stock with a shared cap of two. Carry both skins loose; one skin, a different skin or the finished vest cannot complete this service. Making this armor contributes no story achievement or daily quest credit.

ASK spirit about quest, mist, cross, skull or cloth. Bring all FOUR exact offerings together: swirling mist, a holy cross, a skull and abominable cloth. The spirit gives the holy longsword Righteous and departs. Its words about protecting the temple and defeating demon lords explain the story; the recipe checks four objects rather than three personal kills or a completed rescue.

The humming orb carries the exact mist; a skeleton warrior carries the skull; the cloth is declared loose in the ruins. The holy cross is inside a locked static-charge container, with its exact key carried by a cleric zombie nearby. The container also permits native PICK or KNOCK attempts under their actual rules. A supplied key, permitted alternate opening or another player's prior opening can provide access; your personal key-recovery or unlocking history is not an extra turn-in requirement.

ASK corporal about deserter or quest. The corporal takes the exact soldier's scalp for the declared bloody scalp reward. The deserter carries the scalp, but matching supplied custody also fits. The item exchange does not require your own kill or establish a separate battlefield victory.

ASK justunian about book, medallion or hammer. His three requests are independent: Minanupoli's black magic book gives a white magic book; the unholy crystal medallion gives a holy medallion; the large war hammer gives SkullSplitter. Any one can be accepted without the other two. The three rewards are not steps required to finish one larger mandatory quest.

The black magic book is carried by Minanupoli, the unholy medallion by Bor'Vongonkiliu, and the large hammer is equipped by Kalisteritax. Exact trophy identities matter. Remove worn or held trophies into loose carrying before offering them. Gifts fit without personal demon-lord kills, and a reward received from another source does not prove Justunian accepted a trophy.

Use TOUCH for the altar, the paired demon-lord statues and the cosmic orb. Use ENTER for the spiraling portal, secret sphere, beam of light and swirling vortex. Their fixed destinations form distinct approaches and return routes. The local tower's spoken-word descriptions do not define a native magic-word lock; no invented password or portal-use achievement is required.

The outpost's north gate uses a solid steel key with a break chance. Its declared stock belongs to an orc sentry following the minotaur captain; it is not carried by the captain. Already-open shared routes and native permitted alternatives remain valid. Doors, search clues, travel and the waterfall hazard explain access without becoming quest receipts.
Grungish offers a separate jewelry-forging service with eight choices and a coin fee. That service is currently unavailable. The blacksmith's two-skin vest uses its own request and materials.

Current exact loose custody is preparation. Worn, held, nested, eaten, spent or handed-away materials do not satisfy those preparation rows. Reward possession, spoken keywords and weapon effects do not prove acceptance. Six stories contribute achievements and potential dailies; the vest remains a service. A departing spirit still needs a qualified later return and fresh offerings. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting; shared access and scarce stock determine played availability.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore Torrhan's lost sailor, royal potion deliveries, dragon cloth and restored sword stories. Eight independent outcomes sit beside fourteen support exchanges and four refusals. Earlier producers and current materials explain routes without requiring personal recovery. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The city has Surface Realm approaches at the stone highway, ship-store waters and eastern Rhanale Forest. Discovery opens this zone journal; named stories and contacts still depend on encounters. The administrative dispersal room is not an ordinary player entrance.

Aineila at the end of the pier and the wounded elf in the forest cabin describe the same engagement ring. A hidden forest key opens the stationary box in the loft. Take the exact ring from the box and give it to Aineila. Her departure narrates the reunion, without an implemented escort or cure.

Marthona in the hidden city room describes a green dragon and suspicious royal behavior. Green dragonscales produce fuzzy pink socks and a secret-beach clue. Translucent cloth is returned as wrong proof. The clue does not unlock an exit or prove travel.

The secret eastern route from the beach reaches ledges with configured falls. Ladder exits provide a return route. Finding or using these exits does not create journal history; their current state and hazards need actual travel qualification.

The owl lady lives in a hidden hollow tree off Rhanale Forest. The boy and curious halfling each consume her same white feather for independent rewards. Source caps and her potion-story retirement affect availability; neither request requires a personal kill.

The full yellow potion is hidden inside a laboratory shelf. The laboratory seashell exchange produces a purple potion and shark skin gloves, despite its random-potion wording. Blue and purple potions are refused by the owl; the half-empty yellow potion is also a different kind.

Full yellow potion to owl lady gives a princess seal and half-empty yellow potion, then removes her current appearance. Half-empty potion to King Torrhan gives a reward crown and keeps him present. Either delivery accepts supplied material without requiring the other receipt or a Zrilxa kill.

The potion dialogue describes a princess rescue and royal cure. Those accepted exchanges record their exact materials and rewards. No persistent princess replacement, king cure, escort, demon defeat or returned-home state is implemented by these recipes.

The palace entry guard carries the iron gate key. A particular guardian enchantress carries the golden key for the throne-level hallway door. A black key comes from one troll declaration in the Tower of Uncertainty; a blue key comes from one greater demon in the queen's chamber. Check the actual appearance and item.

Zrilxa carries the glowing key for the Tower of Choices, and a nearby portal enters that tower. The plaque claims one choice, but the configured key has a chance to break rather than guaranteed single use. Choosing, unlocking and moving are separate actions with no recorded branch decision.

The mighty throne is a push-triggered switch, but its current target is an already-open hallway exit. It does not implement the described throne opening. The throne-room northern route currently loads as an ordinary open connection; a reviewed native repair must settle the intended access and return behavior.

The tailor in the underground drow city wants cloth carried by the translucent dragon. Its source declaration is in a holding chamber with real connecting exits, not an exitless room. Current appearance, roaming and access still need qualification. Supplied cloth also crafts the first cloak.

The tailor's eight cloak forms share the same visible name and mostly the same keywords, but their native properties differ. Each reworking consumes the current form and produces the next; the eighth returns to the first. These support exchanges give no additional quest or daily achievements.

Torrok accepts only restored Oblivion. The patrolling underground guard's thick steel longsword is the correct raw kind for Thurdorf, while ordinary steel swords with the same lookup aliases are different. Supplied Oblivion works without a restoration receipt. The mask reward does not prove its later use.

Thurdorf also polishes a dull bracelet and helmet. The fisherman exchanges a dirty seashell and original shark tooth earring for different jewelry. These are support recipes; current custody is separate from producer history, and competing consumers do not duplicate spent materials.

Guilds, epic constitution teaching, inn rental, ordinary shops, fishing and ship/crew operations retain their own rules. Nirrel's ambient blizzard and Mimir thoughts, the aging woman's rumors, the graveyard and palace lore do not create automatic taught-skill, learned-keyword or cleared-area achievements.

story_mappings.introduction: Expose the intruder’s tablet, choose how to use Mahr’s recommendation, return Mande’s robes or the General’s head and memoirs, and follow Troggahn’s egg through the podium ring and poison to the helmet-case key. Tel’s recommendation rejection is a supporting exchange, not an achievement.
orientation: The surface temple and the underworld Clan Stealth Hunter outpost are separate parts of this area. The temple has an open tundra approach. The outpost also connects to Clan Stoutdorf through a secret passage; a recorded recommendation is not an access requirement.

Follow the intruder’s tablet to Mahr’s recommendation, then choose how to use the note. Tel rejects and replaces it; the upset disciple consumes it for experience and a clue. Neither exchange admits you to the order. Exact supplied notes can skip the earlier tablet exchange.

For the outpost wall, read its inscription and SAY Khildarak. The switch removes the blocked north passage. The guardians’ black key opens the gates; the guild officer’s thin key opens the short-hallway door. Both keys normally break after a successful unlock; another copy may be needed after the doors reset.

PUSH the statue at the short hallway to expose the underground tunnel. PUSH boulder at the secret lair approach, then SEARCH for the west entrance. On the second-floor landing, PUSH tapestry, then SEARCH for the north helmet-room entrance. SEARCH again on the secret return side if needed. Switch activation, finding an exit and actual travel are separate actions.

Troggahn’s egg supplies the priest’s bone key. Unlock and open the dining-room podium to recover the hidden exact ring, then bring it with the assassin’s poison to the adviser. His rib bone unlocks the stone case; open the case and retrieve the battle helmet separately. Exact supplied rings can skip the egg/key route.

The General’s named head is already loaded as a hidden held trophy. Doss needs Mande’s loaded robes, and the General needs Kirrb’s exact hidden tome. Search source bodies and recover exact items loose. Current possession, first personal recovery, another player’s handoff and a source kill are different facts.

The egg has competing requests in Jade and Winterhaven; the elder ring has local and rare Alatorin sources sharing a world cap of one. Missing stock, traps, breakable keys and departed singleton recipients can limit a journey. A daily request does not guarantee renewal or replace a spent item.

The tablet’s ten-minute instructions, Father Tel’s meditation lesson, admission into the order and narrated poison revenge have no accepted campaign ending or timer in this journal. Questions provide guidance, without granting an achievement for every keyword. Every new journal or credit update requires active, ready accounting.

story_mappings.introduction: Follow the rivalry among Moreg, Dura and Tala, bring Glub the killer’s sword, and recover Gimbatul’s pouch before gathering four distinct planar components. Keep real access keys, the trapped letter desk, recipient availability and paid crafting visible as separate steps.
orientation: Arrive from the Trukt tunnels at the outpost, or from the Surface gravel path through the cave passage. The small hole between the two cave ends is a secret closed door: search and open it when needed. The staff fast-track room above the inn is not a normal player entrance.

The town has upper and lower streets joined by ladders. The Street of Guilds leads to the academy, conjurer classroom, temple and inn; the Street of the Dead leads to the cemetery and guards’ barracks. Doorways, guards, shops and training do not by themselves create quest achievements.

Moreg accepts Dura’s exact hidden severed-head item for a lockpick called the key to Moregeeth and 10,000 copper. He also wears Pig-Sticker, the weapon Glub wants. Consider Moreg’s turn-in before recovering that weapon; supplied exact items skip personal kills and routes.

The cemetery caretaker carries the rusty key to the sepulchres. Glub accepts Pig-Sticker for a spectral sword and leaves. His promise to hunt the killer in the netherworld is narration, without a separate tracked hunt. The cemetery’s secret slab leads to Tala’s guild.

Gimbatul’s component pouch is in the open stone table beyond the academy’s locked northern private-room door. The sticky key carried by the resident in the sign room on the Street of Harlots opens that door; the academy side is pickproof. The pouch is a potion-shaped quest item, not a container of loose components.

Return the pouch to Gimbatul for the magical key. Unlock and open the pickproof upper classroom door to the Chamber of Portals. Current keys explain access, while an already open route or supplied exact components does not require your own earlier key receipt.

The Chamber of Portals has four routes: STARE flame for fire, ENTER oval mirror for earth, TOUCH crystal for water, and ENTER circular mirror for air. At the respective arrival points, STARE flame, PUSH boulder, TOUCH crystal, and SOUTH through the smoke return to the chamber. Read the destination before choosing a route.

Recover the fire pendant worn by the efreeti scout, stone heart held by the dao noble, watery ring worn by the marid noble and sylph’s wings worn by the jann. Present all four exact kinds together. Four copies of one kind cannot replace the set; equipped items must be removed before offering.

Gimbatul leaves after making the elemental crown. While he is present, finish any desired pouch return or paid obsidian enchanting first. The paid enchantment needs the exact sharp obsidian dart stocked by the roguish merchant plus 10,000 copper; other obsidian objects do not satisfy it.

Tala wants Dura’s short letter to Ungal, found inside the closed, locked and trapped desk in the assassin combat room. Search and open the hidden gaming-room trap door or abandoned-hovel panel to reach the rogue guild. PICK desk or knock can attempt the repaired lock; DISARM desk handles its opening trap separately. Obtain and examine the exact letter.

Tala returns Dura’s head with a refusal. The drinking woman returns a bottle of rot gut with a nonterminal response. Neither exchange is a new story achievement. Tala’s letter reward is zombie flesh; her threatened spectre transformation has no separate confirmed campaign outcome.

The shamanic merchant crafts a necklace for five distinct bat skulls plus 500 copper. The five bats in the cave by the lake each start carrying one skull. Surface-passage bats and guano in the recess are different sources. This paid craft and the obsidian enchantment grant no story achievement or daily credit.

Gorblag in the academy and Gorblog in the illusionist tower each accept five copper for a plastic package. These coin-only supporting services, ordinary purchases, training, inn rent, bank services and bartender world quests remain separate systems. Described bribes, vault entry and enslaved people have no additional local accepted campaign.

Keep questions, recovery, access, current loose materials and accepted outcomes distinct. Only five qualifying exact exchanges grant local quest outcomes; discovery has its own achievement. Active, ready accounting is required for all new discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit. Frozen reward recovery remains separate.
