story_mappings.introduction: Trace Timmy’s letter from the ruined farmhouse to his mother, explore the wildmage tower, and follow the raiders’ requests for exact materials. Keep five different heads, two independent uses of scarce alloy, real access keys and the portable rift visible as separate steps.
orientation: Follow the Surface foothills path south into the open fields. Timmy’s damaged farmhouse is reached with ENTER farmhouse, and ENTER door returns to the fields. His mouse form is not a promise of a completed transformation or rescue.

Two independent requests consume dark mithril: Timmy needs one bar to write home, while the professor needs another bar together with the crunching torture box. The raider weaponsmith’s bar is uncommon; one earlier receipt or one spent bar cannot satisfy both. Bars in the laboratory description are scenery.

Timmy’s letter can be returned to his mother when she emerges into the Scorched Valley stable. She can wander, and Timmy can be absent. An exact supplied letter skips Timmy’s earlier alloy exchange. His mother’s acceptance is a Fields Between outcome even across the zone boundary; neither receipt proves a reunion.

Climb the bramble hill to the locked southern tower entrance. The sorcerer walrus-giant carries the thorny key, which survives ordinary unlocking. This entrance can also be picked; access through an open door needs no personal key history. The tower’s study, laboratory, kitchen and lower wildmage doors are visible and closed.

For the brewer, recover the exact manuscript worn as a shield by the tower’s monkeys and the banana clump carried by the octopus cook. Bring both together. The hungry ape, loose quills and paper are not their sources. Ask the bored troll brewer about food or book; the bored ogre raiders are different actors.

Grog wants five different hidden head items: elements, nature, creatures, space-and-time and great wildmage. Bring all five together. Their similar names do not make them interchangeable; ordinary carved heads do not substitute. Supplied exact heads need no personal kills or earlier tower journey.

The vampire outside the great wildmage’s chamber carries the spiral key. It survives ordinary unlocking of the locked southern pickproof door. The thorny key fits the tower entrance instead. Inside, TOUCH the rune-covered stone belongs to the epic system, and the memory supports a foreign Winterhaven request.

The small circular rift remains fixed on the floor of the space-and-time wildmage’s room. Its ordinary pickup route is unavailable. The living dimensional-rift creature on the stairs does not drop a portable copy. ENTER the fixed rift reaches a looping dark place; ENTER gateway returns to the fields entrance. The shaman’s delivery request currently has no verified ordinary source.

Grog’s orc shaman bodyguard accepts that exact small rift for a band of the winds. Offering consumes the rift; use it before offering if you want its journey. His promised departure has no separate confirmed escape. The coil carried by the dark beast beyond the rift has no local accepted exchange.

A secret break in the foliage connects the overgrown fields eastward into the raider woods. SEARCH and open it when needed. In the camp, the ruffian at the bar carries Grox’s orders and the mess-hall cook carries the seasoned boy’s body. Deliver both together. Grog’s eastern hut door is separately closed.

The professor asks for the torturer’s crunching box and a dark-mithril bar as inspiration for tipped boots. His injury and chant are reward narration. The raider smith’s repair talk and vampire’s serving talk do not configure shops; captive wildmages and the wildmagical landscape do not create additional rescue or restoration quests.

The brewer’s fez can be taken to his depressed troll brother in Juiblex’s barracks for a separate foreign reward. Grog’s own head is one of three different heads requested by Tallin’s advisor in Scorched Valley. These foreign receipts keep their owning zones and do not award another Fields Between outcome.

Foreign seekers can arrive in the fields from inaccessible loading rooms: the seeker from Torg belongs to Scorched Valley, while Blaxor and Marvin belong to Juiblex. Their requests do not become local quests because of their location. The great chamber’s described permanent rift has no matching placed portal; use the verified small-rift route instead.

Carry exact materials loose; worn, nested, spent or handed-away copies remain missing. Questions and source recovery explain progress without granting each keyword an achievement. Only accepted exact exchanges record outcomes. Active, ready accounting is required for all new discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit; frozen reward recovery remains separate.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore ruined Nital, the battle for the valley and the temple rift. Nine exact deliveries remain independent, including foreign trophies and the blood-to-rings-to-necklace route. Active, ready accounting is required; personal recovery, access, prisoner state and full campaigns need additional accepted evidence.
orientation: Enter from the surface lava fields and descend to the shield. The mostly formed golem carries its sharp shard key. The battle and ruined village lead toward the gnoll caves and temple. Discovery or holding a key does not prove successful unlocking, safe passage or a completed quest.

The mature white dragon carries the temple key. The black wyrm carries the inner-sanctum key, the many-armed demon carries the vault key, and the demonic advisor carries the final chest key. The blood sits inside the locked, pickproof chest in the vault office. These are separate doors and a separate container; keys are optional route guidance when matching blood is supplied.

The advisor also accepts three independent deliveries: the captive sack, three exact heads, and the bodyguard essence. Killing this carried-key holder can remove the recipient until replacement. Choose a source/recipient episode deliberately; a prior receipt cannot restore a missing character.

Return the heirloom ring from the hazardous demonic pit to Nital's survivor for Tallin's signet. The same pit has the strip of young demon hide. Ground declarations do not prove a personal kill or skinning event, and the ring is not one of the colored rings of perfection.

The frost giant upstairs in the ruined home carries the hefty wiggling sack. Examine the two strange columns downstairs for the legs clue. The sack delivery represents a captive in prose, without an escorted NPC or separate capture state.

Bring the exact local commander head plus Grog's Fields Between head and Zuzon's former dwarven lord head from Torg to the demonic advisor together. Only the tunnel commander carries the accepted head; the other same-named commander carries godly magic. The native recipe is narrower than the clue suggesting either commander.

Tallin's bodyguard has a holding source that leads into Mount Banishment and carries the essence for the advisor. Returning it narrates plans to bring the bodyguard back without actually resummoning him. Foreign encounters and recovery remain distinct from the accepted Scorched Valley delivery.

The collector on the overlook accepts two distinct standards plus the pit hide for one object named two bubbles of blazing energy. His separate dragon-charm request uses the abandoned souvenir cart's contents for a scarf. The flaming demon blocks ordinary players' up command while present. Membership and the battle's outcome are narrative rather than extra checked objectives.

Return godly magic from the other commander to the nervous council advisor in Torg. His holding source leads into that council hallway. The exchange stays owned by Scorched Valley and leaves the recipient present despite the runs-off text; it does not execute the planned curse.

Bring Tallin's blood to the seeker in the Fields Between raider camp for four distinct colored rings. Then offer those four rings together to the wandering wildmage for a necklace. Each delivery has its own outcome; the earlier receipt is optional producer history and cannot replace worn, nested, missing or spent proof.

Enter the dimensional rift from Tallin's chamber to the Abyss; its counterpart returns. The full rod object has lore but no verified active assembly terminal or declared reset source. Tallin, the Queen and Miska do not define an extra battle finale. The worn fog wisp responds to say invisible on a cooldown as an item effect, separate from delivery credit.

Yeenoghu's authored healing and attacks currently reject the server's combat event and are not scheduled periodically. A separate repair must qualify dispatch, callback survival and balance before restoring that behavior. Holding exits and reset caps require live encounter qualification; rare-room prose is not a declared rare reset percentage.

story_mappings.introduction: Bloodstone connects the lost locket and upper prison, royal-ring reward, four distinct amulet quarters, missionary proof and unfinished Numbaca plot. Independent local commissions sit beside distant artifact and alchemy recipes. Discovery and player progress require active accounting. Topic words explain the story; they are not separate achievements.
orientation: The forest and regional approaches lead through glowing spheres to the drawbridge and keep. These portals use enter; confirmed travel is separate from a turn-in receipt. The drawbridge and keep gate are open routes in the reviewed data.

The golden locket lies inside the pregnant corpse at the forest altar, beyond the concealed northern path. Return it to the ailing mage for the upper-prison key. Supplied lockets or keys can avoid earlier history.

Ordinary prison access uses the prison key sold by local tavern contacts. The upper gates use the mage's blue skeleton key. Grey and blue cell keys are separate. Some black-key doors described as locked actually reset closed but unlocked; do not assume every prose barrier needs a key.

A blue fish supplies the reception key to the Forbidden Tower. The mistress supplies or carries the sapphire key for the upper royal chambers. The baron wears the royal ring and carries the fourth amulet quarter; these fund separate exchanges.

The mother, father and Faust supply three different quarters and leave after their rewards. The baron carries the fourth. The high mage requires all four distinct kinds together, despite their identical displayed names.

The captain transforms the missionary's original head into a different same-named head for his wife. Her other exact ingredients include a bloody scalp with no confirmed ordinary producer. Her pendant reward points toward Pellops, but the follow-on exchange is absent.

The fisherman's lizard request supplies Asmond's flute. The old woman's mistress-proof reward mentions Ferris; Ferris's minotaur lyre supplies a captain clue and experience, rather than an amulet quarter. These clues do not themselves record learned topics.

Sabrina requires both baby item kinds at once. The ordinary bloody head returned by the mother is rejection feedback. Delivery of loaded trophies does not prove personal combat, a rescue, freshness or a faction choice.

The ring ladder in the vegetable garden and the tight-passage portal provide routes to the meditation platform's bones, ear and ordinary head. Get offerings out of containers and remove equipment before a native turn-in.

Moldar, Sark, Navift, Fibblefinger and Hedvig have no confirmed ordinary active placements in the reviewed sources. Their recipe guidance is still useful for supplied or recovered stock and later builder integration; verify that the actual recipient is present.

Winterhaven provides plain equipment, ingots, blueprint routes, hilts, armor flints and the binding-orb exchange. Each artifact needs its exact upgraded base and distant components. Several component sources remain unconfirmed; separate recipes keep separate ownership.

Bloodstone's Storm legplates recipe needs rolling thunder and Gaia's blessing. Winterhaven instead requires ten maelstrom components alongside the base, orb and flint. Equal rewards do not imply equal inputs or a shared completion.

Fibblefinger requires six planar essences and five potion kinds for two elixirs. Winterhaven and Alatorin use different recipes for the same reward. The generic attribute-scroll transformation chooses one random kind; Hedvig needs two matching scrolls for each basic earring.

The nine-earring finale costs 500000 copper and is currently unavailable under active accounting. Maelborg's stat shop also refuses active-accounting purchases. The ordinary inn and Cerrio's separate world-quest service have their own service rules, without local story completion.

Fresh reset supply and committed scripted transformations still need qualification. Supplied items can satisfy delivery; inventory readiness, keys, topic words and reward prose do not establish personal acquisition or every earlier stage.

stories.title: The Fisherman's Lizard

story_mappings.introduction: Connect the heart order’s preparation, delivery and return note, help the lost human and cursed dragon, and gather Artek’s exact dragon-and-demon bundle. Six accepted offerings retain independent progress while the journal explains their source routes, shared actors, travel hazards and Winterhaven continuation.
orientation: Active, ready accounting is required for discovery, visible encounters, journals and new achievement/daily credit. Discovering Northern Lakes and Settlements has its own achievement. Questions and current materials explain preparation; the six accepted offerings complete six distinct stories.

The delivery chain runs Maur’s heart → Tamara at office 75409 → bottled heart → Aerin at vestibule 75264 → delivery note → Tamara’s earring and copper. Each accepted handoff is independent. Exact supplied bottles or notes skip earlier personal history without granting the stages you skipped.

Artek at foggy bottom 75391 asks for two separate green scales and the red demon’s amulet together. The green dragon at 75393 wears a scale and the old dragon at cave 75411 carries one. Both scales are the same kind; the offering does not enforce one personally taken from each dragon.

The green dragon also accepts the Ruzdo shaman’s quest vial for a dagger and then leaves. Plan the scale route before that delivery when relying on this dragon as a source. The ordinary golden potion in bookcases is a different item despite its similar name.

The lost human at tavern 75278 accepts the exact scroll held by Syria on lake room 75292, rewards a mace and leaves. Asking about home or recall helps identify the request; it does not create an escort, spell-casting or home-arrival objective.

From Winterhaven 55297, travel south to footpath 75410, then south to frozen-lake approach 75283. The cathedral vestibule 75264 connects north to the separate Teka extension at 75546. Those neighboring areas retain their own discovery and quest credit.

Three Surface connections are 537871 down ↔ frozen passage 75418 up, 537889 west ↔ river 75337 east, and 539488 west ↔ forest 75363 east. Entering this physical zone is distinct from completing any foreign story.

The frozen lakes and rivers mostly use water movement rules. Bron at 75219 declares a canoe; Melbh at 75283 declares a canoe and raft. A carried or worn boat, a suitable flying or levitating ability, or another working movement alternative may help. Boat possession does not prevent a current from sweeping you away.

Creek rooms 75234–75237 and river/falls rooms 75309–75313 and 75331–75338 declare currents. Currents can attempt movement on arrival and while you act; flight or levitation can change exposure. Prepare for the direction, return route and actual movement result rather than assuming safe travel.

The hidden cellar door links 75211 down with 75212 up; the vault lies south at 75213. Hidden floor boards link shed 75248 down with cellar 75249 up. Hidden outer stone gates link 75202 north and 75203 south. These doors reset closed and secret, without a declared key lock.

The secret north exit from well-bottom 75274 leads to frozen passage 75414; its south return resets closed without the same secret declaration. A hidden earthen door links hill trail 75403 east with 75404 west. Finding and opening an available route remain separate from quest receipts.

The cathedral ladder at 75266 and 75267 and the well at 75275 have chances of starting a fall while you act there. The vestibule 75264 has a healing flag, while bridge 75392 is single-file. No local room has a safe flag; scenery, recovery and movement support do not promise safety.

Artek’s inspiring dragon visage is accepted by Aevenyl at the Bronze Griffon in Winterhaven 55161 for a silken backsheath of flight and 250000 experience. That is Winterhaven’s separate request. Local visage custody or Artek’s receipt does not complete it.

All six deliveries remain potential dailies under the existing classification. Actual renewal depends on admitted materials, caps, recipient presence and active accounting. The lost human and green dragon leave after acceptance; an old receipt does not recreate either actor or refill spent supplies.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore Rogue Plains, its tribal stronghold, undead camp, giant summit and demon realm. Seven story outcomes cover all nine local exchanges. Active, ready accounting is required. Supplied exact proof remains valid; words, source recovery, access and actual effects need separately qualified events.
orientation: Meet actual recipients before asking addressed words. Sijona answers hi/hello; the reaper answers hi/hello and staff. The other recipes are explained by native descriptions and journal guidance; do not invent a keyword achievement or an unimplemented NPC reply.

The mediator has two independent requests. Recover the lost medal from the obelisk for bracers, or gather one cloud promise and one storm promise for the hammer. Obelisk access uses the persistent obsidian key from Mabus or successful lockpicking. A supplied medal fits without carrying the key or recording an unlock.

The two tribal witchdoctors supply different silence-potion kinds with identical names. Either kind fits either giant. Give one potion to the cloud giant and a separate potion to the storm giant for two different promises. Both recipes for each giant share one outcome; consuming one potion cannot supply both giants.

Cloud and storm promises have identical visible names but distinct identities. The mediator requires one of each; a supplied matching pair fits without personally collecting either promise. His dialogue promises a sword, while the native reward is the hammer of titankind. This mismatch is pending builder review.

The wandering orc needs four different buffalo-flesh kinds, then gives two hides and leaves. A common kind has several sources; three rarer kinds come from different buffalo instances in the southern and eastern plains. All look identical, and not every buffalo carries every kind. The journal labels source kinds separately. The flesh is currently typed as a cure-light potion despite meat prose; changing that is a pending native decision.

The hiking boots are worn by one stronghold sentinel. The sage trades them for only part of his soul. Bring that exact soul plus finger bones from one hand of death to the reaper. Supplied souls fit without the boots history. The staff-named reward is a create-dracolich wand; its spell needs a sufficiently powerful corpse in the same room, valid form and available control capacity. Receipt or device activation alone does not prove raising a controlled dracolich or fulfilling the sage's climb.

Sijona points to Balance in Myrabolus. The chieftain, archnecromancer and Mabus carry light, undeath and evil tokens. Balance on the Myrabolus pier accepts one of each for four rewards under a foreign-owned contract. This local journal provides referral guidance without duplicating credit or treating possession as personal defeat of all forces.

Find and open the secret cliff, corpse-mound and summit routes. Their resets are secret and closed rather than locked or blocked. The corpse-mound wording does not add a magical block. The locked obelisk and altar are separate containers; the altar's persistent bone key comes from the archnecromancer. Key possession is not successful passage.

The pit enters the Styx, and two yurts enter interiors with ordinary exits. Three identically named flaming portals in the demon chamber lead to different plains locations. Actual portal identity and return route matter; a name match alone cannot identify the intended destination. No portal or arrival achievement is implemented here.

Cloudscape entry permits flight or levitation, but horizontal movement out of an air-plane room requires flight; levitation alone only supports vertical exits. Mounted travel checks the mount. Set effects, aerial arrival and a safe return need actual accepted effects and movement events.

Two R resets create the horselords' mounts. Equipment and inventory following R targets the mount; the patrol witchdoctor is a follower. Keva, the windtalker, Lifebane and the lich have ordinary resets in connected staging rooms and can wander. Source descriptions refer to load origins, not guaranteed current rooms.

The Master sigil has a real worn periodic procedure and an alternative foreign source with a shared stock cap. Its direct legacy procedure counts matching worn slots, caps at six, and adds benefits starting at two pieces. A separate adapter table lists an eighth member, but the sigil is directly assigned to the legacy path. Equipping one sigil is not proof of a full set or actual durable effect.

Two surface approaches are reciprocal. A separate northern exit names a room absent from the active static world inventory and present only in historical data; qualify the deployed assembly before selecting any repair. This optional boundary does not make the two existing approaches absent.

All nine native contracts retain potential daily shape, while grouping each giant's alternative recipes leaves seven authored candidates. Orc retirement, reset conditions, shared stock, recipient survival, access and ready accounting still govern actual repeats. Hides have trapper prose but no observed continuation; no full-zone Balance or Master campaign terminal is invented.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore Ultarium and its mountain camp: seven independent story outcomes, including recoveries, offerings and a four-soul seal, plus eight optional support-service rows. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: Loaded Surface Realm approaches reach the sky-city road and the mountain camp on Darkstone Island. They discover one shared area, while each contact still needs an encounter. The stories have a useful suggested order without a mandatory campaign sequence.

The foreman's blueprint clue leads to papers nested in a wounded-runner container in the mine. Enter the cave at the mountain crevice; its ladder has falling hazards. Remove the papers into top-level carrying and return them to the construction engineer. No living-runner rescue is implemented.

The elderly engineer's separate request uses siege-golem plans nested in a skeleton in the harpy settlement. The local blueprint return is independent and cannot substitute. Supplied exact plans satisfy either native request without a personal recovery history.

The recovered planetary study and its onward delivery copy have identical names but distinct object kinds. The local scholar records the first exchange; Xavier in Myrabolus owns the later delivery receipt. Possessing either output alone records neither quest.

Fortress progression uses three exact keys: Grudat's sunstone key opens the outer gates, an antechamber carrier has the oblong stair key, and a parapet carrier has the council key. The smuggler needs a separate security key. Current key checks are optional guidance, not proof of historical access.

The four council members carry four different souls. The director pays a halo only for Zeenium's soul; his other three independent offerings consume their soul without declared rewards. Any donation competes with the box's simultaneous four-soul collection and does not establish permanent council defeat.

Touch the oracle orb to reach the immaterial prison and its NPC box; north returns to the oracle. The box has a 50-percent reset declaration. Acceptance of all four distinct souls grants bracers, robes, gloves and an Ultarium memory. Reward use and world liberation need separate accepted events.

The raw and wearable wisps of living wind share a name. Raw proof comes from a covenant windkin with a 33-percent reset declaration. The windwalker accepts it for the wearable counterpart. Neither possession nor the companion-loss text proves a personally recorded kill.

The dwarven camp offers six independent trapper barters and a hydra-scale gorget service. Foreign trophies have exact sources, caps and possible holding/dispersal routes. The trapper's emblem is a reward for the heart, without an enforced trust prerequisite for other trades.

Two pushable boulders open opposite sides of a secret blocked cliff passage. The warp platform uses stomp to return to the city entrance. These actions, the magical fountain, epic stone, class teachers and griffon services have their own mechanics and no new journal milestones without accepted evidence.

Paid rename, pet purchase/rental/claim and epic skill purchases remain guarded while accounting is active. Native item offerings remain available subject to supported settlement. Exact gifts are valid for delivery without manufacturing personal acquisition, learned topics, travel, faction or full-stage completion.

story_mappings.introduction: Jade connects rice-field work, wild creatures, family proofs, royal audience and a rescue at sea. Discover the Empire and meet its people to reveal their journal requests. Deliveries record their exact outcomes; personal sources, battles, access and escort need their own evidence. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: Start with the city streets, eight rice paddies, tool shed and long pier. Five current rice portions make a harvest bag; the wheel below the wheelhouse turns that bag into ground rice. Supplied exact ingredients work without that preparation history.

Choose how to use each ground-rice portion: the kite-flyer makes a hat, the chef makes sushi, and the bartender makes a drink. The mystic can enchant the hat or a simple necktie for 10,000 copper each; those paid enchantments still need accounting support.

The hunter wants four exact boar-meat strips together. Giving the giant boar hide instead is an upsetting rejection that removes him. The word fresh in an item name does not add a freshness clock or require your own kill.

Enter the tool shed to recover the knife from its shelves. Give it to the entangled coastline turtle to receive a carried turtle. That turtle can pay the chef's soup or the tamer's two-silver-ore exchange; one copy cannot pay both.

The gardener combines one emerald-rose seed portion, two orchid-seed portions, one bonzai seed and one lilac-seed portion. Search the appropriate plants and remove their seeds from the containers. Rose seeds are outside the royal audience door; an audience key is not required for that source. Snapdragon seeds and cherry blossoms are not accepted.

The tamer sells giant nets for 10,000 copper; that purchase still needs accounting support. Give an available net to the alpha razorback or dark outlaw for the corresponding captured item, then deliver that item to its reward recipient. Captures become carried items rather than following creatures, and nets dissolve when dropped.

For the hidden cave, push the stone switch at its secret approach. Scralack carries the blood-red key and the cave bin contains the signet ring. His key opens the assassin guild but breaks on use; the separate Winterhaven entry reaches the guild attic. The soldier of fortune rewards the ring and departs, without a declared army-return finale.

The shifty orc's dice-shaped key fits the secret Tigerlily doorway to Feng Cho and the outlaw. A hydra heart plus Feng Cho's finger earns the Daimyo's invitation. His heart-only briefing returns a new heart and is optional. The bushi exchanges the invitation for the emerald royal key; use that key for the Emperor's room.

The high priest wants four distinct directional relics. The eastern relic is carried by Agaures' physical projection beyond the cave mirror; the western relic is inside an obsidian-keyed obelisk in the Rogue invasion. The northern eye and southern Nansuo use foreign load rooms and movement. Supplied exact relics qualify without those journeys.

The sobbing woman wants the heirloom inside the hive mother's bones. Kobe Chi's mark goes to the chamberlain; Kyan Itsu's medallion goes to the Bloodstone delegate. Each proof is an independent delivery, and legends or load positions do not guarantee personal combat or availability.

Ask Macavor about mande and troggahn. Mande's head comes from the Oda barracks; Troggahn's egg is carried by the black dragon below Father Tel's Holy Cloister. Bring both together. Mande's robes and other egg requests remain separate foreign paths.

The metalsmith combines attic electrum and wyrm-carried adamantium into electium. Weapon and armor commissions each consume a separate bar, the matching template and 10,000 copper. The weapon template is in the tool-shed shelves; the armor template is inside harbor cargo crates. Paid commissions, the separate forge menu and mining still need accounting support.

The royal rescue continues in the neighboring ship-battle area. Marn carries the brig key in the den beneath the pier, reached by pushing the pillars. Miu Pai carries a different set of keys on the Lacedon helm. The keyless locked helm trapdoor has an alternative underwater route through the secret cargo porthole; the brig key opens the princess's cell.

Give Miu Pai's set of keys to the captive princess for her royal token, then bring the token to the Emperor. A supplied token skips the rescue preparation. The token delivery does not prove the brig unlock, your own fighting or an escort back to the palace. The ambassador separately accepts the purse from the huge olyx in the neighboring fields.

The lost legionaire accepts a Jade map. The neighboring halfling's purchase costs 50,000 copper and still needs accounting support, while the legionaire pays 10,000 copper and experience. The mystic's white silk belt exchange has no declared outcome and earns no journal credit.

Fresh supplies depend on available stock, appearance chances and recipients. Carry exact current offerings outside equipment and containers. Supporting cooking, crafting, capture and access exchanges stay visible without adding separate quest achievements or dailies; journal reads and readiness checks award nothing.

story_mappings.introduction: Follow eight independent captive rescues, gather eight cut bindings for Beregan, and deliver three exact invader hands to Jandar. Side quests include the monkey, neckchain, badge and dog. All seventeen exchanges are explained; availability gaps are explicit. Active, ready accounting is mandatory for new journal, achievement and daily credit.
orientation: This is the invaded Desolate zone 773, distinct from normal Desolate zone 222. Discovery and receipts remain independently owned. The initially closed zone is opened by normal Desolate’s random-exit object 22291 at exterior 22200, which can redirect the north route to 77302 and its south return. Source reset chance 20 percent and callback chance 100 percent are different; the live phase and current route need qualification.

Loud orc, goblin and Shady Grove orc start at campground 77358; old and Pinehollow loggers at cabin 77381; monkey hunter at command post 77342; monk and cleric at temple 77435. Each consumes one actual shard and returns bindings, then departs. Beregan in bar backroom 77421 accepts eight current bindings together. His claim that citizens are free is narration, not a check of eight distinct personal rescues.

Shard sources include hidden container stock in garbage 77360 and trapped weapon pile 77457, and nomadic merchant 77408 at 77432. Repeated reset lines retain shared caps and do not guarantee fresh stock. No-exit room 77465 is explicitly a shard-load check room; it is not a player recovery destination. Normal Desolate items do not substitute.

The hunter’s monkey-return exchange and shard rescue are independent. Return the monkey before retiring the hunter if you want both. The monkey is a closed item container in bear den 77394; its hidden neckchain is minotaur proof. Remove the chain before consuming the monkey so the nested item is not lost with the container.

Minotaur 77327 starts at garbage pile 77360 and rewards bronze key 77311. It unlocks the fixed chest there, which holds money, trophy and brass bracelet. Jandar 77319 at master chamber 77370 needs severed hands 77373, 77385 and 77392 from Gromlog 77342, Alboa 77382 and Mackama 77375. These are authored inventory/equipment items, not a CARVE controller. The rewarded black-gate key 77384 fits the paired locked gate at 77343/77361.

Myrabolus delegate and Beregan start at 77421. The scout badge is equipped at 77352; the dog starts at 77428 and wants hidden stinky bones from garbage 77360. NORENT on bones and both reward keys remains intact. Cut bindings require two hands if used as equipment, but are not transient items.

Halfling 77325, wagon driver 77348 and travelling merchant 77380 have no identified local reset. The halfling asks for blade 77331 despite drink narration. Driver wheel 77352 has no identified producer; placed Scotson has no repair recipe here. Keep these builder gaps visible without promising stock or reusing normal Desolate contracts.

The nomadic shop at 77432 lists shard 77326, deep blue potion 77356 and scroll 77388. A stock declaration is not a settled purchase or proof of renewal. The separate travelling merchant’s coin-only quest purchase is guarded under active accounting and earns no story/daily credit. Bank counter 3097 binds storage-locker ENTER service; paid lockers are guarded. Actual inn assignment is tunnel 77442, while 77422’s inn prose says closed; do not assume a functioning tavern service or move the binding.

The hidden Master trial’s PUSH route is chamber 77410 east to Sacrifice 77411, east to Endurance 77412, south to Art 77413, west to Courage 77414, west to Affinity 77415, then north to 77410. Knighthood 77416 branches above Sacrifice. Buttons clear existing blocked exits; current combat guardians and dragon loot are not a completed-trial receipt. Endurance and Courage’s direction captions now match their existing south/west buttons.

Branches at 77386 PULL west; torch at 77364 PULL down and black soil at 77365 PUSH up; barricades at 77453/77454 PUSH down/up. Secret and closed state is separate from clearing BLOCKED. Unplaced rock controls target missing west/east exits and require builder intent. Seven fixed portals retain their existing enter restrictions and return routes; fall fields are risks, not guaranteed quest arrival.

No captured universal first-source, source-versus-gift, control, personal kill, phase episode or full-zone victory fact is invented. Historical accepted exchange rows remain optional, while current exact material and settled terminal outcomes stay separate. Mode2 renewal, actor retirement, hidden sources, shop stock and active accounting’s item-reset refusal still need played qualification before these sixteen potential dailies can be promised.

story_mappings.introduction: Follow Dawndale's refugee preparations, rival ship-captain recipes, hunter and worm deliveries, and Whetstone's foreign forge return. Active, ready accounting is mandatory. Producer histories explain the route without rejecting supplied proof. Three support services and the fossil referral give no achievement or daily credit; source, payment and actual escape/curse effects need qualification.
orientation: The surface has three routes into the valley. Quest descriptions give clues, while addressed questions exist for Drandagger, the smith and Whetstone. Meeting a giver reveals relevant requests; discovering the zone alone does not complete a delivery or award a learned-keyword milestone.

The curator's portrait gives refugee stones; the rock cutter converts them to dust and 250 platinum; the phantom engineer makes an explosive device and retires. A separate key-and-device delivery retires the refugee leader and gives an exquisite moonstone and Longhollow backpack. Supplied exact materials fit without your personal earlier deliveries.

The exiled moon-elf sells the city key for 250 platinum, but that coin-only support purchase remains guarded. Unlocking the city gate retains its zero-break-chance key, which can then be offered in the final refugee delivery. The capital, museum, office and elf-alcove keys are different items; breakable office/alcove keys also require return and reset planning.

At the joined wrecks, each rival captain needs two sunlight vials, dust, rank-water bucket, glowing runestones, witchcraft guide and monkey fur. Choose which bundle to spend; each captain gives his own reward and consumes independent proof. The book describes an incantation, but neither reading it nor reciting words replaces its delivery.

The chemist has three declared sunlight vials, while both captains together need four. The scholar appears only on a fifty-percent declaration and shares a globally capped guide with an administrative library. Accepted supply and renewal need qualification; the journal does not promise that every ingredient is currently obtainable.

Keenfeather accepts the master hunter's exact splintered bow. The orc accepts the warchief's treasure after you open its closed, unlocked sack and recover the contents loose. Other bows, the sack, nearby coin piles and similar rewards do not fit those deliveries.

Ask Drandagger hi, hello, help or assistance. Recover the larvae nest from the rock worm's nest for experience and chainmail. His promised tunneling and the refugees' narrated BOOM do not currently open a new escape route or record a settled party.

Ask the smith lens or telescope, then pile, fine or sand. His clue points to the hidden Aravne sand elemental, whose death produces the exact sand. Sand plus 25 platinum supports a lens commission, but mixed payment remains guarded; possession does not establish your own recovery or a repaired telescope.

Ask Whetstone metal. Recover his hidden electrum near Fossil Rock, take it to Emition in the Home of the Divine, then return the exact forged flute. Whetstone retires and leaves a different same-named flute. The foreign forge history is optional, and his promised visit to Emition is not actual recorded travel.

Push rocks on your side of the narrow rock passage to clear that direction's blockage, then search to reveal the passage and walk through. It is an open secret passage rather than a locked door. The other direction has its own rocks, so qualify return separately. Other secret closed wreck passages need search and opening.

The elf-alcove portal leads to a secluded surface island. Arrival, safe return and access are separate from quest delivery. Cliff and avalanche descriptions contain no reviewed falling-room declaration here; route prose alone does not create a fall objective.

The rock cutter replaces an offered fossil with the same item kind and refers you to an unnamed Ultarium cousin. This is excluded from quest credit and does not multiply supply. Red Star, Mctarvian, captive and great-lens lore have no reviewed additional defense, rescue, bounty or installation outcome.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore ancient graves, upper templar dwellings, an underwater lake, a tower city and a lower settlement of troubled spirits. Five independent delivery or commission outcomes sit beside four preparation/access services; two elder contracts are excluded because one consumes proof without reward and shadows the other. Active, ready accounting is required. Source, payment, access and offering-limit blockers remain explicit.
orientation: The ordinary active entrance connects the ancient stairway to the Underdark. A separate administrative dispersal link reaches the city fountain. Do not confuse an administrative route with ordinary player access.

The descent crosses graves, trapped catacombs, Fire Templar dwellings, an underground waterfall and lake, the city of Neoghtom and a lower settlement. Current and fall metadata, hidden doors and key custody affect the route; prose does not prove successful travel.

The tower support route uses ebony shard plus ten platinum for the southern key, silver shard plus one hundred platinum for a snapped key, then ten platinum for repair. All three paid exchanges remain guarded with accounting active. Two working keys share a visible name but fit different tower doors.

The eastern tower entrance is hidden and locked; finding it is separate from unlocking and entering it. The two working tiny keys are designed to break when used. Do not plan on reusing the earlier key for the later tower.

The ring-to-steel delivery and magical-steel preparation are separate stages. The armor recipe needs two magical bars, two gorgon-scale bags, two rocks, the exact design book, two ebony shards and one genius potion. Its dialogue asks for two potion samples; current terms require one.

The protective-device recipe needs sixteen separate pieces: two chains, two bangles, two rocks, four springs and six gears. The current safe offering limit is fourteen. Matching supplies can be shown as preparation, but cannot make this exchange available or complete it.

Several material sources have one-copy caps despite recipes requiring more copies. One gear ground declaration has chance ten; normal unforced ground resets accept only chance 100. Reset mode zero and retiring or holding-room recipients require episode review. Do not assume a source will replenish for a daily journey.

The park child accepts an exact foreign well-crafted dagger for a scorched letter; the letter recipient returns hair. The elder consumes the hair in a refusal that runs before its ore reward. These deliveries do not establish a king kill, reunion or personal recovery; the blocked elder route needs repair.

A custom soul-collector death procedure creates a guardian carrying a potion. Ordinary potion custody, another player handing it over, personally defeating a source and first accepted acquisition are different facts. Current optional checks establish only unequipped custody.

Getting or taking while the cathedral coin-pile procedure is dispatched can alter doors before any pickup succeeds, including an unrelated failed request. The shadow death procedure opens only one return direction. These world changes are not successful-pickup, access, all-shadow victory or campaign achievements.

Razor-stair, paralysis and sleep traps, equipment effects, local shop stock, ambient warnings and dragon or shadow combat are separately explained leads. They have no invented local quest terminals. Accepted source, effect, travel and campaign events require further integration.

Optional earlier receipts describe one producer route. Supplied matching materials fit without those receipts, personal kills, dialogue history or exploration order. Independent outcomes stay independent; a receipt does not replace an item consumed at a competing recipient.

story_mappings.introduction: Investigate the village raids and missing miners, help a worried mother, and explore the gnome's independent mixtures and the tower challenge. Exact current materials prepare a request; acceptance records its outcome. New progress requires active, ready accounting.
orientation: ASK mayor about mine or insect, then ASK captain about insects for the suspected burrow. ASK foreman or miner about mine, troubles or miners for the disappearances. These conversations explain the routes; neither referral nor every dialogue keyword is a separate achievement or required receipt.

The mayor accepts one exact mantis queen heart and one exact demon ambassador wing together for diamond platemail and a vitality cloak. Carry both loose and offer one of them to submit the full bundle. The proofs have separate sources and access routes. Supplied exact proofs fit without your own kills, prior captain conversation or personal door-opening history.

Search the village's concealed downward passage near its southern wall to reach the burrows. Native searching can reveal the actual shared exit. The royal wall needs the exact royal emblem from a mantis guard captain, or another valid native unlocking or already-open route. That emblem is a key which breaks on native unlocking. It is not one of the mayor's two offerings.

The mines descend through deeper shafts into undead chambers. Their liches and vampires mutter pieces of the tomb name. At the magical tomb gate, SAY mortazoth can unlock the current locked door when speech is permitted; OPEN the tomb if it remains closed. Another player's opening can already provide access. Speaking a name does not prove that you learned it yourself or defeated the ambassador.

ASK weeping about crying or kara for her missing daughter. The native rescue accepts the exact carried girl item from the mine alcove for a ruby ring. This is an item-return request rather than an NPC escort. Carry the girl loose to the mother; supplied custody fits without a personal rescue, miner referral, kill or mayor completion.

ASK gnome about ingredients, potion or potions for five independent mixtures. Fungus alone makes an adrenaline potion; weed+moss+orchid makes green potion; rose+orchid makes swirling potion; moss+weed+rose makes strange elixir; lotus+rose makes sweet smelling potion. Carry each recipe's full exact set loose together. One accepted mixture does not complete the others or leave its spent ingredients available for reuse.

Village garden stock includes lotus, roses, orchids and weeds. Fungus actually has three limited burrow placements; the gnome describes finding it along the southern wall. Moss has limited burrow and mine stock. Search concealed stock where native visibility requires it. Gifts and existing exact stock fit; generic flowers, herbs, diamonds, potion rewards or historical possession do not replace current ingredients.

The tower overseer describes a 100 platinum entrance fee for the exact diamond key. Paid key issuance is a service, separate from winning the tower challenge. The five successive gladiators carry distinct emerald, sapphire, golden, ruby and obsidian keys for its later locked routes. Exact supplied keys, native picking or an already-open route can fit where allowed; paying once is not proof of kills or treasury recovery. The accounting payment adapter still needs qualification before this service is available in an active epoch.

Bargor exchanges the exact remote heart of Bel, orb of unmaking and mystic runed stone tablet together for the Constitution scroll. Other givers consume those same remote materials for different outcomes. The tablet's prose mentions an artifact which Bargor's actual recipe does not require. Its supply and the scroll's claimed stat power remain unresolved; the journal records the declared exchange without promising that reading grants constitution.

Bargor's forge and enchant remarks are ambient speech. His old epic-training table entry does not establish an available enchant lesson or a quest reward. Jallev's weapon lore, ordinary shops, diamonds, the rune stone, the Oasis memory and the alien-looking object beyond the queen remain separate from these accepted requests.

Current exact loose materials are preparation. Worn, held, nested, handed-away or spent items do not satisfy those rows, and holding a reward does not prove acceptance. Limited stock, reset timing, shared doors and other players affect availability. Three story receipts contribute achievements and potential dailies; six services remain visible without that credit. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting; daily eligibility does not guarantee fresh stock.

story_mappings.introduction: The Twin Keeps connect four realms and several independent commissions. Follow Kristigrogg's key route, the ore and crystal recipes, the scouting-message chain, or the Refuge and pirate requests. Each exchange keeps its own reward and history. Discovery and progress require active accounting; source availability and scripted stages still need qualification.
orientation: From ruined Tharnadia, the locked western keep gate uses the city's gate key. The expeditionary leader and an Old Quarter contact offer it for the necromancer's remains; the leader's pouch is another source. The key breaks on use. Rifts and regional approaches can offer other arrival routes.

Kristigrogg trades five claws for the tower key and four distinct same-named life shards for the dungeon key. Tower keys can break while opening the four locked tower approaches; you may need replacements.

The four tower rifts lead to Blackrock Mountain, the Alteran Valley, Blackbeard's island and the Shaeradin Valley. The dungeon's fifth portal leads to the foreign Pit of Dragons. A shown route does not record confirmed travel or a dragon victory.
In Blackrock Mountain, Captain Fizz Thunderfist carries the consumed key to Bostas's High Seat. Bostas carries a life shard and scepter; use separate scepters for separate consumers.

In the Alteran Valley, look for FrostSharn Camp and the two harpy mountains. The warlord contracts accept four distinct hearts, despite head wording. The scouting report is inside the frozen orc corpse on Mount Straka.
Skinjar's report reward leads to Woten's note exchange, CrowFoot's bottled-message delivery and Woten's nether crystal. Supplied intermediate items can skip the producer route.
Jenzuel's recovered bow supplies Hindis's figurine. Deliver the figurine before Hindis's head reward when using the same encounter, because the head exchange removes him.
Trekash's orb leads to Keshia's pirate key. The hidden crevice in the island jungle leads to the locked pirate chest and ether crystal. The key is consumed on unlocking.

In Pirate Cove, pull the massive tied-up crate to open the northward route to the burial cave and captain's key. That consumed key opens the concealed submerged doorway to Blackbeard's remains, chest and life shard.

CrowFoot stays after his egg bounty but leaves after the message delivery. Several other givers also leave after a reward. This area uses epic-triggered rather than ordinary timed resets; do not assume daily replacement.

Thelinnius needs void, earth, nether and ether crystals plus the shadow staff. A concentrated void elemental is another void-crystal source. Earlier exchange history does not replace a spent component.

Ground, carried, equipped and nested sources are distinct. Get offerings out of containers and remove equipment before a native turn-in. Supplied items are accepted; inventory readiness does not establish personal recovery or kills.

Mungir's silverleaf-and-50000-copper payment is currently unavailable under active accounting. Ordinary reset supply also needs qualification. Existing recovered materials and valid receipts can still explain the routes.
Read contacts for useful topic words. Topics, switches, keys, scenery and departures are guidance until their accepted events and outcomes are integrated; each keyword is not an achievement.

steps.hint: FrostSharn grunts carry these exact scimitars in the camp. Bring five for the greenstone orb; another scimitar does not substitute.

steps.hint: Reward: a green orb of mystics, 85000 experience. The giver remains available after the exchange.

steps.hint: His earlier blackrock exchange awards the receipt. A supplied receipt is accepted, and recorded history cannot replace the physical item.
steps.text: Optional: obtain the physical receipt from Marny

steps.text: Carry 1 x a receipt from Marny Taskgulch

steps.text: Bring the mystical figurine to Hindis

steps.hint: His five-scimitar commission supplies the orb. You may deliver a supplied orb without that earlier receipt.
steps.text: Optional: obtain the greenstone orb from Trekash

steps.text: Bring the greenstone orb to Keshia

steps.text: Optional: earn Weskel's earth crystal

steps.hint: Thel'Samar carries the staff of the Shadow Mage atop Dagger Peak. Thelinnius requires this staff alongside four crystals; another staff or a fifth crystal will not substitute.

steps.text: Carry 1 x an ether crystal

The shadow staff is the fifth required item, rather than a fifth crystal. Ore exchanges, moonstone and pirate-message deliveries are optional source routes; supplied components are accepted. The final reward is the staff of Twin Worlds.

steps.hint: Bostas holds this scepter at Strak'Ash's High Seat. Captain Fizz Thunderfist carries the approach key, which breaks on use. Naboriyan and two Alatorin weapon collectors consume separate copies for separate rewards.

Alatorin's weapon collectors also consume the scepter with four other weapons; reserve separate copies for separate rewards.
stories.title: Naboriyan's Moonstone Reward

steps.hint: Recover the report or bring a supplied one. Woten also accepts a supplied note directly.
steps.text: Optional: obtain Skinjar's packaged note

steps.text: Bring the packaged note to Woten

Woten remains available for the eventual ore-to-crystal exchange. Supplied notes qualify; his ambient actions do not provide extra learned-topic achievements.

steps.text: Optional: deliver the scouting report to Skinjar

story_mappings.introduction: Explore the Rift Valley Jungle floor, canopy, bullywug village, lizardman caves, Moonhollow and elemental cages. Twelve story outcomes and twelve supply services classify all twenty-eight exchanges, with three non-credit referrals or rejections. Active, ready accounting is required. Current possession does not prove personal recovery; dialogue, access, effects and combined campaigns need separate accepted events.
orientation: The three Woodseer approaches enter the western jungle; the southeastern trail connects to the current surface. Climb the actual tree routes for canopy sources. Connected load rooms seed wandering actors; a declared load location is not a guaranteed current position. River currents, falls, closed routes and actual movement rules remain relevant. Some exact proofs are secret items: search the source room or opened source container as appropriate. Revealing an item, acquiring it, and handing it in are different events.

Meet recipients before asking addressed words. Dialogue topics explain requests but do not award keyword achievements. Twelve flagged contacts receive generic class-sensitive teacher level guidance; the schoolteacher's name alone does not confer that runtime role. The two bartenders also offer separate procedural world quests.

For the elderly couatl, recover three eggs of the same exact kind from the scattered placement sites, plus the drow hunter's wrist guard. Offer all four loose items together for a burnished bracer. The young couatl returns an egg kind and refers you to the elder; that optional referral earns no separate credit and does not prove the same physical egg survived.

Reiwiggy offers three paid services: two giant-alligator skins for a tunic, two red-alligator skins for armor, or two ordinary tiger skins for tiger armor, each with ten platinum. These mixed payments are currently guarded with accounting active. He refuses white skin; the cave leather-worker accepts it for boots without requiring the refusal first.

Enter the lizardman caves through their actual hidden closed routes. Soft bark becomes a blanket service; canopy red petals finish the painter's pigment request; the strange parchment supplies the engineer. The plans actually load in Moonhollow guard quarters despite his cave clue. No mural or city construction is recorded by delivery.

The cave leather-worker also needs three red-alligator and three giant-alligator skins together for three azurian-hide pieces. Its reward name does not mean azurian hide is an input. The tribal shaman turns leaves into a green potion and dartfrog skin into poison; these services do not prove healing or poisoning a target.

The chief's dialogue asks for Summerstorm's head but accepts his silver amulet, which has a forty-percent load roll. The scout asks for the chief's head but accepts his golden rod, which has a thirty-percent equip roll, and rejects the actual mangled head. The opposing requests are independent; no allegiance lock, raid, kill history or peace finale is enforced.

Recover the crystal-headed staff from the Moonhollow lieutenant and bring it to the woodcarver at his unfinished carving for the crystalline bow. The crystal dragon has an equivalent recipient contract but no active appearance or transformation. Use the reachable woodcarver branch; neither two deliveries nor a recorded transformation is required.

The elemental ranger carries four distinct amulets and can wander out of his connected load room toward the jungle or the separate fire, water, air and earth planes. Recover the actual proofs; his equipped flaming javelin is different from the required flaming medallion. Do not assume he remains in the staging room.

The jungle brazier at 80061 leads UP to the fire cage; the water bowl at 80072 leads UP to water; the mud bowl at 80071 leads UP to earth. Each cage has its DOWN return portal. ENTER the plane of light at 80060 for air, and ENTER its paired plane to return. Portal arrival and survival are not current story steps.

Each elemental accepts its own amulet, gives its own reward and leaves: fire javelin, water drums, air cloak, earth mask. These are four independent outcomes. No recorded relocation to its home plane or combined four-rescue finale is implemented. The decorative iron amulet's four compartments have no native opening recipe.

Teglaron offers four five-platinum services: elder hide → armor; young hide → boots and eyepatch; rare mithril ore → hammer; giant-turtle shell → plate armor. All four mixed payments are currently guarded with accounting active. Killing the elder for hide is not a prerequisite to helping him recover eggs.

The elderly weaver needs five green, five yellow and five red quetzel feathers together for her cloak. Green and yellow stock is on different bright-quetzel instances; red comes from red quetzels. Fifteen loose items exceed the current exchange limit of fourteen, so this story is guarded and has no daily candidate until the complete batch can settle safely.

Recover the ancient silver sword from the chieftain's aid and bring it to wandering Mistwalker for Orcslayer and twenty-five platinum. His ghostly reunion is native narrative; recipient departure does not record a spawned ghost, escort or actual effect. Supplied exact sword fits without personal acquisition history.

Moonhollow's tavern memorial, bereaved villagers, school, songs, Windstrider recipes and Teglaron's fused wall axe explain the world without native quest endpoints. Ordinary shop stock, trophy keys and loot remain separate. Five route descriptions now match their actual exits in a separate repair; ambiguous plot or stock decisions remain pending.

Seventeen native recipes retain potential daily shape; classifying services and the staff alternatives leaves eleven authored story candidates. The feather batch and seven mixed payments remain guarded. Repeat availability depends on real encounters, access, stock, retiring recipients, reset mode two and active, ready accounting. No first-source recovery, learned word or whole-jungle campaign is inferred.

story_mappings.introduction: The chrysloin grow and shape living crystals, but their king fears the imprisoned mage who created them. The rainbow-key route is the local progression story. Colored-crystal shaping, moss preparation and the sage's paid clue are separate services; returned wrong-color offerings are feedback.
orientation: The entrance golem blocks ordinary north passage for levels 21 through 50. Inside, the crystal groves and moss clearings provide exact ground materials. Look for loose stock; descriptions of gems welded to stone do not implement an extra mining or harvest quest.

Match each crystal to its maker: violet for a collar, blue for a shield, green for a javelin and red for an earring. The local chrysloin shaman makes a mossy potion. These services remain separate from the king's story.

A concealed stone path reaches the spire gates. The burly guards' glowing crystal shard unlocks the entrance. Follow the crystal hallways to the throne room and ask the king about his kind, worries and the drow mage. Questions provide guidance, not achievements for every keyword.

A gap below the white crystal farm leads into wet lower caverns. Beyond the brackish-water pool, the hot crystal is a hazardous remote switch: push it to unblock a west passage elsewhere in the lower cavern. The switch itself does not move you or complete a quest.

The lower guardian carries the rainbow crystal key. Its intended death pile is a container, different from old blue remains and wearable shard piles. Recover the exact key, or use a supplied copy; the intact key is not accepted by the king as a finale.

The hidden ceiling trapdoor in the spire leads to the mage's quarters, then a concealed wall reaches his library. His normal ward blocks attacks and casting. Giving him the rainbow key creates exact rainbow shards on the floor and removes him. This custom exchange still needs reliable accounting and failure recovery; the king can accept supplied shards directly.

The sage's 2,000-copper paid clue is optional and currently unavailable under active accounting. Her topic guidance remains useful. The amber and hidden vaults have their own keys and treasures; they are optional exploration rather than king-story prerequisites.

Bring the exact rainbow shards to the king for his mask. Carry offerings directly, outside containers or equipment. Current supplies show readiness; the successful recorded delivery completes the story while accounting is active. It does not prove a personal kill, learned clue or the entire narrated route.

story_mappings.introduction: Choose one surviving thief guild, earn Lord Lenbrea’s trust, and follow his time-portal and vault rewards. Keep the merchant’s paired crate delivery and the captain’s legacy scroll exchange distinct from actual travel, stat gains and epic training.
orientation: Enter from the Surface forest onto the paved road at Ceothia’s southern edge. Cyraes Way connects the town north to south; Trenathal and Asahtoan Ways lead around the merchant square. Ordinary shops, inns and clerks do not grant quest achievements just by being visited.

Ask Lord Lenbrea about hello, legacy, service or town, then task. He wants one thief guild to remain. Choose a surviving leader before collecting the other three different badges; each leader wears their own badge, while ordinary guild thieves do not. Supplied badges skip personal kills and the native exchanges do not enforce a permanent faction choice.

Moonstone waits at the damp alley’s far end, jade wyrm at the lightless alley’s far end. Search and open the secret eastern door in the dim alley for red shadow, or the secret northern door in the smelly alley for violet death. Native closed doors and secret discovery still apply.

All four bargains give the same Ceothian thief-guild badge, with different gifts: moonstone’s platinum eyepatch, jade wyrm’s amethyst bracelet, red shadow’s ruby-buckle belt or violet death’s gold-lined boots. The chosen giver leaves. One accepted bargain completes the shared journal card; its four alternatives are not four required campaign stages.

Give Lenbrea the common badge for the bluestone key and 500,000 copper. Unlock and open the western audience-chamber door to the storeroom; the door is pickproof and the key breaks when used. ENTER the shimmering portal goes to past Ceothia. An open door or supplied later proof bypasses earlier personal history.

Lenbrea separately accepts future Ceothia’s flickering dragon horn for the demonic ogre-warlord sword and 500,000 copper, or the Chronomancer’s thread of time for a glowing vault key. The huge beholder supplies the horn. The return portal in future Ceothia leads back to the present audience chamber. Exact supplied proofs need no personal timeline journey.

The glowing key unlocks the pickproof northern vault door and breaks when used. The vault’s imported glowing pool has its own DRINK agility effect, level requirement and shared two-day pool cooldown. A denied or capped drink is not a positive stat gain; obtaining the key is not proof of entering or using the pool. A dormant skill-beacon table mentioning this room does not place a beacon here.

Two exact oaken crates lie inside the closed, locked wagon on the southern cobblestone road. One of the three bored guards beside it carries the tiny iron key, which may break on use. Get two separate crates and bring them to the merchant guard waiting in the Steel Mug taproom for 200,000 copper. The crates are other-type quest items rather than containers; the fixed wagon need not be picked up.

The captain’s legacy recipe asks for Bel’s heart, the orb of unmaking and the mystic runed tablet for a Dexterity scroll. No current fresh tablet source or bound scroll-learning effect was found. The captain also teaches epic Dexterity and the butcher teaches Toughness through separate PRACTICE purchases, which remain unavailable while economic accounting is active.

The General Store is the only shop definition in this area; other shop descriptions are not proof of shopping support. Five rooms have explicit inn bindings. The Golden Cat taproom offers separate ship crew services. The local level potion also has foreign and procedural sources, without becoming a Ceothian quest hand-in.

Guild survival, earning trust, entering the past, returning future proofs and using the vault form a story in the lore. Their exact native exchanges remain independent, without an enforced all-stage campaign or proof that the timeline has changed. New campaign, source, access, custom effect and renewal credit requires admitted events and recovery qualification.

Discovery has its own achievement, and meeting the terminal givers reveals the relevant journal cards. Dialogue, current loose materials and exact accepted outcomes stay distinct. Active, ready accounting is required for all new discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit; frozen reward recovery is separate.

The outer cave leads WEST to the goblin shaman; his bone key opens the pickproof WEST boulder. The dragon inside carries the obsidian key for the secret DOWN trapdoor to the vault. orientation: Discover Myrabolus and meet its residents to reveal their requests. These journals require active, ready accounting. Thirteen story outcomes are separate from three supporting services; asking questions and carrying materials do not finish an offering.

Enter the city northward from the Surface valley or eastward from its beach. The lagoon opens north to the ocean, and the dark forest connects south through secret bushes to Darkfall. Prepare for darkness, water and dangerous falls.

The parchment is in the locked gold chest in Roland’s empty house. At the crash site, SEARCH for the downward plank passage, OPEN it and descend; the old crate to the south holds a hidden gold key. OPEN and SEARCH the crate, then unlock and open the chest. The gold key normally breaks when used.

A palace guard carries the palace key. Beyond the gates, SEARCH for the hidden eastern passage to the Sunweaver, then open the bridge hatch to find Markam. He returns a parchment and gives one keystone half before leaving; Xavier separately exchanges a parchment for the observatory key.

The holy knight beyond the Home of the Holy’s closed curtain carries the other half. It is hidden and invisible: see invisible items before searching his body. Andryn needs both different halves. The knight’s half and assembled key can dissolve when dropped; the assembled key normally breaks when unlocking the secret treasury trapdoor.

Xavier’s observatory key opens the southern portal passage to the Hunt. The Hunt portal returns directly to that passage. Exact supplied materials can skip earlier personal collection or story stages; an earlier completed stage does not replace a material you have spent or given away.

Rico, Random, Decker and Alexis each offer a different reward for one chest of treasure from the Hunt. It is one quest item, with no container to open. Each delivery consumes its own copy. Decker leaves after his exchange; WAKE Alexis before asking about or giving her an offering.

The monkey hunter wants the hidden lost-monkey item from the Hunt, rather than the local living monkey. The naval officer wants a small wooden raft and hidden tree sap. The fixed floating life raft is a different object; Shantil’s raft shopping is currently unavailable.

Ask Balance hi, hello, howdy or hey about the three Rogue Plains tokens. All three different tokens make one offering. His drider staff and holy broadsword request is separate. His returned-letter referral is optional preparation for Seraphim in Desolate.

Paid armor crafting, shopping, smithing, epic lessons, paid storage and ticket purchases are currently unavailable with accounting active. The upstairs inn has separate rent conditions. The WaveDancer stops at the pier, but boarding still needs a valid ferry ticket.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore a working bailey, its palisades and the Duke's keep. Six independent deliveries explain a bell-and-cog route, a replacement banner, a missing chess piece and the study documents. Five paid services remain separate. Active, ready accounting is required; paid textile settlement and safe source/access journeys remain open.
orientation: The ordinary entrance is the bailey gate, reached north from the surface stone highway. The outside gate leads south back to the highway. Closed inner, keep and room doors are access steps; source descriptions do not prove safe travel or a return.

The bell-and-cog route is exact small iron bell → large iron cog → military blade. The bell is carried by the bellfounder; no local purchase is bound. Both accepted deliveries are independent, and supplied matching items fit without earlier personal receipts.

The replacement-banner producer route is sheep fleece + 5000 copper → white yarn; white yarn + 10000 → crimson yarn; crimson yarn + 10000 → fabric; fabric + 35000 → banner. Starting from fleece costs 60000 copper. All four paid stages are currently guarded with accounting active. The later exact-banner return is an independent item-only outcome and accepts supplied matching banners.

The recipient of the banner is high above the keep, at the top of the flagpole. The ladder can cause falls and the two flagpole rooms have no ground. Prepare flight, levitation or suitable climbing protection for the approach and return. Delivery gives slippers; it does not prove hanging the flag or a magical transformation.
A worried servant has the exact ivory knight sought by the off-duty captain. The accepted piece gives military boots; it does not prove borrowing the piece, winning chess or learning a move.

In the private study, the military assessment lies inside an ebony desk that starts closed and has a one-charge acid trap on opening. The assessment exchange gives a scribbled note. One exact note plus a deep blue braid give the signet ring in a separate court delivery. Supplied matching evidence fits without a desk-opening history or personal kill.

The scribbled note describes a wedding, while the court reply calls the occasion a daughter's birthday. Treat the documents as evidence for the accepted delivery; no event date, spy allegiance, timed invasion or defended-castle state is checked.

Five paid services have no achievement or daily credit. Matching material checks cannot pay fees. Native delivery receipts and optional producer histories remain separate from current unequipped custody; neither proves first recovery, source ownership or a personally completed campaign.

Many craftsmen and merchants appear in room descriptions, but there is no local shop file. Lodging and customs descriptions do not provide a local rent or tariff quest. Ambient craft work, false alarms, scenery and the magician's teacher role remain separate from the six delivery outcomes.

Quest materials and recipients have one-copy source declarations, and the zone resets in mode two. These declarations do not promise supplies, safe recovery or repeatable daily availability in the current visit. Sources carried or worn by others need a separate acquisition route; the journal does not assume a personal kill.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore Alatorin's kitchens, workshops, guilds, royal requests, outposts, port and First Mountain shrines. Exact deliveries have independent outcomes; preparation and source history are optional. Active, ready accounting is required. Some paid, mining and material routes await supported settlement.
orientation: Meet the Stonebrew, BrightAxe, Hammerhelm and guild cooks. Each royal dish independently earns a culinary token from the King's attendant; ten current tokens pay Modan. Serving one dish does not complete all four courses.

The outer-city spice merchant supplies mandrake, garlic and green herb; the fruit vendor stocks apples, oranges and bananas; the elven peddler stocks dust, dragon blood and stones; the potion vendor stocks empty bottles. Purchase availability needs accounting-qualified stock.

Dweef trades 209 ordinary salvaged kinds for one fragment each. Ten fragments make one collecting token. Nebula adds copper; vellum gives three fragments; the strange object gives a full token and treasure. Ten tinkerer tokens give only one fragment, and have no ordinary reviewed source.

Ten exact collecting, dragonslaying, mining, cooking, stealth or siege tokens pay Modan for a medal and family-specific gifts. Ten medals earn the honor key; four medals instead buy gnome currency from Dweef. A single token receipt does not establish ten current tokens.

Miboli needs blank paper and two identical components for each arcanum. One of each of ten arcanums makes an enchantment scroll and gnome token. Winterhaven's Lancer supplies all five elemental components for one gem-studded dragon hide; that foreign receipt is optional.

Reciting an enchantment scroll draws one random attribute scroll. Electrum plus two matching scrolls make the corresponding ring. All nine distinct rings plus 500,000 copper make wondrous power. Eighteen random draws do not guarantee a complete matching set; supplied materials remain valid.

Mining, smelting, salvage, refining and paid native offerings currently refuse active accounting. Their journals explain exact supplied-input alternatives. Readiness shows item quantities; it does not guarantee payment support, fresh source issuance or personal preparation.

Gimbrin uses six identical materials plus matching armor and a fee; Xamora uses eight identical materials, two tokens and a fee. Steel/cold iron and wood/leather alternatives are whole recipes. Mixed material batches do not qualify. Mundorno's two overlapping blue-tunic recipes remain separate.

The mystic gardener requests all four distinct flowers together. Mishanen carries all four on separate rare stock rolls; the rose also has ground stock in the Fortress of Dreams. Twin Towers' gardener belt does not gate this local recipe. All three library books yield deadly mist; the Baron separately consumes Jedd's book.

Royal and rival proofs have competing uses: Noroth's head pays Taark, Queen Bellethra or Mundorno; the wedding band pays Taark or the attendant; Kereghaktis's head pays Sturb or Uttan. Guild recipients with equal terms still own separate requests. One current proof cannot pay multiple consumers.

The four northern hearts are declared on carriers in the Alteran Valley dispersal room, despite Frost Sharn wording. Mixt and Lyena have separate Twin Towers carriers. The five dwarven weapons have distinct foreign equipped sources; delivered proofs do not prove your kills or allegiance.

Jenk needs both royal signets for his stealth reward and then leaves. His five potion recipes, all-five elixir recipe and elixir-plus-token upgrade are supporting services. Prepare first or find another available appearance; supplied higher outputs can skip personal preparation.

Deramuth requests include both beast hearts for Ravi, a current mountaineer insignia for Locke, five different brewery casks for Naltem, and two distinct crate buybacks. Egg-to-soup routes compete with egg buyers and food buybacks. Osquip remains can expire before cooking.

The armoire and hidden button use push; the shrine statues use hit; vine travel uses grab. Keys unlock specific doors or containers and can break. An open wall, an unlocked door and confirmed travel are different effects. The malformed abandoned-tower switch and royal blocked gate need builder decisions.

The First Mountain shard passes through independent divine exchanges as replacement copies. Seven gifts do not establish a full pilgrimage; two priests only return it without added gifts. Vergadain's coins and Abbathor's satchel are money-item rewards whose accounting handling needs qualification.

Ask the named contacts about their listed topics for explanations. Dialogue is informational, without a learned-topic achievement. Current supplies and optional earlier receipts help explain preparation; only an accepted final exchange completes its own request. Rare recipients, caps, gifts and recovered stock affect availability.
