story_mappings.introduction: Discover the Tempest Court and follow Zieflia's family rescue, Aurilium's palace key, Ixteal's heart and the five Wind Dukes' Maelstrom essences. Choose how to spend each fragment on Cloudseeker or Fearfrost's hammer. Seven outcomes explain exact acceptance and optional source preparation; active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: Active, ready accounting is required for zone discovery, visible NPC encounters, journal progress and new daily credit. The first visit is its own zone discovery achievement. Current material checks and journal reading do not award credit.

The ordinary boundary is the Plane of Air courtyard up to the Cloudwalk. Most local routes use air-plane terrain: entering requires flight or levitation; moving horizontally from it requires flight, while levitation supports up/down. The acting mount must meet the movement requirements. Encountered actors can move away from declared starting rooms.

Use ENTER on the actual planar portals: Cloudwalk to mist fortress and back; smoke fortress to its prison tower and back; smoke to ice-and-steel fortress and back; mist-tower top to palace top and back. These eight portals have unlimited charges. The top of the palace still has a locked downward door requiring Aurilium's key on the ordinary approach.

For Zieflia, find and open the smoke wall to Galzron. His smoke key opens her northern force cell without a normal-unlock break chance. Then give it to her for the medallion; that exchange consumes the key and retires her. Return the medallion to the current Al'Hajib in the mist courtyard for the sapphire eyepiece. The older Al'Hajib is an equivalent inactive source identity.

Aurilium wants frost from Ecthius, smoke from Galzron and mist from Si'Ciltron: one of each exact kind. The barracks frost key belongs to the second following aerial servant, and can break on normal unlocking. The persistent rewarded palace key fits the downward entrance; its receipt does not prove personal kills, unchaining Aurilium or defeating Akadi.

Darthikya accepts Ixteal's heart for frost gauntlets. Ixteal and several recipients have nominal rare mobile resets, which ordinary unforced resets currently skip. Starting-room clues, global limits, current custody and admitted reset generations govern real availability.

Chan requires five distinct Wind Duke essences. The Dukes start together in the mist fortress guest room, not the final palace; four wear their proof at the neck while Emoniel carries his. Chan starts inside the palace and is naturally invisible. Find and perceive the actual recipient before addressed dialogue or delivery.

Chan's fragment is consumed by two different requests. Cloudseeker needs eight exact wind relics plus a fragment; Fearfrost needs a fragment plus Frostbite, Mistweave and Thrym's token. A prior fragment receipt cannot spend the same object twice. Both independent rewards can be recorded if you obtain separate supplies; no permanent exclusive branch is invented.

Cloudseeker materials come from Winterhaven's Lancer bundle, Lair of the Gibberling King, the Hall of Knighthood, the Charcoal Palace, IceCrag Castle, Akadi, the Jade Empire and the Savannah Watcher. The same wisp and katana have other consumers. Use each item's exact name and source hint; personal completion of those foreign stories is optional when proof is supplied.

All native offerings here are complete exact bundles of loose carried items, without coin fees. Wearing or holding a weapon, cloak, boots, token or essence does not satisfy the native offering search. Optional source/history aids are not hidden prerequisites, and earlier receipts do not restore consumed objects.

ASK/TELL topics explain lore without awarding separate keyword achievements. The yan/yan-c-bin MA family is still addressed dialogue, with a room audience. Native si'ciltron topics are explained in prose because structured topic tokens cannot contain the apostrophe.

Seven named outcomes cover all eight native recipes. The two Al'Hajib recipients share one outcome. Rescue and Cloudseeker retire their recipients in reset mode zero and remain story-only. The five remaining candidate units still need evidence of current access, supply and player suitability before daily assignment.

The palace epic rune uses the existing committed epic-touch result and its accounting/group/reset policy. It is separate from a key receipt, a personal Akadi defeat or full liberation. Active accounting refuses legacy reset item issuance without an owned generation, so declared loot is not guaranteed replenishment.

The sapphire eyepiece has a native upgrade promise and four unused gem-set prototypes, but no established active upgrade recipe or source. Divine sparks, extra encoded Air Attack prototypes, sealed rare-load rooms and quasi-plane dead ends remain integration or builder-intent findings, not invented story terminals.

The courtyard cloud portal declares the Troll Hills as its destination but has command zero and zero charges; do not depend on it for ENTER return. The eight upper-cloud lightning objects lack the movement-trigger bit; restoring that hazard needs builder intent and balance qualification. Normal return through the Plane of Air boundary remains a separately qualified route.

story_mappings.introduction: Find the city inn's local requests, the wizard's independent commissions and the medicine-and-pendant chain. Current supplies, optional preparation and accepted delivery history stay distinct. Supporting maps, medicine, equipment and paid practice grant no extra quest achievements. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The city has ordinary sea-wall, mesa, bay and north/south road approaches. Start with look and exits, then find the inn and market. Arrival discovers a place; it does not complete any named delivery.

The hungry mercenary needs the exact city loaf. The baker stocks it and the inn kitchen has a ground supply. Other food belongs to the homeless child's different, currently unsupported typed-food request.

The inn monk needs three different toy instruments together. The elven child carries the flute, the human the mandolin and the halfling the lyre; two descriptions name the wrong toys. The travelling bard's ordinary loan instruments are not valid substitutes.

The dining-room storyteller signs the large blank book, without requiring the quill mentioned in her dialogue. Inspect an accessible desk in the library; search hidden contents, then take the actual book. Examining, searching and carrying are separate actions.

The inn ranger calls his lost wolf pup Phobos and points under a bed, but the current source is a plant sack. Return the exact pup for belt and cloak. A living pet, follower, generic wolf or pet-shop claim ticket does not substitute.

The inn herbalist explains nightshade and mandrake. Open an accessible plant sack before searching; a successful ordinary search reveals one hidden object at a time, and you still need to take it. Similar sacks can hold different contents, so check the live source.

Bring the two different herbs together to the kitchen alchemist for a maroon vial. That preparation service supports the wounded halfling without adding an achievement. A supplied vial skips the herbs and does not fabricate their gathering or production history.

The wounded halfling wants the vial and the merchant's solid-gold pendant together. The merchant wears the pendant and has two bodyguards; his dialogue refuses help. The wounded halfling's heirloom claim is disputed. Acceptance lets him leave and awards experience and an empty pouch, without an escort or separate healing outcome.

The travelling bard exchanges shared blank paper for a city map. Paper exists in the active world and is declared in desks and the wine merchant's inventory. City directions, level advice and instrument loans remain supporting information, without learned-topic or performance credit.

The sorcerer's stair-bottom portal leads into the twisted tower's first chamber, where a glowing bookshelf holds the twisted-tower wizard's crumpled note. The return portal leads to the park. The note commission, magical-text commission and foreign-dagger commission are independent.

The conjurer-tower bookshelf supplies the magical text book. Royal-bedroom chest stock is another declaration, but its loaded lock has no ordinary key. The text reward is a tome and raven feather quill; other blank, signed or spell books are different items.

The twisted-tower wizard accepts Tezcat's bloody sacrificial dagger for a disguise kit, illusion robe and potion. A foreign Tezcazul carries the proof. This local delivery does not prove your own defeat of that carrier or use of the reward powers.

The dwarven warrior improves four exact ordinary weapon families. Two same-named two-handed swords are alternative inputs for one support service. Unwield the selected weapon before offering; practice, generic weapon names and other finished weapons do not substitute.

The apprentice sorcerer's one-platinum wand purchase and several city paid services are unavailable until their payments can be completed safely. A visible fee or available cash is not a completed purchase.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore the Tower of Darkness and Dubneth: the Bloodstone messenger and captain’s key, Katalia’s bindings, Amelia’s locket and Dorthan’s shield, the three planar keys of stasis, and the physically connected Star Stone and prisoner stories currently credited to Braddistock.
orientation: Active, ready accounting is mandatory for discovery, visible encounters, journals and new achievement/daily credit. Discovering the Tower of Darkness has its own achievement. Questions, reading, kills, current possession and attempted travel do not complete native exchanges.

The Tower source also includes Dubneth village, the farmhouse and church, planar side routes, loading rooms and Sargon’s prison. Follow exact source and destination identities; lore names alone do not define quest terminals.

Five physically local requests — Azlion, Jenifer, Father Darrin, Danthas and Isabia — currently belong to Braddistock by giver-number range. Their accepted recipes remain in that owning journal. Tower encounters do not discover Braddistock; the broader physical campaign is guidance until explicit cross-zone affiliation and discovery support is designed.

The oak entrance resets closed but unlocked in both directions; opening, rather than prior sergeant-key history, is the initial route requirement. The sergeant carries the matching key for later locked state. The Bloodstone letter yields a small note; the note or guarded 100-platinum bribe yields the captain key. Earlier receipts are optional route help, and key issuance is not unlocking, opening or passage.

Recover the hidden board’s steel key for Katalia, and use the priest’s different small black key for Amelia. Amelia’s locket and five exact swords yield Dorthan’s shield. Supplies received from another player remain valid without personal rescue/source history.

Speak the exact magic words at the actual locked exits: sargon for the cleric routes, darkfather for the upper-level diagonal door, and thothrontithos for the elemental route. Successful speech clears lock/secret state, while opening and surviving arrival remain separate. Asking a quest topic is a different interaction.

The illusion maze has actual direction-triggered teleport objects that can override ordinary room exits. Select the active room object and command, rather than trusting labels alone. The central portal reaches Janyon’s hall. The portal of darkness containing an elemental key is a container, not a teleporter.

Verinor’s Death key, the elemental container’s key and Gailon’s Creation key yield the statue’s stasis key. Bone, conquest and demon murals use distinct real teleporter destinations. Actual route use, traps, hidden recovery, current shared doors and perception require qualification.

Father Darrin’s five Star Stone pieces are declared on Kinslor, Mordren, the Cardinal, Earlion that Is and Urian. Their exchange yields the Star Key in the Braddistock journal. The Star Key fits the hill keystone and prison door; neither receipt proves surviving Sargon or ending the campaign.

The Cardinal’s bone key also opens a chest with a thirty-percent hammer child. Isabia consumes that key and yields a ring; Danthas consumes the ring for leggings. Access keys and delivered proof need distinct physical allocation. Isabia’s D0 departure remains narrative only.

Danthas and other mobile actors can start in loading/holding rooms. Some routes enter a room with no outward exit; actual roaming, population, admitted generation and perception need qualification before reliable daily supply. Reset mode zero keeps disappearing recipients story-only.

The bounded active-world scan finds an outward route to Troll Hills 1883 but no ordinary incoming exit or foreign fixed ITEM_TELEPORT into this room range. This is an access concern to qualify with builders and other travel mechanisms before proposing a topology change.

Fenrral’s one village tavern shop sells food and drinks; this is not rental or a story outcome. Hammer proc placeholders, copied item/shop descriptions, holding-room placement and narrated-but-unimplemented departures remain separate pending proposals. No unsupported event credit or fee bypass is introduced.

Azlion and Father Darrin retire on acceptance in physical Tower reset mode zero, but their current Braddistock owner has reset mode two, making the static catalog mark them repeatable/potential daily. This is not proven physical renewal: qualify actual actor episodes and supply independently of immutable receipt owner before daily use.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore the abandoned mansion's clues, secret cellar and smuggler cave. Five recorded exchanges take place in the Tower of Darkness: free Azlion, report Joseph's fate, assemble Darrin's Star Key and carry Isabia's ring to Danthas. These Tower requests currently appear in this mansion's journal.
orientation: This is Braddistock Mansion (brad), entered from Tharnadia's sea wall onto the short rocky road. It is separate from the older Braddistock area. The spirit on the road blocks ordinary northward entry above level 14; trusted staff bypass that rule. No quest hand-in opens this gate.

Inspect the entrance-floor tracks and the mansion's rooms. The library's closed tome contains a note pointing beyond the skeletons. OPEN the tome and GET the note; reading that clue is useful guidance, without a recorded learned-topic achievement.

The scratched key on the main bedroom floor fits the southern bedroom door. Ned Shakeshaft waits beyond it with his dagger; no native request or rescue reward is attached to him. Closed chests and furniture contain ordinary supplies and treasures, distinct from accepted quest outcomes.

Search the secret southern cellar door, then inspect and open the eastern barred door toward the skeleton room. Search the next secret eastern door to reach the laboratory. These are real exit and door routes, with normal search, lock and combat requirements; the journal does not record their discovery or traversal as completed stages.

The laboratory's alchemy book, golden skull, apple, rose and set of five weights tell an alchemist's story. The weights are one treasure object. The alchemist’s skeleton container holds the pebble, and tables hold scrolls. No bound alchemy conversion or laboratory finale was found; a book or pebble is not proof of performing one.

Sanbalet and the smugglers occupy the lower caverns with brandy kegs and silk bolts. These are treasure items, not a named turn-in. The glowing boat is an ordinary boat in the sea cave; the current cave has no exit to the sea or implemented smuggling voyage. Exploration, combat and loot have no authored local quest terminal here.

The five cards below describe requests in the Tower of Darkness. Meeting those givers in the Tower does not itself open this mansion's journal; visit the mansion to discover it. Consult the Tower's own journal for its access requests. Some givers leave after a hand-in, and return availability is not guaranteed.

Azlion waits in the Tower's summoning chamber. Ask power, circle, freedom or favour for his staff request, and urian or sargon for the larger threat. The excited conjurer holds the cold-iron staff in the arbysal audience chamber; recover it to loose inventory and give it to Azlion for the Redemption of Light broadsword. Azlion leaves, but the described rift is not spawned by the exchange.

Jenifer waits in the Tower's farmhouse. The ogre mercenary in the foyer carries Joseph Hammerson's decapitated head. Give that exact head to Jenifer for 100,000 experience. Supplying it is accepted without this player's personal kill or first recovery history.

Father Darrin waits in the Church of Holy Light. Ask key, stone, keystone or star. The first through last Star Stone pieces belong to Kinslor, Lord Mordren, Cardinal Faethron, Earlion that Is and Urian Shadowborn. Five different loose pieces are required together; duplicate copies of one piece cannot replace another. Darrin gives the Star Key and leaves.

The Star Key's actual Tower hill, keystone and prison access differs from receiving it. The rift, Sargon battle and return route need their own successful travel and outcome evidence before a campaign can be completed. The current exchange does not prove that Sargon was defeated or that the world was saved.

Ask Isabia key or prison in the Tower's prison room. Cardinal Faethron carries her bone key, which also opens a different chest. Give the exact key to Isabia for her ring; despite her farewell, the native exchange leaves her instance present. Deliver the loose ring to Danthas for bladesinger leggings. His staged starting room and possible wandering make actual encounter availability a separate concern.

Earlier Isabia completion is optional guidance for Danthas; a supplied matching ring is valid. ASK aliases are response topics rather than separate achievements. Current materials, earlier accepted receipts, source recovery, physical access and actual reward completion are distinct facts.

Discovery has its own achievement. Active, ready accounting is required for quest journals, achievements and daily credit. A daily listing does not guarantee that the recipient is present or that fresh materials are available.

story_mappings.introduction: Meet the savannah's tribes, rocchasers, hidden researcher and Watcher. Their named requests have exact delivery outcomes. Lynstar's equipment trades remain distinct supporting services, while the sister and tribal-war legends are unfinished leads. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: Enter from the western surface trail to meet Dromis and Kylian's companions. Ask Dromis about savannah and Kylian about roc. Topics explain lore; hearing a keyword does not award an achievement.

The roc in the northeastern clearing carries the tailfeather for Kylian. He pays 10,000 copper and an insignia, accepting supplied proof as well. His gratitude does not record your own kill or send the companions home.

The Tukluk shaman in the northwestern village accepts three tusks together for a curio, or three gazelle skins together for sleeves. These are different requests and rewards; a mixed batch or one of each does not qualify. Neither delivery records the defeat of the Butsus.

Three tusks are declared on elephants at the watering hole. The three skin declarations belong to a large gazelle and its follower near the center and another follower in the dusty clearing. Exact stock is limited; every animal of a species need not carry a quest part.

A proud lion near the central savannah carries the one declared pile of lion bones. Descend through the huge baobab, pass the falling shaft and follow the underground tunnels west to Sprithnog. His laboratory plaque requests the bones for monocles; ordinary golem stock is separate.

Ask the Watcher about contest or interfere. Enter the giant termite mound and find the secret, closed wall into the Kahir burial chamber. One essence declaration is carried by a ghostly host among five. No item key opens that wall. Bring the current essence to the Watcher for his cloak and departure.

Lynstar is declared in the pit beneath the Butsu village, rather than on the village paths. The well drops down and has no upward exit. A secret, closed western connection links the pit to the termite tunnels, providing a separate approach and way out.

Each Mitashi katana pays a different legendary instrument: Shadows Breath → lyre; The North Wind → drums; Divine Fury → horn; Celestial Dragon → flute; Torrential Rain → mandolin; The Lotus Blossom → harp. These are six separate equipment services, not interchangeable collection terminals.

Kunji Pishida in the abandoned Mitashi warehouse basement accepts all six distinct katanas together for Retribution and leaves. Giving a katana to Lynstar instead spends that copy. A supplied Retribution can skip the Kunji exchange, but a receipt cannot replace the sword after it is consumed.

Each epic upgrade needs one current Retribution plus its matching legendary instrument. Lynstar leaves after an upgrade, so additional epic instruments require another available appearance or supplied instruments. Repeated lyre wording in dialogue does not change the six exact recipes.

Using only these fresh native recipes to make all six epic instruments consumes seven copies of each original katana: one set for the six base instruments and six sets for six Retributions. Kunji and Lynstar each need six available appearances. Declared cap-one sword stock and active generation must be qualified; gifts can shorten this preparation.

Lynstar says her sister in the Drakenwood Hostel wants the six epic instruments. That full-set request is an unfinished lead with no supported ending in the journal. Each instrument trade remains available separately when Lynstar and the supplies are present.

Dromis predicts M'Bele will appear after a chief is defeated. The journal does not yet track that ending. Tukluk deliveries and Kahir proof have their own rewards without awarding tribal victory or a god-summoning achievement.

The North Wind katana and the Watcher's cloak also pay a separate nine-item relic request on the Plane of Air. That foreign recipient owns its own reward and receipt; one current item cannot pay both uses. Local hints do not discover or complete the foreign story.

Instrument use belongs to the normal bard system: equip the correct instrument and know an appropriate song. A trade receipt records the equipment exchange, rather than learned songs or a successful performance. Remove equipment before offering it in a quest.

Readiness shows current exact carried quantities. Supplies, recipient appearances and ordinary travel need active-world qualification. Item names, NORENT restrictions and animal stock do not prove freshness or personal hunting; gifts are valid unless a future objective explicitly requires personal recovery.

story_mappings.introduction: Discover Fairlocke, the Black Hall and the lost Ironstar hold. Follow Larra’s ring to Robert’s spirit, return Haldron’s crown, and learn the separate paid vault-key route and three independent equipment commissions. Exact material sources and access clues guide preparation while each accepted exchange retains its own outcome.
orientation: Active, ready accounting is required for discovery, visible encounters, journals and new achievement/daily credit. Discovering Ironstar has its own achievement. Reading lore, asking keywords and carrying materials award no quest credit.

Enter the Wherston Road from the northern tundra boundary at 138978. Follow the bridge and Fairlocke village to Larra’s garden. Behind the waterfall is the Black Hall; its school rooms, lower ladder and ancient dwarven ruins form the main exploration route. Flight, water, darkness, door state and survival need actual qualification.

Recover the black skull key in the kitchen and open the locked office desk for Larra’s gold wedding ring. Return it to Larra for Robert’s gold-and-silver ring, then meet Robert’s actual spirit for Soulcatcher. Zrack starts by the dragon, not in his office. The two accepted deliveries are separate; supplied ring material fits.

The king’s tomb is down from the newly excavated area. Its raw door declares the dagger mold as a key, but the two D resets open and unlock that route. Do not invent a mandatory vault-first mold dependency or a circular crown quest from the prototype alone. Shared or later closed state may differ.

Return the old adamantium crown to Dralor for a runed darksteel axe. His trading station has a closed secret entrance. The axe plus 500 platinum produces a vault key in the native recipe; current durable coin-offering support blocks that paid exchange. His completion prose mentions crown and axe together, but the actual paid inputs are axe and fee.

Three successive southward vault locks use the silver mithril key from the third baby-dragon reset, the large mithril key inside riverside gravel, and Dralor’s paid vault key. Reverse doors have different key/state definitions. A key receipt, copied room prose or possession alone does not certify an unlock or arrival.

The vault contains both distinct mithril molds, other equipment and imported ore. Reforging either mold needs the minion’s demonhide scroll, Maltheas’s broken weapon and its own 1000-platinum fee. The intact burning blade is a separate weapon, not the broken offering. Shared cap-one materials cannot be spent twice.

Dragonbone mail uses Charringdeath’s declared scales and a 100-platinum fee. Mail, dagger and hammer are equipment services, separate from the four named story outcomes. All four paid native recipes remain guarded until durable coin offering is supported; material readiness does not establish wallet readiness or accepted payment.

The black velvet spellbook contains the word Datherlion. The underground grate uses a magic-word lock: saying the matching word can unlock an actually locked grate, but the zone’s normal D resets already open both sides. SAY does not itself open a closed door or award a learned-topic achievement.

River currents, waterfall falls, underwater breathing and native item traps are actual hazards. The surface river bends east at 138911 while its current direction remains south; that mismatch needs a bounded source/behavior review before an isolated repair. The map does not treat an attempted command or surviving hint as successful passage.

Robert’s nominal seventy-five-percent and Urian’s apprentice’s eighty-percent placement need admitted initial/forced placement and actual wandering qualification. Normal unforced active-accounting reset does not admit these lower-chance M commands, and legacy item resets require admitted generation. Source declarations do not promise daily stock.

Marius’s teaching, the lovers’ reunion, rebuilding Ironstar, reading globe histories, and Urian’s letter are contextual stories without reviewed accepted endpoints. Preserve that lore; let builders specify committed actor, dialogue, access or campaign objectives before granting semantic milestones.

Supplied exact loose material fits all native recipes. Earlier Larra or crown receipts are optional history, cannot replenish spent items and do not certify the current object’s original source. Robert’s D1 retirement under reset mode one requires renewal qualification before assigning repeated dailies.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore the City of Brass, its shrines, zoo, harbor and palace. Gather the tax collector’s four collectibles for palace access, fulfill Herl’s blood request and Yodono’s three-head request, find the hidden spy’s six-head mission, and understand the separate guarded bracer commission and unfinished djinn branch.
orientation: Active, ready accounting is required for discovery, visible encounters, journals and new achievement/daily credit. Discovering Brass has its own achievement. Asking aliases, reading notes, carried preparation, kills and attempted access do not record accepted quest outcomes.

Enter from Plane of Fire room 25455 at city entrance 139000. The first golem guards north; death of the second golem clears the separately blocked north gate. A closed door still needs opening. Actor defeat, barrier clearing and surviving passage are distinct facts.

Most of Brass is fire-plane terrain. Shared heat behavior can remove ordinary fire-protection spells; a fire-ward potion alone does not establish safe travel. Account for actual protection, survival, perception, door state and placement. The Flaming Dragon Inn at 139078 is a real assigned rental service.

The tax collector at office 139020 wants four exact collectibles, including two special coin objects rather than wallet payment. The Surtr and Imix shrines, dock master and magma lake supply the declared inputs. One accepted QA exchange yields the palace key; key possession is not palace arrival.

The Palace Gate Key opens the forward north gate at 139140 and has a one-hundred-percent break value. Reverse palace door state differs. Trace the actual door reset and current shared state before treating a configured key as a mandatory historical prerequisite.

Yodono at 139217 accepts three distinct heads and yields two identical-kind cold-blue-flame vials. The potion’s spell is elemental form, not healing. His narrated second task and the unplaced dying djinn’s empty vial recipe have no verified rescue endpoint; that empty exchange is excluded from named progress.

The hidden spy starts in Magma Lake 139238 with nominal ten-percent placement, accepts six distinct heads for an airy sash and departs. Two heads overlap Yodono’s request; spend a new copy for each accepted request. Actual visible encounter and renewable recipient supply require qualification.

The armorer’s bracer needs both elder and ancient pyrohydra scales plus 7500 platinum. This mixed fee remains guarded under durable accounting. The smaller elder-scales-plus-fee exchange returns the same kind and fee as a refusal and earns no achievement or daily.

The ten-headed pyrohydra is declared in rare room 139247 with sixty-percent placement. Its non-sentinel movement may bring it into the palace via outward exits; there is no reviewed ordinary incoming exit into that birth room. Normal unforced active-accounting resets skip lower-chance M commands, and legacy item resets require admitted generation.

The palace has distinct front/rear routes, green and purple-fire side keys, two different blue-fire throne keys, a treasury key, armory/slave-quarter key and a locked armoire’s skeleton key. Alternate entry and asymmetric reverse states matter. No local switch or portal prototype implements a new access quest.

Shanaanaa sells external-zone notes. Their narratives can help future mapping, but buying/reading them does not dynamically prove those gates, passwords, quests or routes. Nine note kinds are configured stock; Transparent Tower notes require actual carried-stock availability. Imported artifact/stat-pool/epic effects remain separate interactions.

The city bank, shops, shrine imagery, guild titles, floating pools, prisoner lore and Sultan battle do not add accepted native story terminals. Builders can select successful access, rescue, dialogue, source or campaign events later. Preserve current acceptance and exclusions while recording missing capabilities and balanced repair proposals.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore the Plane of Smoke, return Korli’s spectacles, fulfill Rijak’s heart request and understand Erk’s four exact equipment services. Follow declared planar and vault routes while keeping current supplies, accepted outcomes and pending native repair decisions distinct.
orientation: Active, ready accounting is mandatory for discovery, visible encounters, journals and new achievement/daily credit. Discovering Smoke has its own achievement. Questions, current inventory, attempted access and scenic lore do not complete quests.

The two accepted delivery stories are Rijak’s heart exchange and Korli’s spectacles return. Erk’s two-blade forging, ring/earring conversions and staff enhancement are four equipment services with history but no quest achievement or daily credit. Supplied exact materials need no personal kill or producer history.

Smoke has no ordinary exit to another zone. The older Plane of Air portal at 24405 leads to Korli’s fresh-air pocket 139832; the older Plane of Fire portal at 25464 leads to the fire pocket and locked box 139894. Local blue and red portals return to those older planes. These are distinct from the later Air and Fire areas.

The main smoke grid spans five layers with six-direction travel. Magical darkness and blocked sight affect perception. Most rooms are actually Fire Plane terrain, so shared heat hazards apply. Fresh-air and sphere/vortex rooms are Air Plane terrain; flight and surviving arrival matter. The fresh-air pocket is not flagged safe.

At Ehkahk’s lair 139863, the disc leads to Sphere of Smoke 139937; its counterpart returns to the lair. Rijak starts at 139940, whose separate smoky portal leads one way to vault antechamber 139941. The antechamber’s south route returns to the grid, so this does not certify personal use of Rijak’s portal.

Rijak’s veil and vault key require heart 139808, not Etrita’s different heart. Both are ordinary preloaded trophies; the exchange does not validate a personal kill. Rijak and Erk may wander, while Korli is sentinel. Potential daily metadata does not guarantee renewable recipients, rare actors or proof supplies.

Korli’s spectacles are declared on the second twenty-five-percent mephit follower at 139875. Returning them grants obsidian key 139812 and retires Korli. His described sight recovery and disappearance are narrative; the native transaction does not equip the glasses, cure blindness or record escort or homecoming.

The trapped, closed, locked and pickproof obsidian box at 139894 holds Hate. Its key and the vault key both have a one-hundred-percent break roll on accepted unlock. Possession, unlocking, break settlement, opening and loose recovery are separate. A historical key receipt neither opens today’s lock nor restores a spent key.

The vault portcullis now names the rewarded vault key 139818 on both sides. Unlocking changes reciprocal lock flags but leaves the door closed and pickproof; opening remains separate. The northern door from vault 139942 to forge 139945 resets closed but unlocked. Existing shared state and alternate supplied materials still matter.

Discontent is a different broadsword from Hate, carried by forty-percent Charzzlk at 139863. Newly loaded Discontent can be selected by its own name and retains its old aliases. Two copies of Hate cannot satisfy Erk’s two-kind forging bundle. First acquisition, original source and another player’s handoff are not distinguished by this inventory check.

The human ring, half-elf earring and grey-elf staff are equipped on separate forty-percent vault occupants. Recover them to loose inventory. The ring is shared by conversion and enhancement recipes; spending it once does not reserve another. Reversible jewelry services create no daily or quest achievement loop.

The Smouldering Forge room 139945 currently uses Negative Plane terrain and schedules life-force drain. Its forge object is an ordinary container with no operating quest procedure. Builder review must select intended terrain. The exit down to 139944 reaches blue/red return portals; there is no ordinary upward return from that exodus room.

Erk’s greatsword currently includes a permanent Power effect. Its intended abilities need builder review before combat or stat growth becomes a story objective. This journal records the accepted forging service and explains its materials.

Ehkahk carries imported epic stone 359. Its shared touch procedure uses live zone, peaceful-room/group and committed claim checks; holding the stone or delivering the heart does not prove a personal victory or a completed group claim. Frozen obligation recovery stays separate from active-accounting publication.

Concubine captivity, commander followers, the conjurer, elemental vortices and unused holding/rare rooms have no additional native quest terminals. Builder-selected rescue, obstacle, combat, travel or campaign events would need actual accepted transitions before new progress. Preserve exact identities and explain incomplete intent openly.

story_mappings.introduction: The Black Pearl owns a scattered dragonslayer expedition as well as a wreck full of undead. Its intended campaign travels from Tharnadia through Caer Tannad, Twin Towers, Turopolis, Pharr Valley, Evermeet, the circus, Verspin, the Moonshaes, Newhaven and Kimodril. The reviewed source currently leaves the campaign contacts and several supplies in an exitless holding room; deeper placement repairs are required before a complete ordinary journey is available.
orientation: The intended expedition begins with Warthehr's scrawled invitation at Tharnadia's Tower of the Cleric. That invitation and the lost Turopolis sewer fragment currently have no ordinary source. The campaign's named contacts, animal proofs and first four wreck keys are currently declared only in an exitless holding room.

The fragment leads are: thief in Caer Tannad; farmer's son in Twin Towers; Turopolis sewer recovery; Gartham in Pharr Valley; Milerg's white wolf request on Evermeet; ogre-gnome's yo-yo request at the circus; Derimous's four different horns in Verspin; Lyle and Abal's Moonshae letters and scepter. These are intended destinations, awaiting placement and source repair.

Warthehr replaces the original Gartham, hunter and Ffolk fragments with three different pieces bearing the same name. The Gartham report also awards 100,000 copper through the supported item-and-wallet reward path. The hunter report provides a letter to Lyle; the Ffolk report provides a letter to Jyarl.

Warthehr's letter to Lyle produces the letter to Abal. Abal supplies a heavy iron chest key and a separate shimmering key for the Moonshae king's secret door. The royal scepter and trapped chest have no ordinary source in the reviewed data. Abal's later reply to Lyle is a different letter and produces Lyle's fragment. No recorded theft, royal vengeance or restored hunting title follows from delivery prose.

Jyarl's addressed letter produces the humming hilt. Telrar needs nine distinct pieces together: thief, farmer, sewer, Milerg and circus fragments; the three Warthehr replacement fragments; and the hilt. Eight copies of one fragment cannot substitute. Optional producer history helps explain sources without replacing spent pieces or excluding a supplied complete set.

Showing each recovered piece to Warthehr supplies recorded guidance. These returns preserve the item kind while replacing the offered object. They remain visible services without extra quest achievements. The native exchanges are independent; their narrated order does not enforce every earlier stage.

The intended dragon finale is Ghalasax's baby-dragon skin for six large and six small gems. The reviewed Ghalasax is still in the holding room; the huge skeletal dragon aboard the wreck is different. The final delivery accepts supplied skin without proving personal sword construction, weapon use or a kill. The fixed gems go to the offering actor rather than being allocated by current party size.

The barbarian, gnome and dwarf hunters offer separate large/small gem equipment trades. Giving has no class prerequisite, though equipment restrictions and experience caps still apply. The patron's five-platinum gadget purchase is unavailable under active accounting; a supplied gadget can feed the farmer's independent request. Services do not add quest achievements.

The wreck has an outward exit to the surface mountains, but no reciprocal ordinary entrance was found. Its permanent mobile hunter-ship entrance is disabled. Early grating and door keys come from spirits currently in the holding room; several later doors are locked without a matching key, so access needs explicit repair and live qualification.

Inside the wreck, cargo rooms lead up to cabins and guard quarters. Two concealed side closets reset locked. The guard captain's small bone key fits the northern secured route despite its unusual object type. The roof trapdoor resets closed and must be opened. Long John Silver, the alchemist, navigator and skeletal dragon are separate encounters; their remains, rod and broken compass have no reviewed campaign finale.

Carry all offering items directly, outside containers and equipment. A committed hand-in records that exact delivery once. Inventory readiness and optional earlier receipts award nothing. Mode-zero disappearing contacts have limited shared availability; a daily candidate count does not promise a currently reachable contact, a stock refresh or a completed campaign.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore the Arcaneum's teaching wings and dream plane through five independent collection requests, a paid admission service and verified lore contacts. Exact offerings determine completion. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting.
orientation: ASK gafrizzen about student or scholar for admission terms. His ten-platinum key exchange is a paid service, separate from the five collection requests. Coin offerings are currently unavailable while accounting is active. Carrying a key or entering through an already opened route does not prove a personal admission payment.

The portico's eastern gate starts closed, locked and pickproof. Its small obsidian admission key may break when used; a supplied matching key or a passage opened by someone else remains valid under native access rules. The journal does not add a personal payment prerequisite or promise a bypass. Ordinary travel, combat and PvP restrictions still apply.

ASK yralrife about summoning or essences. He accepts six different elemental essences together: fire, acid, sulfur, frost, shadows and lightning. The initial gatehouse golems have limited exact essence stock. Other golems in the summoning rooms do not all carry those materials. You need not prove that you personally summoned or killed a golem.

ASK rikn about necromantic, necromancy, necro or arts. His request needs seven different undead proofs together. The necromancy wing has limited stock on specific creatures; ordinary zombies and skeletons do not all supply it. His speech describes study and victories, while the accepted request checks the exact items rather than seven personal kills or lessons.

ASK gringobbi about job for the historical journal of Solbeep. It is reset stock inside the sorcerer's obsidian desk, which starts closed and locked. A successful native lock-opening method and then OPEN are needed unless someone has already opened it. Normal PICK requires the skill and a held usable pick; the shop's sales pitch does not guarantee that its own picks can be held.

ASK gazdiel about fragment, dream, dreams or memories. He requires eight distinct dream fragments, which share a plain-text name and keywords but have different native colors. The color names and numbered preparation labels distinguish eight exact kinds without an offering order. Eight copies of one kind are insufficient.

The shadow portal at the ethereal-mist lookout leads into the dream plane; the portal near Gazdiel leads back. ENTER portal follows the native command and arrival rules. The treasury passage starts secret, closed, locked and pickproof; its insubstantial skeleton key is limited stock carried by one dream-memory placement. Finding or using a passage is not a recorded personal puzzle completion.

The dream demon starts beside eight different fragment placements and can bring one color through its one-way approach into the treasury. Its normal approach does not tour all eight colors. Gathering the full set can require multiple available demon and stock episodes; a single encounter does not promise eight fragments. Exact supplied fragments also fit. Availability still needs played qualification, and staging rooms are not player destinations.

ASK razeline about books when the rare book collector is available. She requests ten specific apprentice books together, spread through the elemental, wild-magic, shadow, spirit, nature, necromancy, study, demonology and lore shelves. Those books differ from the lich's spellbook, a teacher's claw-bound tome and the reward tome. Current stock and its actual container can vary with resets and collection by others.

Razeline's approach to the fountain is not reliable: her declared starting route can leave her away from the public rooms. Finding every book does not guarantee that she is presently available. Do not enter staging rooms to chase her. Both Razeline and Gazdiel leave after an accepted offering and need a fresh available recipient for another attempt.

The falling routes near the undead pit, the ethereal lookout and the two inn routes retain native fall, flight and movement behavior. Hidden-looking captions do not always mean a secret exit: the dracolich's northern crypt door starts closed and unlocked, and the inn's downward portico exit is not initially secret. Follow actual passage state rather than treating every caption as a new puzzle.

Carry each chosen offering loose to see current preparation. Held, worn, nested, consumed or handed-away objects are not current loose preparation. Exact gifts can fit without personal first-recovery, source, combat, training or dialogue history. Each bundle settles as one accepted request; readiness and reward ownership do not create its receipt.

ASK the listed class contacts about their verified topics for guidance. Ne'kalsai explains his curse, but no accepted cure is declared here. Class specialization, learning from teachers, Shezeera's epic instruction, shopping, the bank and the fountain remain separate native services or lore. Epic skill purchases are currently unavailable while accounting is active.

Potential daily eligibility describes a repeatable item offering and native reset renewal, not guaranteed materials, recipient availability or daily rewards. Gazdiel's soul-mending and Ne'kalsai's transformation language does not record a repaired soul or a cured creature. Discovery stays separate, and new credit requires active, ready accounting.

story_mappings.introduction: Explore the Surface Realm: seventeen independent story outcomes and six support rows, including regional deliveries, competing trophies and the labyrinth's exact five-material finale. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The Surface Realm is one large discovered zone covering many continental regions. Use nearby contacts and the exact zone journal command to follow encountered requests. Discovery supplies regional guidance; it does not reveal every contact or require exploring every grid room.

Most stories are independent deliveries. Native exchanges accept exact materials supplied by another player. Current possession, personal source recovery and durable accepted delivery are separate facts; inspecting this journal grants no history or keyword achievement.

The labyrinth campaign has competing offerings: four different warden trophies buy a book, while each warden asks for a separate labyrinthmaster heart to buy one elemental locket. A single heart cannot serve four consumers, and killing a warden can remove that appearance as a locket recipient.

The mystic's finale requires the book plus fire, water, earth and air lockets together. These are five current item kinds, not five earlier receipts. The air locket has copied fire keywords; the actual object kind distinguishes it. Earlier personal campaign receipts are optional rather than enforced.

The ornate gemmed reward key opens the downwards tomb door in the forest beyond the surface approach. The neighboring transparent gateway has another key and a different continuation. Local hand-in credit does not establish later access or foreign quest completion.

Opposing raider bounties and elemental prophet requests remain separate stories. Their pledge or victory prose supplies a role-playing choice without durable allegiance, permanent world defeat or mutually exclusive branch enforcement.

The tundra hunter has a five-fang equipment service and a paw story. Complete desired necklace work before the paw exchange retires that appearance. The rewarded white potion can serve a separate nomad request; a supplied potion qualifies without the producer's earlier receipt.

Five nightcrawler claws, a witchdoctor totem, three blood crystals and two independent wyvern-egg requests use exact current materials. Kills, worn items and earlier deliveries cannot replace those supplies. One egg is consumed by one recipient; narrated study or rebirth has no extra recorded endpoint.

Three fishing-market rows group independent support barters without quest achievements or dailies. Breale bass and normal large bass are distinct kinds. A valid supplied fish satisfies a barter without manufacturing a first personal catch.

The gland/bracer and four-crystal wand recipes also require coins. Their mixed settlement remains guarded while accounting is active. Preparation hints do not prove wallet readiness. The bracer has no ordinary loaded repeatable source found in this review.

Private dispersal hubs, capped proof, roaming contacts and 99-percent campaign appearances need actual availability qualification. A starting room or reset declaration is a lead; do not promise that a quest recipient or every material is currently present.

Treant death creates wood, the highwayman guardian can summon help, and the shadow rift chooses its destination by racewar context. Accepted source, helper and confirmed-travel events are needed before these mechanics can become recorded stages. The old devil death invasion is commented out.

Ports, travel buildings and class teachers have separate service and travel mechanics. Epic purchases remain unavailable while accounting is active. The old descend continuation is disabled; possession of campaign rewards does not make it a playable quest.

Directional boundary access and foreign source or continuation receipts retain their own area ownership. Two surface exits reference an unloaded room and have a targeted repair plan; neither discovery nor receipt tests certify a played access journey.

steps.hint: The Ice prophet starts at "An Altar of Ice" and remains after acceptance. Acceptance grants ring and three potions; describing a pledge does not establish a recorded faction choice.
steps.text: Complete the accepted exchange

stories.summary: Bring the Fire prophet's head to the Ice prophet for a frosty ring and three icy-cold potions. Opposing receipts are independent; the native contracts enforce no mutually exclusive allegiance.
stories.title: The Ice prophet's rival

steps.hint: Carry one exact listed fish or shellfish. Most ordinary kinds have fishing or other sources; the Breale bass is a different kind from the normal large bass. Supplied stock is valid without manufacturing a first personal catch.
steps.text: Carry one accepted market item

steps.hint: Starts at "Along a Crumbling Cobblestone Road". Either exact fish pays 900 copper; the fisherman remains. One selected barter completes this support row, with no story achievement or daily.
steps.text: Complete one accepted barter

stories.summary: Two independent support barters pay nine silver for one rainbow trout or one perch. The fisherman's clam/frustration topic is a clue, without a clam contract or a fishing achievement.
stories.title: Ja'Gunk's fish market

steps.hint: Carry one exact listed fish or shellfish. Most ordinary kinds have fishing or other sources; the Breale bass is a different kind from the normal large bass. Supplied stock is valid without manufacturing a first personal catch.
steps.text: Carry one accepted market item

steps.hint: Starts at "A Secluded Island on Lake Moria" and remains: Breale bass pays 4,000 copper, lobster pays 1,000, crab pays 800, oyster pays 600, clam pays 900 and mussel pays 750. Breale bass is stocked by the Breale shop; normal large bass is not valid here.
steps.text: Complete one accepted barter

stories.summary: Six independent bait barters are alternatives within one support row. They pay different prices rather than requiring a six-kind collection or awarding a shark. Ordinary catches and shop-supplied stock have separate source histories.
stories.title: Kres's bait market

steps.hint: Carry one exact listed fish or shellfish. Most ordinary kinds have fishing or other sources; the Breale bass is a different kind from the normal large bass. Supplied stock is valid without manufacturing a first personal catch.
steps.text: Carry one accepted market item

steps.hint: Starts at "A Small Fisherman's Dock" and remains: normal large bass pays 1,000 copper, piranha pays 2,000 and cod pays 950. Breale bass is a different kind and cannot replace the normal bass.
steps.text: Complete one accepted barter

stories.summary: Three independent village-food barters form one support row. A normal large bass, piranha or cod is accepted without requiring all three or a personal fishing receipt.
stories.title: Moldug's food market

steps.hint: Green hydralisk glands come from exact Ship Yards/vehicle carriers. Three distinct current instances are required; current source availability and imported custody need qualification.
steps.text: Carry three green hydralisk glands

steps.hint: The actual fee recipe requires one bronze-colored bracer, despite plural prose. It occurs in a class starter kit and a generic item table; no ordinary loaded reset or native quest producer was found. Qualify legitimate carried supply before promising repeat availability.
steps.text: Carry a bronze-colored bracer

steps.hint: Starts at "Along a Crumbling Cobblestone Road". Native terms are 100,000 copper plus the four actual items for gaseous bracelet, with recipient retirement. Item preparation does not establish fee readiness or bypass the accounting guard.
steps.text: Complete the accepted exchange

stories.summary: This equipment service asks for three glands, one bronze-colored bracer and one hundred platinum. Its mixed item-and-coin settlement is guarded while accounting is active. The row adds no story achievement or daily.
stories.title: Agnut's gland bracelet service

steps.hint: The local grey panther carries one sharp fang with cap one; Ship Yards, vehicle and Alatorin carriers provide further exact sources. Five actual instances are needed. Complete desired necklace work before giving the grey paw, which retires the current hunter.
steps.text: Carry five sharp fangs

steps.hint: Starts at "A Small Camp Site". Acceptance grants necklace and leaves the hunter present. The paw exchange retires this same recipient appearance, so order matters for availability.
steps.text: Complete the accepted exchange

stories.summary: Bring five sharp fangs together for a sharptooth necklace. This repeat equipment service is independent from the hunter's revenge story and contributes no achievement or daily.
stories.title: The hunter's five-fang necklace service

steps.hint: Twenty-four ordinary ground declarations on the Isle of Death share cap twenty-four. The wizard consumes three crystals; the wand service consumes four different currently carried crystals and a fee. An earlier hand-in cannot supply either later recipe.
steps.text: Carry four blood crystals

steps.hint: Starts at "Vast Plains of the Eagle Ridge Delta" and can roam. Native terms are four crystals plus 50,000 copper for wand, then retirement. Current item checks do not prove fee readiness or bypass the accounting guard.
steps.text: Complete the accepted exchange

stories.summary: This equipment service asks for four blood crystals and fifty platinum for a living wand. Mixed item-and-coin settlement is guarded while accounting is active. It competes with the wizard's three-crystal story and adds no achievement or daily.
stories.title: Flegnus's crystal wand service
